01-第一段-1到12級.md:73｜站內取捨｜值得做失而復得的武器（Wayward Weapons）、懶惰的苦工（Lazy Peons）和火刃洞穴兩件，目標可以併成兩趟。｜Do Wayward Weapons, Lazy Peons, and both Burning Blade Coven quests. Group the objectives into two loops.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:74｜站內取捨｜先完成 1485／1499 的小鬼任務，再找同一位祖雷薩接火刃獎章（Burning Blade Medallion）794【僅術士】。｜Finish the Imp quest (1485 or 1499), then accept Burning Blade Medallion (794) from Zureetha Fargaze. Warlocks only.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:74｜標籤｜僅術士｜Warlock only
01-第一段-1到12級.md:75｜站內提醒｜不足 6 級就沿路打雜斑野豬、工蠍或邪靈劣魔，再前往森金村。｜Below level 6? Grind Mottled Boars, Scorpid Workers, or Vile Familiars on the way to Sen'jin Village.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:77｜練怪說明｜密集／一般怪／多為中立，可逐隻開怪／試煉谷北側空地，1–2 級接續小試身手｜Dense, mostly neutral normal mobs. Pull singles north of Valley of Trials for Cutting Teeth at levels 1–2.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:78｜練怪說明｜密集／一般怪／多為中立，可逐隻開怪／大獸穴西北方，做工蠍的尾巴時順打｜Dense, mostly neutral normal mobs. Pull singles northwest of the Den while doing Sting of the Scorpid.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:79｜練怪說明｜密集／一般怪／洞口易多拉，先打外圍／火刃洞穴一帶，離谷前補到 6 級｜Dense normal mobs near Burning Blade Coven. Pull singles outside first. Grind to level 6 before leaving the valley.

01-第一段-1到12級.md:241｜交通步驟｜十字路口開迪弗拉克飛行點（1413 51.50, 30.34），可綁旅店老闆伯蘭德·草風（1413 51.99, 29.89）。｜Learn Devrak's flight path (1413 51.50, 30.34). You can set your hearth with Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind (1413 51.99, 29.89).

01-第一段-1到12級.md:243｜站內取捨｜「新的背包」值得做。帆布腳料可和提拉加德城堡其他任務一起收。｜Do Carry Your Weight. Collect Canvas Scraps alongside the other Tiragarde Keep objectives.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:244｜站內取捨｜先交背信棄義的人類（Vanquish the Betrayers）784，才接得到海底沈船（From The Wreckage....）825。把沉船和沃納爾大師（A Solvent Spirit）818 排成同一趟。｜Turn in Vanquish the Betrayers (784) to unlock From The Wreckage.... (825). Do it alongside A Solvent Spirit (818).
01-第一段-1到12級.md:245｜站內取捨｜暗巷區副本接續可先留。打算下怒焰裂谷（Ragefire Chasm）再跟索爾接隱藏的敵人（Hidden Enemies）5726→5727→5728。5726 所需的軍官徽章可在北邊火刃區取得。｜Save the Cleft of Shadow dungeon chain. If you plan to run Ragefire Chasm, take Hidden Enemies (5726 → 5727 → 5728) from Thrall. Get the badge for 5726 from the Burning Blade camp to the north.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:246｜站內提醒｜不足 12 級可補保衛商路（Securing the Lines）、骷髏石（Skull Rock）或地底威脅（Threat from Below）前幾段。｜Below level 12? Do Securing the Lines, Skull Rock, or the first few Threat from Below quests.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:248｜練怪說明｜密集／一般怪／城堡通道易多拉，先打外側／提拉加德城堡，順收新背包所需的帆布腳料｜Dense normal mobs at Tiragarde Keep. Pull outside to avoid adds in the halls. Collect Canvas Scraps for the new bag.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:249｜練怪說明｜集中／一般怪／巡邏可能加怪，先拉營地邊緣／剃刀嶺西面，可和野豬人的進犯一起做｜Normal mobs cluster west of Razor Hill. Pull along the camp edge and watch for patrols. Pair with Encroachment.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:250｜練怪說明｜集中／一般怪／有施法怪，貼掩體拉到近處／北杜洛塔，做保衛商路或進奧格瑪前補到 12 級｜Normal mobs cluster in northern Durotar. Use cover to draw casters close. Do Securing the Lines or grind to 12 before Orgrimmar.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:256｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
01-第一段-1到12級.md:259｜危險說明｜提拉加德城堡的樓梯和門框容易把樓上水兵一起引下來。先清外牆與門口。｜The stairs and doorways in Tiragarde Keep can pull sailors from upstairs. Clear the outer wall and entrance first.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:260｜危險說明｜北岸的海巨人在納迦區活動。清掉周圍小怪再打，跑不動時從岸上撤。｜Sea giants roam the naga area on the north shore. Clear nearby mobs before pulling one. Retreat along the shore if you get in trouble.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:266｜站內交通｜跨族起點先到血蹄村，再沿路往南上紅雲台地到納拉其營地。完整轉乘見文首。｜Coming from another starting zone? Head to Bloodhoof Village, then follow the road south up Red Cloud Mesa to Camp Narache. See the travel notes above.

01-第一段-1到12級.md:466｜步驟說明｜需已學製皮且達任務門檻，另備 4 塊輕皮與 4 份粗線。同任務也可找波拉姆（1456 44.08, 44.89）。｜Meet the LW req. Bring 4 Light Leather and 4 Coarse Thread. Boramu (1456 44.08, 44.89).
01-第一段-1到12級.md:466｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
01-第一段-1到12級.md:467｜交通步驟｜達 12 級後從莫高雷東門走到貧瘠之地。經陶拉祖營地時開歐姆薩·雷角飛行點（1413 44.45, 59.15）。｜At level 12, leave Mulgore by the east gate. Learn Omusa Thunderhorn's flight path in Camp Taurajo (1413 44.45, 59.15).

01-第一段-1到12級.md:471｜交通步驟｜沿大路向北到十字路口，開迪弗拉克飛行點（1413 51.50, 30.34），並向旅店老闆伯蘭德·草風綁爐石（1413 51.99, 29.89）。｜Follow the road north to the Crossroads. Learn Devrak's flight path (1413 51.50, 30.34) and set your hearth with Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind (1413 51.99, 29.89).
01-第一段-1到12級.md:473｜站內取捨｜值得做幻象儀祭（Rite of Vision）767→771→772、智慧儀祭（Rite of Wisdom）773 和雷霆崖之旅（Journey into Thunder Bluff）775，末段正好開飛行點。｜Do Rite of Vision (767 → 771 → 772), Rite of Wisdom (773), and Journey into Thunder Bluff (775). Unlock the flight path on the last leg.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:474｜站內取捨｜水井任務先完成前一口才接下一口【僅牛頭人】。已到 12 級時可跳過蠻鬃之井支線【僅牛頭人】。｜Turn in each well quest before taking the next one. Tauren only. Skip the Wildmane Water Well chain if you're already level 12. Tauren only.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:474｜標籤｜僅牛頭人｜Tauren only
01-第一段-1到12級.md:475｜站內取捨｜到了雷霆崖可接怒焰裂谷（Ragefire Chasm）前置，打算進本才跟拉哈羅接試探敵人（Testing an Enemy’s Strength）5723、尋找背包（Searching for the Lost Satchel）5722。｜Running Ragefire Chasm? Pick up Testing an Enemy's Strength (5723) and Searching for the Lost Satchel (5722) from Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:476｜站內提醒｜接近 12 級還差經驗，優先補莫高雷北邊鷹身人、赤色石或菲茲普羅克礦坑；10 級職業解鎖見文末。｜Need XP for level 12? Grind harpies in northern Mulgore, or head to Red Rocks or the Venture Co. Mine. See the class quests below for level 10 unlocks.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:478｜練怪說明｜分散／一般怪／草地可逐隻拉，留意游走怪／血蹄村北側，順收馬茲拉納其材料｜Scattered normal mobs north of Bloodhoof Village. Pull singles in the grass and watch for roamers. Pick up Mazzranache materials.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:479｜練怪說明｜集中／一般怪／混有工人與巡邏，先沿礦坑外側拉／菲茲普羅克礦坑周邊，可順做礦坑任務｜Normal mobs cluster around the Venture Co. Mine. Pull from outside and watch for workers and patrols. Pair with the mine quests.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:480｜練怪說明｜密集／一般怪／混有施法型鷹身人，先拉營地外側／莫高雷西北鷹身人營地，接近 12 級時補經驗｜Dense normal mobs at the harpy camp in northwest Mulgore. Pull along the edge to avoid casters. Grind here if close to level 12.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:485｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
01-第一段-1到12級.md:488｜危險說明｜菲茲普羅克礦坑會把巡邏與礦工一起拉入戰。先清外側，拿到筆記板就退出洞道。｜Patrols and miners can pull together inside the Venture Co. Mine. Clear the outside first, grab the clipboard, and leave the tunnel.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:494｜站內交通｜跨族起點從布瑞爾南側飛艇塔下船，沿大道向西進喪鐘鎮。完整轉乘見文首。｜Coming from another starting zone? Get off at the zeppelin tower south of Brill and follow the road west to Deathknell. See the travel notes above.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:498｜站內提醒｜從墓穴內的 363 開始【僅不死族】。抵達喪鐘鎮後，可在暗影牧師薩維斯（1420 30.84, 66.20）接 364。若薩維斯未顯示任務，沿道路前往布瑞爾。｜Start with 363 inside the crypt (Undead only). Pick up 364 from Shadow Priest Sarvis (1420 30.84, 66.20). If he has no quest, follow the road to Brill.

01-第一段-1到12級.md:530｜交通步驟｜沿東路離開喪鐘鎮，前往布瑞爾。｜Take the east road out of Deathknell to Brill.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:532｜站內值得做｜在夜行蜘蛛洞穴完成 380 時，可順路救出闇境明燈（A Light in the Darkness）98389 的受害者【僅不死族】。｜While doing 380 in Night Web's Hollow, rescue the victims for A Light in the Darkness (98389). Undead only.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:532｜標籤｜僅不死族｜Undead only
01-第一段-1到12級.md:533｜站內提醒｜尚未到 3 級再打幾隻斷骨骷髏，升到 3 級才接瑪拉的遺願 6395。到 6 級或做完這段就往布瑞爾。｜Grind Rattlecage Skeletons to level 3, then accept Marla's Last Wish (6395). Head to Brill at level 6 or once you finish this section.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:535｜練怪說明｜密集／一般怪／多為中立，可逐隻開怪／喪鐘鎮北側，1–2 級順做無腦的僵屍｜Dense, mostly neutral normal mobs north of Deathknell. Pull singles during The Mindless Ones at levels 1–2.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:536｜練怪說明｜密集／一般怪／洞內易多拉，沿入口到內側逐段清／夜行蜘蛛洞穴，順做洞穴任務｜Dense normal mobs inside Night Web's Hollow. Clear in stages from the entrance to avoid extra pulls. Pair with the cave quests.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:537｜練怪說明｜密集／一般怪／與信徒混居，先打營地外圍／東側血色營地，與臂章任務一起清｜Dense normal mobs at the eastern Scarlet camp. Clear along the edge to avoid pulling zealots. Pair with the armband quest.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:541｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
01-第一段-1到12級.md:543｜危險說明｜夜行蜘蛛洞穴的窄道容易同時拉到前後兩群蜘蛛。入口先清一輪再進。｜The narrow tunnel in Night Web's Hollow can pull spider packs from both sides. Clear the entrance before going in.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:552｜粗體註記｜喪鐘鎮往布瑞爾，先清西側農場｜Deathknell to Brill via the western farms

01-第一段-1到12級.md:675｜交通步驟｜前往布瑞爾東南方的飛艇塔，到西平台找飛艇管理員薩匹塔（1420 60.74, 58.87）搭奧格瑪線。飛艇抵達杜洛塔奧格瑪正門外東側塔樓的南平台（1411 50.82, 13.54）。｜Board the Orgrimmar zeppelin at Zapetta's west platform southeast of Brill (1420 60.74, 58.87). Get off at the south platform of the east tower outside Orgrimmar (1411 50.82, 13.54).
01-第一段-1到12級.md:676｜交通步驟｜下塔進奧格瑪正門，開朵拉斯飛行點（1454 45.12, 63.89）。已開十字路口飛點就直接飛；初訪沿杜洛塔大道南下剃刀嶺，再向西過橋進貧瘠之地。抵達十字路口後開迪弗拉克飛行點（1413 51.50, 30.34），向旅店老闆伯蘭德·草風綁爐石（1413 51.99, 29.89），接貧瘠之地 十字路口。｜Enter Orgrimmar and learn Doras's flight path (1454 45.12, 63.89). Fly to the Crossroads if unlocked. Otherwise run south to Razor Hill, cross west into the Barrens and continue to the Crossroads. Learn Devrak's flight path (1413 51.50, 30.34) and set your hearth with Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind (1413 51.99, 29.89).
01-第一段-1到12級.md:678｜站內提醒｜若 383 未接，直接從布瑞爾旅店和第一批可接任務開始。｜If you haven't accepted 383, start at the Brill inn and pick up the first batch of quests.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:679｜站內取捨｜血色、蜘蛛和墓穴草在東南同趟做；北岸魚人和阿加曼德可成一趟。先就近交，12 級就轉去十字路口。｜Do the Scarlet, spider, and grave moss objectives on the southeast loop. Pair the north-shore murlocs with the Agamand quests. Turn in nearby quests and leave for the Crossroads at level 12.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:680｜站內取捨｜旅店旁的 375 需要粗線，順路向供應商買。97558 若手上仍少北岸魚人皮，可等再去北岸時完成。｜Buy Coarse Thread from a vendor for 375 by the inn. If you still need north-shore murloc hides for 97558, finish it on your next trip to the shore.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:681｜站內取捨｜可在銀色黎明的兩個原地任務後接班達利昂要塞 96899【僅獸人／食人妖／不死族】。要塞的部分後續可接【僅不死族】。趕往十字路口可在銀色黎明的兩個原地任務後離開。｜Finish both local Argent Dawn quests to unlock Bandarion Keep (96899) (Orcs, Trolls, and Undead only). Some follow-ups are Undead only. If you're heading straight to the Crossroads, leave after the two local quests.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:681｜標籤｜僅獸人／食人妖／不死族｜Orc/Troll/Undead only
01-第一段-1到12級.md:681｜標籤｜僅不死族｜Undead only
01-第一段-1到12級.md:682｜站內提醒｜若未到 12 級，優先補 372、408 或銀色黎明 96895／96897／96898，依可接與所在位置選擇。｜Below level 12? Do 372, 408, or the Argent Dawn quests 96895, 96897, and 96898, depending on availability and where you are.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:684｜練怪說明｜分散／一般怪／會施法，可從營地外側逐隻拉／布瑞爾西南，與第一輪血色十字軍任務同行｜Scattered normal casters southwest of Brill. Pull singles from the edge during the first Scarlet Crusade quests.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:685｜練怪說明｜集中／一般怪／與血殭屍混居，留意巡邏／東南墓地，巡查後方和墓穴草可一起做｜Normal mobs cluster with Blood Zombies in the southeast graveyard. Watch for patrols. Pair Rear Guard Patrol with the graveyard herb quest.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:686｜練怪說明｜密集／一般怪／與黑暗執法者混居，營地邊緣較好單拉／東南銀色黎明支線附近，11 級後可補到 12｜Dense normal mobs near the Argent Dawn quests to the southeast. Pull singles from the camp edge to avoid Dark Enforcers. Grind from 11 to 12.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:691｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
01-第一段-1到12級.md:694｜危險說明｜東南墓地混有血殭屍與遊蕩的幽靈，容易被前後夾擊。沿墓地邊緣清，留住退路。｜Watch for zombies and roaming spirits in the southeast graveyard. Clear along the edge so you don't get boxed in.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:700｜站內交通｜跨族起點從莫高雷 天空守望者高原 南側碼頭（1412 34.30, 25.80）搭割天者號，在瓦拉納爾西碼頭（2521 57.90, 80.90）下船，再沿路北上坦德爾林地。｜Coming from another starting zone? Board the Skycutter at the south dock of Skywatcher Plateau in Mulgore (1412 34.30, 25.80). Get off at Valanaar's west dock (2521 57.90, 80.90) and follow the road north to Thendal Grove.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:704｜站內提醒｜抵達瓦拉納爾後沿大道北上坦德爾林地。其他部落可做共用支線，種族限定與未解鎖的前置步驟由插件過濾。1–3 級可先沿坦德爾林地打飛狐幼崽與捲雲蜂，再做可接的採集和村落支線。若已清完可接任務仍不足 12，回莫高雷接血蹄村支線補足。｜Follow the road north from Valanaar to Thendal Grove. Other Horde races can do shared side quests. The addon hides race-locked steps and those with missing prerequisites. At levels 1–3, kill young vuldren and cirrusflies before the gathering and village quests. Still below 12? Finish in Bloodhoof Village.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:706｜粗體註記｜坦德爾村、瞭望塔與山坡｜Thendal Village, the watchtower and hills

01-第一段-1到12級.md:954｜步驟說明｜用傳送門抵達羅哈希尖塔後再進行劇情，完成後回瓦拉納爾交件。｜Take the portal to Rohashi Spires for the event, then turn in at Valanaar.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:963｜交通步驟｜到瓦拉納爾小屋外的西碼頭（2521 57.90, 80.90），在塑風者碼頭管理員所在的碼頭搭割天者號。到莫高雷 天空守望者高原 南側碼頭（1412 34.30, 25.80）下船。瓦拉納爾的東碼頭（2521 65.90, 83.50）開往達拉然。｜Board the Skycutter by the Windshapers Dockmaster at the west dock outside Valanaar's hut (2521 57.90, 80.90). Get off at the south dock of Skywatcher Plateau in Mulgore (1412 34.30, 25.80). The east dock at Valanaar (2521 65.90, 83.50) serves Dalaran.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:965｜步驟說明｜同任務也可找穆倫‧地怒（1412 33.42, 22.59）。｜Muln Earthfury also handles this quest (1412 33.42, 22.59).
01-第一段-1到12級.md:966｜標籤｜僅塑風者天裔精靈｜Windshaper Skyborne only
01-第一段-1到12級.md:966｜步驟說明｜之後到奧格瑪才交｜Save the turn-in for Orgrimmar.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:966｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
01-第一段-1到12級.md:967｜交通步驟｜從 天空守望者高原 沿地面道路南下，搭雷霆崖電梯上城，先開塔爾飛行點（1456 47.00, 49.83）。若十字路口飛點已開，可直接飛過去。初訪則沿莫高雷大道走東側山口，經陶拉祖營地開歐姆薩·雷角飛行點（1413 44.45, 59.15），再沿大路往北。到十字路口開迪弗拉克飛行點（1413 51.50, 30.34），向旅店老闆伯蘭德·草風綁爐石（1413 51.99, 29.89），接貧瘠之地 十字路口。｜Run south from Skywatcher Plateau, take the lift to Thunder Bluff and learn Tal's flight path (1456 47.00, 49.83). Fly to the Crossroads if unlocked. Otherwise leave Mulgore via the east pass, learn Camp Taurajo from Omusa Thunderhorn (1413 44.45, 59.15), then follow the road north. In the Crossroads, learn Devrak's flight path (1413 51.50, 30.34) and set your hearth with Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind (1413 51.99, 29.89).
01-第一段-1到12級.md:969｜站內取捨｜本島主線依序走坦德爾、申德村、瓦拉納爾、奧基爾聖殿。還沒到12級可先做果園或影風森林支線，再搭飛艇。｜Follow the island chain from Thendal Grove through Shen'dar Village and Valanaar to the Shrine of Akir. Below level 12? Do the orchard or Shadowgale Forest side quests before boarding the zeppelin.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:970｜站內取捨｜村旁學徒和強盜任務可一起接。也可同時接角鷹獸騷擾（Hippogryph Harassment）92516【僅天裔精靈】。群爪問題（The Problem With Prideclaws）給簡易皮革背袋。愛管閒事的法師（Meddlesome Mages）可選潮汐流轉塑像【僅德魯伊】。完成火之召喚可取得充能烈焰圖騰【僅薩滿】。｜Pick up the apprentice and bandit quests together. Add Hippogryph Harassment (92516) if you're Skyborne. The Problem With Prideclaws rewards a Simple Leather Satchel. Meddlesome Mages offers Idol of Shifting Tides to Druids. Shamans get Totem of Charged Flames from Call of Fire.

01-第一段-1到12級.md:971｜站內提醒｜離島兩個銜接任務 93090、95349 顯示為 13 級任務，QuestieDB 最低可接等級是 7，主線跑完就能接。｜Quests 93090 and 95349 show level 13 in the log, but you can pick them up from level 7 once you finish the island chain, per QuestieDB.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:974｜練怪說明｜密集／一般怪／可逐隻開怪，留意鄰近蜂群／坦德爾林地，1–2 級可先在起點附近升級｜Dense normal mobs in Thendal Grove. Pull singles and watch for nearby swarms. Grind near the start at levels 1–2.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:975｜練怪說明｜密集／一般怪／強盜會成群，先清營地邊緣／申德高地，與犯罪元素及被偷走的風石同行｜Dense normal mobs in the Shen'dar Highlands. Pull bandits from the camp edge to avoid groups. Pair with The Criminal Element and Pilfered Windstones.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:976｜練怪說明｜密集／一般怪／混有步行兵，先從營地外側拉／影風森林，順做不屑為伍也不夠格之人，接近 12 級時補經驗｜Dense normal mobs in Shadowgale Forest. Pull from the edge to avoid footsoldiers. Pair with Unwanted and Unworthy or grind to 12.

01-第一段-1到12級.md:991｜危險說明｜坦德爾林地瞭望塔的跳下路線需要空中行走。先把種族技能放上快捷列，跳下後立即用。｜Put your racial on your action bar before jumping from the Thendal Grove lookout. Use it immediately after you jump.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:991｜標籤｜僅天裔｜Skyborne only
01-第一段-1到12級.md:992｜危險說明｜影風森林營地的奧拉凱斯追風者混在步行兵之間，別穿營地中央，沿外圈逐隻拉。｜Al'Aketh Stormchasers are mixed in with footsoldiers in the Shadowgale Forest camp. Pull one at a time from the edge and avoid the middle.

02-12到30級.md:78｜步驟說明｜以科卡爾牧民的掉率估算。往綠洲打牧民，路過同區其他科卡爾怪也可補護腕。｜Kill Kolkar Wranglers at the oasis. Other nearby Kolkar can drop bracers too.

02-12到30級.md:101｜步驟說明｜海盜隊長在更南邊，等級不足可略。｜The pirate captain is farther south. Skip if you're underleveled.

02-12到30級.md:118｜交通步驟｜從棘齒城沿西南路到死水綠洲，清完綠洲目標再走回十字路口交件，保留爐石供銀松回程。｜Take the southwest road to the Stagnant Oasis. Clear it and run back to the Crossroads to turn in. Save your hearth for the return from Silverpine.
02-12到30級.md:120｜粗體註記｜死水綠洲、異變鉗嘴龜，解鎖銀松導引｜Stagnant Oasis and Altered Snapjaws. Unlock the Silverpine lead-in
02-12到30級.md:125｜步驟說明｜可到十字路口西南的甘泉綠洲，也可沿死水綠洲再打龜。｜Kill turtles at Lushwater Oasis southwest of the Crossroads or at Stagnant Oasis.

02-12到30級.md:133｜交通步驟｜選做雷霆崖支線時，已開塔爾的飛行點就從十字路口搭鳥。沒開時由陶拉祖營地沿路入莫高雷，搭雷霆崖電梯上城，找塔爾開點（1456 47.00, 49.83）。853 計時從接取開始，只有能及時到達才接。｜For the optional Thunder Bluff detour, fly from the Crossroads if unlocked. Otherwise enter Mulgore via Camp Taurajo, take the lift and learn Tal's flight path (1456 47.00, 49.83). Quest 853 starts a timer on pickup. Take it only if you can make it.

02-12到30級.md:143｜步驟說明｜雷霆崖靈魂高地的克拉莉斯，留銀松森林 瑟伯切爾在銀松交。｜Pick up from Clarice on Spirit Rise. Turn in at the Sepulcher later.
02-12到30級.md:143｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
02-12到30級.md:144｜交通步驟｜從目前所在的十字路口或雷霆崖飛奧格瑪，前提是已開奧格瑪飛點。從十字路口首次去奧格瑪，走東北大道過怒水河再沿杜洛塔大道北上；從雷霆崖首次去，先飛十字路口。進城找朵拉斯開點（1454 45.12, 63.89）。｜Fly to Orgrimmar if unlocked. For your first visit, start at the Crossroads, cross the Southfury River and follow the Durotar road north. From Thunder Bluff, fly to the Crossroads first. Unlock Orgrimmar with Doras (1454 45.12, 63.89).
02-12到30級.md:145｜步驟說明｜順路進奧格瑪智慧谷才接，留石爪山脈 烈日石居找希雷斯。｜Pick up in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom. See Seereth on the Sun Rock Retreat leg.
02-12到30級.md:145｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
02-12到30級.md:145｜標籤｜13級起｜Lv 13+
02-12到30級.md:146｜交通步驟｜從奧格瑪出城，走到杜洛塔飛艇塔的弗雷薩（1411 50.82, 13.54）所在一側，往銀松森林時搭提里斯法林地線。爐石保持十字路口。｜Leave Orgrimmar and board the Tirisfal Glades zeppelin at Frezza's platform (1411 50.82, 13.54). Keep your hearth at the Crossroads.
02-12到30級.md:148｜站內交通｜第 4 步開十字路口並綁爐石；第一趟棘齒城開布萊格；離站到弗雷薩一側等提里斯法林地線。｜At step 4, unlock the Crossroads flight path and set your Hearthstone. See Bragok on your first Ratchet visit. When leaving, wait on Frezza's side for the Tirisfal Glades zeppelin.
02-12到30級.md:149｜站內取捨｜值得做 870 → 877 → 880，只有交完才開往銀松的 3301。TUGs 把 880 排到另一次貧瘠之地，本路線提早清完，方便下一站直接交 3301。｜Do 870 → 877 → 880 to unlock 3301 for Silverpine. This route moves 880 earlier than TUGs so you can turn in 3301 at the next stop.
02-12到30級.md:150｜站內取捨｜北側沼澤護送、礦洞與 888 留貧瘠之地 棘齒城與陶拉祖營地一起做，第一次到棘齒城只清近岸海盜。｜Save the northern marsh escort, the mine, and 888 for the Ratchet and Camp Taurajo loop. On your first Ratchet visit, clear only the pirates near shore.
02-12到30級.md:151｜站內取捨｜雷霆崖 853、1489、264 看是否順路；若已 16 級又無哀嚎隊伍，可直接轉銀松。｜Do 853, 1489, and 264 if passing through Thunder Bluff. If you're level 16 and have no Wailing Caverns group, head straight to Silverpine.
02-12到30級.md:152｜站內提醒｜14–16 可選怒焰裂谷；主線無須排到副本。未滿 16 可提前做貧瘠之地 棘齒城與陶拉祖營地的 881、875，或在死水綠洲（約 55, 42）打變異龜，走下一站前先交現成的任務。｜Ragefire Chasm is optional at 14–16. Below 16, do 881 and 875 early during the Ratchet and Camp Taurajo leg, or grind Altered Snapjaws at the Stagnant Oasis (around 55, 42). Turn in any finished quests before leaving.
02-12到30級.md:155｜練怪說明｜十字路口東南的開闊平原，密度中等、普通怪。附近有半人馬巡邏，沿路挑落單的陸行鳥，適合 12–13 級補開局經驗。｜Moderate density on the open plain southeast of the Crossroads. Pick off lone tallstriders at levels 12–13. Watch for centaur patrols.
02-12到30級.md:156｜練怪說明｜死水綠洲岸邊密度高，普通怪；往外拉，留意附近的科卡爾。可同步補變異的鉗嘴龜殼。｜Dense normal mobs along Stagnant Oasis. Pull away from the shore and watch for Kolkar. Collect Altered Snapjaw Shells as you go.
02-12到30級.md:162｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
02-12到30級.md:163｜標籤｜僅法師,薩滿,牧師,聖騎士,術士,德魯伊,盜賊｜Mage/Shaman/Priest/Paladin/Warlock/Druid/Rogue only
02-12到30級.md:167｜危險說明｜棘齒城南的南海炮兵與海盜會從高低兩層一起加入。先清山腳再上坡取零件。｜Southsea Cannoneers and pirates can pull from both levels south of Ratchet. Clear the foot of the hill before going up for the parts.
02-12到30級.md:175｜交通步驟｜在杜洛塔城外飛艇塔，找弗雷薩（1411 50.82, 13.54）確認提里斯法林地線再登艇。到布瑞爾南方的飛艇塔後沿大道往幽暗城；保留十字路口爐石。｜At the Durotar zeppelin tower, confirm the Tirisfal Glades route with Frezza (1411 50.82, 13.54). Get off south of Brill and follow the road to Undercity. Keep your hearth at the Crossroads.
02-12到30級.md:176｜交通步驟｜尚未開幽暗城飛點就進城找邁克爾·加勒特（1458 63.25, 48.56）。若已開瑟伯切爾就飛去；首次到瑟伯切爾先出幽暗城，沿提里斯法林地西南的大路進銀松森林。｜Learn Undercity's flight path from Michael Garrett (1458 63.25, 48.56). Fly to the Sepulcher if unlocked. Otherwise leave the city and take Tirisfal's southwest road into Silverpine Forest.

02-12到30級.md:334｜交通步驟｜有幽暗城待交的任務時，從瑟伯切爾飛幽暗城一趟；沒有待交任務即可在瑟伯切爾直接用下一個爐石步驟。｜Fly to Undercity if you have turn-ins there. Otherwise hearth straight from the Sepulcher at the next step.

02-12到30級.md:340｜交通步驟｜用先前綁好的爐石回貧瘠之地 十字路口。爐石不可用時，由幽暗城出城到布瑞爾南塔，找薩匹塔（1420 60.74, 58.87，西平台）確認奧格瑪線；下艇後進奧格瑪飛十字路口。｜Hearth to the Crossroads. If your hearth is unavailable, board the Orgrimmar zeppelin at Zapetta's west platform south of Brill (1420 60.74, 58.87), then fly to the Crossroads.
02-12到30級.md:342｜站內交通｜初訪瑟伯切爾先走地面；開點後才飛。回程優先用十字路口爐石，冷卻時才搭奧格瑪飛艇。｜Walk to the Sepulcher on your first visit and unlock the flight path. Hearth to the Crossroads on the way back. If your Hearthstone is on cooldown, take the Orgrimmar zeppelin.
02-12到30級.md:343｜站內取捨｜值得做｜先解鎖 479 與永恆版 95981，同一趟掃安伯米爾；479 交回後再殺 480 的法師。｜Unlock 479 and Forever quest 95981, then do both in Ambermill on one loop. Turn in 479 before killing the mages for 480.
02-12到30級.md:344｜站內取捨｜值得做｜焚木村一起做 99、450；交 99 後一次接 98298、98299，到葛雷邁恩之牆一起清。｜Do 99 and 450 together in Pyrewood Village. Turn in 99, then take 98298 and 98299 and do both at the Greymane Wall.
02-12到30級.md:345｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜走到 20 級便可以回貧瘠之地。優先跳過還沒進場的護送 435、伏擊 452 與影牙城堡支線。若已接 447、444 等幽暗城交付，從瑟伯切爾飛回時順便交。｜Head back to the Barrens at level 20. Skip escort 435, ambush 452, and the Shadowfang Keep chain if you haven't started them. Turn in any active Undercity quests, such as 447 or 444, when you fly back from the Sepulcher.
02-12到30級.md:346｜站內取捨｜先別交｜493 在 19 級接到後留給希爾斯布萊德丘陵 塔倫米爾。路線先回貧瘠之地，不另跑一趟塔倫米爾。｜Accept 493 at level 19 and save it for Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills. Return to the Barrens first to avoid a separate trip.
02-12到30級.md:347｜站內提醒｜若低於 20 級，先清葛雷邁恩之牆（約 43, 81）或安伯米爾（約 63, 65）剩餘的單人任務和普通怪。有隊伍時可打影牙城堡；1013 最低 16 級，1014、1098 最低 18 級。｜Below level 20? Finish the solo quests and grind normal mobs at the Greymane Wall (around 43, 81) or Ambermill (around 63, 65). Run Shadowfang Keep if you have a group. Quest 1013 requires level 16, while 1014 and 1098 require 18.
02-12到30級.md:350｜練怪說明｜安伯米爾外圍密度中等，普通遠程怪；先清路邊，用地形拉離房屋門口，減少連帶引怪。｜Moderate density of normal ranged mobs outside Ambermill. Clear the roadside first. Use terrain to draw mobs away from doorways.
02-12到30級.md:351｜練怪說明｜安伯米爾外圈密度中等，普通遠程怪；附近有衛士，逐隻打。離原本達拉然任務近。｜Moderate density of normal ranged mobs outside Ambermill, near the Dalaran quest area. Pull singles and watch for guards.
02-12到30級.md:352｜練怪說明｜葛雷邁恩之牆前密度高，普通怪；近牆區域較擠，從路邊逐隻拉，適合離站前補到 20 級。｜Dense normal mobs by the Greymane Wall. Pull singles from the roadside. Grind to level 20 before leaving.
02-12到30級.md:359｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
02-12到30級.md:360｜標籤｜僅盜賊｜Rogue only
02-12到30級.md:364｜標籤｜僅法師,薩滿,牧師,聖騎士,術士,德魯伊｜Mage/Shaman/Priest/Paladin/Warlock/Druid only
02-12到30級.md:365｜標籤｜僅盜賊｜Rogue only
02-12到30級.md:367｜危險說明｜銀松森林有 24–25 級精英阿魯高之子巡邏。看到精英就繞開，別往林內逃。｜Level 24–25 elite Sons of Arugal patrol Silverpine Forest. Give them a wide berth. If one spots you, stay out of the woods.
02-12到30級.md:368｜危險說明｜焚木村通往葛雷邁恩之牆的路也會遇到阿魯高之子。做完伏擊就走，別沿牆追怪。｜Sons of Arugal also patrol the road from Pyrewood Village to the Greymane Wall. Leave after the ambush and don't chase mobs along the wall.
02-12到30級.md:377｜粗體註記｜從銀松返回十字路口，先掃北側｜Back from Silverpine: clear north of the Crossroads first
02-12到30級.md:379｜交通步驟｜銀松森林 瑟伯切爾已回十字路口者在營地接任。中途加入且仍在東部王國，優先爐石回十字路口；爐石不可用則搭布瑞爾南塔的奧格瑪線，再從奧格瑪飛十字路口。十字路口爐石先留到北線清完。｜Pick up quests if you're already back at the Crossroads. Joining from the Eastern Kingdoms? Hearth there, or take the Orgrimmar zeppelin south of Brill and fly to the Crossroads. Save your hearth for the end of the northern loop.
02-12到30級.md:384｜標籤｜掉率 100%｜Drop rate: 100%

02-12到30級.md:390｜交通步驟｜從十字路口飛棘齒城，先前兩處飛行點已開就直接搭鳥；漏開棘齒城就沿東側大道進城找布萊格（1413 63.08, 37.16）。貧瘠之地 十字路口已拿 894 可保留。｜Fly from the Crossroads to Ratchet if both flight paths are open. Otherwise take the east road and learn Ratchet from Bragok (1413 63.08, 37.16). Keep quest 894 if you picked it up at the Crossroads.
02-12到30級.md:395｜步驟說明｜北邊要順路去礦洞再接。｜Accept only if you're heading to the mine up north.

02-12到30級.md:398｜交通步驟｜棘齒城沿城北通道往泥漿沼澤，順便清北側原野；第一趟未接 894 者先回斯布特瓦夫補接。｜Take Ratchet's north exit to the Sludge Fen and clear the northern flats. If you missed 894, pick it up from Sputtervalve first.

02-12到30級.md:544｜站內交通｜北側清完用爐石回十字路口，先交營地任務再飛棘齒城。初到陶拉祖營地補開飛點。｜Finish the northern loop, then hearth to the Crossroads and turn in before flying to Ratchet. Unlock the Camp Taurajo flight path on your first visit.
02-12到30級.md:545｜站內取捨｜值得做 878、95774、899 的重疊目標。899 需要 60 根獠牙，不夠就留在背包，等級達標時可省去單刷。｜Do 878, 95774, and 899 together. Keep any tusks you get toward the 60 needed for 899. Skip farming the rest if you've reached the target level.
02-12到30級.md:546｜站內取捨｜開往石爪山的 1060、1483 在下一站交，1069 先採卵、下次順路回棘齒城才交。6382 與選做的 6543 留灰谷。｜Turn in 1060 and 1483 at the next stop in Stonetalon Mountains. Collect the eggs for 1069 now and turn it in the next time you pass through Ratchet. Save 6382 and optional 6543 for Ashenvale.
02-12到30級.md:547｜站內取捨｜20 級精英 92706、半人馬事件 4021、邊境 97250 組隊再做；北方城堡護送容易引到沿路怪，也可略過。｜Group for the level 20 elite in 92706, the centaur event in 4021, and border quest 97250. Skip the Northwatch Hold escort if you want to avoid extra pulls.
02-12到30級.md:548｜站內取捨｜礦工的寶貝掉率偏低，已打不出便去做路線後段；四個稀有只在遇到並拾到物品時觸發。｜The miner's loot has a low drop rate. Move on if it won't drop. The four rare quests only start if you find the rare and loot its item.
02-12到30級.md:549｜站內提醒｜未到 23 級可在肅清原野 98093 的怪點（47.11, 77.38）續打蜥蜴、潛獵者，或南下接 843。哀嚎洞穴入口約 47.70, 35.00，建議 18–23 級跑。可帶貧瘠之地 十字路口已解鎖的尖牙德魯伊 914、毒蛇花 962，棘齒城港口的麻煩 959、智慧飲料 1491，以及洞外岩台的變異皮革 1486、清除變異者 1487。｜Below level 23? Grind lizards and stalkers at the 98093 spot (47.11, 77.38), or head south for 843. Run Wailing Caverns around levels 18–23 (entrance 47.70, 35.00). Bring 914 and 962 from the Crossroads, 959 and 1491 from Ratchet, and 1486 and 1487 from the ledge outside the cave.
02-12到30級.md:552｜練怪說明｜肅清原野密度高，普通怪；在草地輪巡，留意憤恨的掠取者精英，避開戰團中央。｜Dense normal mobs in the Field to Clear. Loop through the grass and stay out of the fighting. Watch for the elite Outraged Pillager.
02-12到30級.md:553｜練怪說明｜與雷鱗蜥蜴同一片草地，密度高、普通怪；有其他玩家清同區時，沿外圈補另一種怪，不必轉營地。｜Dense normal mobs in the same field as the Stormhides. If other players are farming, switch targets along the edge without moving camps.
02-12到30級.md:560｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
02-12到30級.md:565｜危險說明｜肅清原野的精英掠取者在普通怪之間巡邏。只打外圈蜥蜴，避免穿過戰團。｜An elite pillager at Field to Clear patrols among the normal mobs. Grind lizards on the outside and avoid crossing the battlefield.
02-12到30級.md:566｜危險說明｜通往塵泥沼澤的邊境有成群聯盟士兵。沒有隊伍可略過遭錯怪，得平反。｜Alliance soldiers cluster at the Dustwallow Marsh border. Skip 97250 if you don't have a group.
02-12到30級.md:574｜交通步驟｜從十字路口沿西北大道往石爪山入口，先找貧瘠之地希雷斯·碎石（1413 35.26, 27.88）。｜Take the northwest road from the Crossroads toward Stonetalon. Stop for Seereth Stonebreak in the Barrens (1413 35.26, 27.88).

Learn the flight path from Tharm (1442 45.12, 59.84) and set your hearth with Innkeeper Jayka (1442 47.47, 62.13). Save it until the southern pass turn-ins are done.

02-12到30級.md:649｜交通步驟｜做完雷霆崖選做支線先從雷霆崖飛奧格瑪。從奧格瑪出城，到杜洛塔飛艇塔弗雷薩（1411 50.82, 13.54）處確認提里斯法林地線；搭到布瑞爾南塔，再走到幽暗城。接續往希爾斯布萊德丘陵 塔倫米爾。｜After the optional Thunder Bluff quests, fly to Orgrimmar. Board the Tirisfal zeppelin at Frezza's platform (1411 50.82, 13.54). Get off south of Brill, head to Undercity, then continue to Tarren Mill.
02-12到30級.md:651｜站內交通｜烈日石居首次開點和綁爐石；留爐石給南側山口交件後回烈日石居，續飛棘齒城。｜Unlock the flight path and set your Hearthstone on your first visit to Sun Rock Retreat. After the turn-in by the southern pass, hearth back to Sun Rock Retreat and fly to Ratchet.
02-12到30級.md:652｜站內取捨｜值得做。暗色湖撿蓋亞之種，石爪峰清塞納留斯的遺產。交回種子後，焦炭谷四項同趟做。千針石林 亂風崗路過大升降梯再交 5881。｜Pick up the Gaea Seeds at Mirkfallon Lake and do Cenarius' Legacy at Stonetalon Peak. Turn in the seeds, then do all four Charred Vale objectives on one loop. Turn in 5881 at the Great Lift on the way to Freewind Post.
02-12到30級.md:653｜站內取捨｜之後順路。1088 在梣谷 碎木崗哨打奧達努斯；1095～1096 只有日後會回狂風峭壁才續做，少一趟棘齒城往返。｜Kill Ordanus for 1088 on the Splintertree Post leg. Continue 1095–1096 only if you plan to revisit Windshear Crag. That saves a round trip to Ratchet.
02-12到30級.md:654｜站內取捨｜可跳過。貝瑟萊斯、土靈的覺醒要打精英；1058 要刷多種野獸且交件在南端，已有足夠材料才交。｜Besseleth and Earthen Arise involve elites. Quest 1058 sends you after several kinds of beasts and turns in at the south end. Turn it in only if you already have the materials.
02-12到30級.md:655｜站內提醒｜沒到25級時在焦炭谷外圍（約32, 64）補血怒鷹身人或火元素，先打單隻落單怪。｜Below level 25? Grind Bloodfury harpies or fire elementals on the edge of the Charred Vale (around 32, 64). Pull singles first.
02-12到30級.md:658｜練怪說明｜焦炭谷東側入口密度中等，普通怪；外圍先挑落單，留意巡邏，23 級即可補經驗。｜Moderate density of normal mobs at the Charred Vale's east entrance. Pick off singles outside, watch for patrols, and grind from 23.
02-12到30級.md:659｜練怪說明｜焦炭谷東側密度高，普通施法怪；利用山壁拉出營地，避免把巢群一起引來。可同時做焦炭谷任務。｜Dense normal casters in eastern Charred Vale. Use the cliff for line-of-sight pulls to avoid whole nests. Pair with the Charred Vale quests.
02-12到30級.md:665｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
02-12到30級.md:666｜標籤｜僅法師,薩滿,牧師,聖騎士,術士,德魯伊｜Mage/Shaman/Priest/Paladin/Warlock/Druid only
02-12到30級.md:668｜危險說明｜蛛網山地有精英蜘蛛貝瑟萊斯。先清周圍小蜘蛛，沒有隊伍可跳過。｜Besseleth is an elite spider near Webwinder Path. Clear the small spiders first. Skip it if you don't have a group.
02-12到30級.md:669｜危險說明｜滾岩峽谷洞裡路窄，開桶召出高戈羅克前先清洞口到桶邊的退路。｜The cave in Boulderslide Ravine is narrow. Clear a path from the entrance to the barrel before opening it to summon Goggeroc.
02-12到30級.md:677｜交通步驟｜石爪山脈 烈日石居已進幽暗城者從城內出發。塔倫米爾飛點已開可直飛；初訪先飛瑟伯切爾，再沿南路到銀松通往希爾斯布萊德的東側道路，過丘陵沿北岔路到塔倫米爾。瑟伯切爾未開點則由幽暗城先走地面。若中途加入仍在卡林多，才先到奧格瑪城外搭飛艇。｜Start from Undercity if you arrived from Sun Rock Retreat. Fly to Tarren Mill if unlocked. Otherwise fly to the Sepulcher, follow the south road east into Hillsbrad, then take the north fork. Walk from Undercity if needed. If still in Kalimdor, board the zeppelin outside Orgrimmar first.
02-12到30級.md:678｜交通步驟｜初訪找札瑞斯開塔倫米爾飛行點（1424 60.14, 18.62），並向旅店老闆沙恩綁爐石（1424 62.78, 19.03）。｜On arrival, learn Zarise's flight path (1424 60.14, 18.62) and set your hearth with Innkeeper Shay (1424 62.78, 19.03).

At level 29 with Freewind Post finished, go straight from Orgrimmar to Splintertree Post.
02-12到30級.md:751｜站內交通｜初訪先由瑟伯切爾步行至塔倫米爾；開札瑞斯飛點、向沙恩綁爐石。離站從幽暗城走到布瑞爾南塔搭奧格瑪線。｜Walk from the Sepulcher to Tarren Mill on your first visit. Unlock the flight path with Zarise and set your Hearthstone with Shay. To leave, walk from Undercity to the south tower outside Brill and take the Orgrimmar zeppelin.
02-12到30級.md:752｜站內取捨｜值得做｜496、501 在西面同一趟收集，搭配希爾斯布萊德之戰 527。交 527 後才出現 546，之後殺人類時一路收頭骨。｜Collect 496 and 501 on the west-side loop alongside Battle of Hillsbrad (527). Turn in 527 to unlock 546, then loot skulls as you kill humans.
02-12到30級.md:753｜站內取捨｜值得做｜98094、509 順路完成馬索吉周圍的兩個任務；若接了 1066，再到敦霍爾德外圍。Forever XP 走完才補滿顱骨，此處從 528 起就順手收。｜Do 98094 and 509 together around Deathstalker Masoj. If you have 1066, continue to the outskirts of Durnholde Keep. Start collecting skulls with 528 instead of waiting until after the loop as Forever XP does.
02-12到30級.md:754｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜若 567 缺目標且需為此折返，直接前往下一站。丹加洛克 541 怪多，獨行可留到等級更高；98095 西側山脊有高等山獅，趕路時略過整條支線。｜Skip 567 if the target is missing and you'd need to backtrack. Dun Garok is crowded for 541, so solo it later. Skip the 98095 chain if you're in a hurry. Higher-level mountain lions patrol its western ridge.
02-12到30級.md:755｜站內取捨｜之後順路｜若石爪山脈 烈日石居已接 1065，趁敦霍爾德行程完成 1066，帶 1067 給千針石林 亂風崗途經雷霆崖時交。｜If you accepted 1065 at Sun Rock Retreat, finish 1066 at Durnholde Keep. Turn in 1067 when you pass through Thunder Bluff on the way to Freewind Post.
02-12到30級.md:756｜站內取捨｜之後順路｜509 → 513 完成後，希爾斯布萊德丘陵 塔倫米爾可在幽暗城接 515，再回希爾斯布萊德海岸做。｜Finish 509 → 513, then pick up 515 in Undercity on the Tarren Mill leg and do it on the Hillsbrad coast.
02-12到30級.md:757｜站內取捨｜之後順路｜想現在救敦霍爾德城堡的兩名囚犯，可順做克魯斯克的拯救行動（The Rescue，498）；同地的通緝：辛迪加成員（WANTED: Syndicate Personnel，549）可一起做。奧特蘭克山脈收錄兩個任務的完整步驟。完成 498 後 29 級才接續秘密潛入（Infiltration，533）。｜Do The Rescue (498) at Durnholde Keep alongside WANTED: Syndicate Personnel (549). See the Alterac Mountains section for both quests. The Rescue unlocks Infiltration (533) at level 29.
02-12到30級.md:758｜站內提醒｜到 27 級即可轉千針石林 亂風崗短訪，再進梣谷。仍低於 27 級時先在西側希爾斯布萊德農場（約 33, 42）打農夫，或清敦霍爾德城堡外圍（約 77, 43）的普通辛迪加成員；有隊伍可再挑戰丹加洛克。｜At level 27, stop briefly at Freewind Post before Ashenvale. Below 27, grind farmers at Hillsbrad Fields (around 33, 42) or normal Syndicate mobs outside Durnholde Keep (around 77, 43). With a group, you can do Dun Garok.
02-12到30級.md:761｜練怪說明｜希爾斯布萊德農場東側密度中等，普通怪；避開農舍門口的群怪，可同步收人類顱骨。｜Moderate density of normal mobs on the east side of Hillsbrad Fields. Avoid packs by the farmhouse. Collect Hillsbrad Human Skulls as you go.
02-12到30級.md:762｜練怪說明｜農場中段密度中等，普通怪；沿田邊找巡邏步卒，避開同時站著議員與農夫的屋內。｜Moderate density of normal mobs in the middle of the farm. Look for footman patrols along the fields. Avoid houses with both a councilman and a farmer.
02-12到30級.md:763｜練怪說明｜敦霍爾德城堡北側的野外林地密度較低，普通怪；避開城堡人群，適合沿東側主線回程時補幾隻。｜Sparse normal mobs in the woods north of Durnholde Keep. Avoid the keep's packs. Pick up a few kills on your way back along the eastern route.
02-12到30級.md:769｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
02-12到30級.md:771｜標籤｜僅法師,薩滿,牧師,聖騎士,術士,德魯伊｜Mage/Shaman/Priest/Paladin/Warlock/Druid only
02-12到30級.md:772｜標籤｜僅盜賊｜Rogue only
02-12到30級.md:774｜危險說明｜丹加洛克的火槍手、牧師與巡山人會在階梯口互相支援。隊伍先清外圈，再進室內找上尉。｜Dun Garok riflemen, priests, and mountaineers assist each other at the stairs. Clear the outside with your group before going in for the captain.
02-12到30級.md:775｜危險說明｜放西峰藥劑瓶要經雪怪洞上方。遇到高等山獅就沿坡繞開，避免直接上陡坡。｜Take the path above the yeti cave to place the vial at the western peak. If you see higher-level mountain lions, go around along the slope instead of climbing straight up.
02-12到30級.md:783｜交通步驟｜在布瑞爾南方飛艇塔找薩匹塔（1420 60.74, 58.87，西平台）確認奧格瑪線。抵杜洛塔後進奧格瑪；有 1067 要交就先飛雷霆崖再飛陶拉祖，否則從奧格瑪飛陶拉祖。若仍在塔倫米爾才先飛幽暗城轉飛艇。｜Confirm the Orgrimmar zeppelin at Zapetta's west platform south of Brill (1420 60.74, 58.87). Enter Orgrimmar after landing. Fly through Thunder Bluff if turning in 1067. Otherwise fly directly to Camp Taurajo. If still in Tarren Mill, fly to Undercity first.

02-12到30級.md:786｜交通步驟｜沿貧瘠之地南路到大升降梯，與北側守衛交接。｜Take the southern Barrens road to the Great Lift and speak to the guard on the north side.
02-12到30級.md:787｜標籤｜若石爪山脈 烈日石居已接｜If accepted at Sun Rock Retreat
02-12到30級.md:788｜標籤｜若石爪山脈 烈日石居已接｜If accepted at Sun Rock Retreat
02-12到30級.md:792｜交通步驟｜搭大升降梯下到谷底，沿路東行至亂風崗，再搭亂風崗升降梯上台地，找奈瑟開飛行點（1441 45.14, 49.11）。本段不改爐石綁定。｜Take the Great Lift down. Follow the valley east and ride the Freewind Post lift up. Learn Nyse's flight path (1441 45.14, 49.11). Keep your hearth.
02-12到30級.md:796｜步驟說明｜同任務也可找勞恩·峭壁行者（46.14, 51.71）。｜Rau Cliffrunner also offers this quest (46.14, 51.71).
02-12到30級.md:799｜交通步驟｜先繞亂風崗北側半人馬營地，再去多恩和風蛇巢。｜Clear the centaur camps north of Freewind Post, then head to Dorn and the wind serpent nests.
02-12到30級.md:802｜步驟說明｜只從多恩傳送點正前方突出的木板跳，成功會傳回多恩。｜Jump from the plank directly in front of Dorn. A successful jump teleports you back.
02-12到30級.md:810｜交通步驟｜到西邊先清尖嘯鷹身人與補給箱，再沿谷底接風巢和白沙崗哨。｜Clear the screeching harpies and supply crates to the west. Follow the valley through Highperch to Whitereach Post.
02-12到30級.md:811｜步驟說明｜與 98070 同一區，從亂風崗往西，沿鷹身人坡地到洞內找可互動的補給箱。｜Head west from Freewind Post, up the harpy slope to the crate in 98070's cave.
02-12到30級.md:811｜步驟說明｜遊戲實測物件 670338 的三個採集點。｜Three in-game spawn points for object 670338.
02-12到30級.md:813｜步驟說明｜在洞底破壞補給箱才會刷出格林卡·血嘯，可先清洞。｜Clear the cave first. Break the crate at the back to spawn Grenka Bloodscreech.

02-12到30級.md:830｜交通步驟｜由西側坡道登黑雲峰撿密信，沿木橋向北。｜Take the western ramp up Darkcloud Pinnacle for the note, then cross the bridges north.
02-12到30級.md:831｜步驟說明｜從約 31.5, 36.7 的坡道走上木橋，再在三個營區找密信。｜Take the ramp at 31.5, 36.7 onto the bridge. Search all three camps for the notes.

02-12到30級.md:847｜交通步驟｜有神聖之火 5062 要交且雷霆崖飛點已開，先從亂風崗飛雷霆崖。若不去雷霆崖，略過下一個交件，直接走離站步驟。｜If you have Sacred Fire (5062) ready and Thunder Bluff unlocked, fly there from Freewind Post. Otherwise skip the next turn-in and continue.
02-12到30級.md:848｜標籤｜雷霆崖交件｜Turn in at Thunder Bluff
02-12到30級.md:848｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
02-12到30級.md:849｜交通步驟｜從目前的亂風崗或雷霆崖搭鳥。碎木崗哨飛點已開可直飛；初訪先飛十字路口，沿貧瘠之地北路越過莫爾杉壁壘，沿梣谷東側大道抵碎木崗哨。｜Fly from Freewind Post or Thunder Bluff. If Splintertree Post is locked, fly to the Crossroads and run north past Mor'shan Rampart into Ashenvale, then follow the east road to Splintertree.
02-12到30級.md:851｜站內交通｜奧格瑪進城飛陶拉祖；從貧瘠之地南端搭大升降梯下谷，亂風崗首次開點。雷霆崖有 5062 才繞。｜Fly from Orgrimmar to Camp Taurajo, then take the Great Lift at the south end of the Barrens. Unlock Freewind Post on your first visit. Detour to Thunder Bluff only if you have 5062.
02-12到30級.md:852｜站內取捨｜值得做。石爪山脈 烈日石居的信直接交大升降梯守衛。亂風崗西邊的補給箱、三種鷹身人和耐力試煉共用區域。｜Turn in the letter from Sun Rock Retreat to the guard at the Great Lift. Do the crate, three harpy types, and Test of Endurance together west of Freewind Post.
02-12到30級.md:853｜站內取捨｜之後順路。影片先講梣谷，再提中途跑一趟千針石林。這裡把亂風崗短訪排在梣谷主線前；閃光平原整圈留千針石林 閃光平原。｜The video introduces Ashenvale before mentioning the Thousand Needles detour. Stop at Freewind Post before the Ashenvale chain. Save the full Shimmering Flats loop for the later Thousand Needles visit.
02-12到30級.md:854｜站內取捨｜可跳過。拉克塔護送、豹籠和西側巡邏後續較費時；有隊友或正在經過目標再做。｜Skip the Lakota Windsong escort, the panther cage, and the western patrol follow-up unless you have help or are already passing the targets.
02-12到30級.md:855｜站內提醒｜若要打剃刀沼澤，入口在大升降梯前的貧瘠之地南端。未達本段預期進度，可以在亂風崗西側的尖嘯鷹身人坡地（約27, 51）補經驗。｜The Razorfen Kraul entrance is at the south end of the Barrens before the Great Lift. If you're behind on XP, grind the Screeching harpies west of Freewind Post (around 27, 51).
02-12到30級.md:858｜練怪說明｜亂風崗西側谷地密度中等，普通怪；在谷底逐隻打，不必繞到鷹身人營地。｜Moderate density of normal mobs in the valley west of Freewind Post. Pull singles on the valley floor and skip the harpy camp detour.
02-12到30級.md:859｜練怪說明｜西側鷹身人坡地密度中等，普通怪；營地同時有其他鷹身人，沿坡緣挑落單，可順做尖嘯鷹身人任務。｜Moderate density of normal mobs on the western harpy slopes. Pick off lone harpies along the edge while doing the harpy quest.
02-12到30級.md:865｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
02-12到30級.md:866｜標籤｜僅法師,薩滿,牧師,聖騎士,術士,德魯伊｜Mage/Shaman/Priest/Paladin/Warlock/Druid only
02-12到30級.md:869｜危險說明｜升降梯落差會致死。過亂風崗橋面或北端升降梯時先等平台到位。｜The elevator drop is fatal. Wait for the platform before crossing the Freewind Post bridge or using the northern lift.
02-12到30級.md:870｜危險說明｜鷹身人洞穴開補給箱會觸發敵人。清掉箱旁小怪並留好出口後再開。｜Opening the crate in the harpy cave spawns enemies. Clear nearby mobs and make sure you have a way out first.
02-12到30級.md:878｜交通步驟｜抵達碎木崗哨，找烏爾格拉開飛行點（1440 73.18, 61.59）。保留塔倫米爾爐石給東部王國回程；已綁別處且想在梣谷用，找旅店老闆凱利斯克（1440 73.99, 60.65）。｜Learn the flight path from Vhulgra at Splintertree Post (1440 73.18, 61.59). Keep your Tarren Mill hearth for the return. If you want to bind in Ashenvale, see Innkeeper Kaylisk (1440 73.99, 60.65).
02-12到30級.md:879｜標籤｜若貧瘠之地 棘齒城與陶拉祖營地已接｜If accepted on the Ratchet/Camp Taurajo leg

02-12到30級.md:887｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional

02-12到30級.md:889｜步驟說明｜殺沙普塔隆並拾取爪子，需點背包中的爪子接任務。｜Kill Sharptalon and right-click the claw in your bags to start the quest.

Hearth instead if bound there and ready. If you skipped the escort and have no turn-ins, fly straight to your next stop from Zoram'gar.

02-12到30級.md:963｜交通步驟｜剛在北側交完戰歌報告者回十字路口飛奧格瑪。其餘從目前所在的碎木崗哨、佐拉姆加前哨站或烈日石居飛奧格瑪。訓練 30 級技能後，在弗雷薩（1411 50.82, 13.54）一側搭提里斯法林地線，在布瑞爾下艇後往幽暗城。只有確定不用進幽暗城交接或訓練，才直接用保留在塔倫米爾的爐石。｜After turning in the Warsong Reports, return to the Crossroads and fly to Orgrimmar. Otherwise fly from Splintertree Post, Zoram'gar Outpost or Sun Rock Retreat. Train level 30 skills, then take the Tirisfal zeppelin from Frezza's platform (1411 50.82, 13.54). Get off at Brill and head to Undercity. Hearth to Tarren Mill only if you have no Undercity quests or training.
02-12到30級.md:965｜站內交通｜先開碎木崗哨，再開佐拉姆加；依待交任務選碎木崗哨、烈日石居、十字路口，或從佐拉姆加直接飛奧格瑪。保留塔倫米爾爐石。｜Unlock Splintertree Post, then Zoram'gar Outpost. Fly to Splintertree, Sun Rock Retreat, or the Crossroads for outstanding turn-ins, or go straight to Orgrimmar from Zoram'gar. Keep your Hearthstone set to Tarren Mill.
02-12到30級.md:966｜站內取捨｜值得做。碎木崗哨南側先驅者、西南湖元素、北側薩特各做一圈；佐拉姆加的熊怪與洞穴符咒一起解。｜Do three loops from Splintertree Post: outrunners to the south, lake elementals to the southwest, and satyrs to the north. Do the furbolgs and cave charms together at Zoram'gar.
02-12到30級.md:967｜站內取捨｜可跳過。三隻獵物會巡邏，只在順路遇到時打。散頁沒集滿可留到日後交易，不必反覆刷。｜The three beasts patrol. Kill them only if you come across them. Trade for missing pages later instead of farming them.
02-12到30級.md:968｜站內取捨｜之後順路。29級後若本來就要跑十字路口和奧格瑪，可先接 1145，交奧格瑪後接 1146。到千針石林 閃光平原交 1146 才能接 1147；與本段交通不順路就略過。｜At level 29, take 1145 if you're already headed to the Crossroads and Orgrimmar. Turn it in at Orgrimmar for 1146, then turn in 1146 at the Shimmering Flats to unlock 1147. Skip the chain if it's out of the way.
02-12到30級.md:969｜站內提醒｜未到30級優先補薩特（約67, 57）或薊皮熊怪（約32, 38）。有隊伍可在佐拉姆海岸下黑暗深淵；若隊友未到齊，先繼續本段。｜Below level 30? Grind satyrs (around 67, 57) or Thistlefur furbolgs (around 32, 38). Run Blackfathom Deeps on the Zoram Strand if your group is ready. Otherwise, keep questing.
02-12到30級.md:972｜練怪說明｜魔草薩特營地外側密度中等，普通怪；同類巡邏與其他薩特會靠近，沿營地邊緣清，能順便收薩特之角。｜Moderate density of normal mobs outside the satyr camp. Clear along the edge, watch for patrols and nearby satyrs, and collect Satyr Horns.
02-12到30級.md:973｜練怪說明｜碎木崗哨北側林地密度中等，普通怪；用開闊地逐隻打，離飛行點近，適合不想進薩特營地時補經驗。｜Moderate density of normal mobs in the woods north of Splintertree Post. Pull singles in the open near the flight path if skipping the satyr camp.
02-12到30級.md:974｜練怪說明｜薩維亞營地密度中等，普通怪；留意隱匿與巡邏怪，先清外圍再走內側。適合 29 級最後一段，亦可順手補薩特之角。｜Moderate density of normal mobs at Xavian. Watch for stealthed mobs and patrols. Clear outside first and finish level 29 while collecting Satyr Horns.
02-12到30級.md:980｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
02-12到30級.md:984｜危險說明｜阿斯特蘭納是聯盟城鎮，路邊有 40 級哨兵。去佐拉姆加時從鎮外繞過。｜Astranaar is an Alliance town with level 40 sentinels by the road. Go around it on the way to Zoram'gar.

03-30到45級.md:3｜粗體註記｜34 級從荊棘谷 格羅姆高與藏寶海灣開始。｜At level 34, start with Grom'gol and Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.
03-30到45級.md:25｜交通步驟｜梣谷 碎木崗哨已搭飛艇者從布瑞爾南塔進幽暗城；由卡林多中途加入時才飛奧格瑪、補技能再搭飛艇。尚未開幽暗城飛行點，找邁克爾·加勒特（1458 63.25, 48.56）。｜If you took the zeppelin after Splintertree Post, head from Brill's south tower to Undercity. If joining the route in Kalimdor, fly to Orgrimmar, train, then take the zeppelin. Unlock Undercity's flight path with Michael Garrett (1458 63.25, 48.56) if needed.

03-30到45級.md:28｜交通步驟｜開塔倫米爾飛行點 60.14, 18.62，綁爐石。｜Learn the Tarren Mill flight path (60.14, 18.62) and set your hearth.
03-30到45級.md:35｜粗體註記｜丘陵洞穴 → 達拉然營地｜Foothill Caverns → Dalaran camp

03-30到45級.md:65｜交通步驟｜出塔倫米爾往東，過索拉丁之牆進阿拉希高地。｜Head east from Tarren Mill through Thoradin's Wall into Arathi Highlands.
03-30到45級.md:67｜站內取捨｜未到 31 級可在丘陵洞穴打雪怪補差額。｜Below level 31? Grind yetis in the Hillsbrad cave.
03-30到45級.md:68｜站內取捨｜達拉然巡邏隊與地縛護腕要交前一輪才開，集中跑西側。城市鑰匙可順手接，達拉然城副本可跳過。｜Turn in the previous round to unlock the Dalaran patrol and Bracers of Binding quests. Do them on the west-side loop. Pick up the city key quest if passing, and skip City of Dalaran if you prefer.
03-30到45級.md:69｜站內取捨｜秘密潛入 533 要先完成拯救行動 498，留奧特蘭克山脈再接。未做過苦楚藥劑前段就跳過沿海分支。｜Finish The Rescue (498) to unlock Infiltration (533). Save it for Alterac Mountains. Skip the coastal Elixir of Agony branch if you haven't done the earlier quests.
03-30到45級.md:70｜站內提醒｜赫爾庫拉的墓地靠近聯盟南海鎮，從城外接近。｜Helcular's grave is near the Alliance town of Southshore. Approach from outside town.
03-30到45級.md:71｜站內提醒｜30–32 級帶可與阿拉希高地 落錘鎮合併累積。缺經驗先打希爾斯布萊德西側山腳的普通雪怪（約 45, 29），也可到落錘鎮再補。｜Combine the level 30–32 leg with Hammerfall in Arathi Highlands. Need XP? Grind normal yetis in the west Hillsbrad foothills (around 45, 29), or catch up at Hammerfall.
03-30到45級.md:73｜練怪說明｜西側雪人洞外坡地，密度高、普通怪。先在洞外逐隻打，避開洞口重疊怪點，30 級即可開始。｜Dense normal mobs on the slope outside the western yeti cave. Pull singles away from the entrance. Start at level 30.
03-30到45級.md:74｜練怪說明｜雪人洞口附近，密度高、普通怪。與洞穴雪人混在一起，先清外圈再補 31–32 級經驗。｜Dense normal mobs mixed with Cave Yetis at the cave entrance. Clear the outer edge first for level 31–32 XP.
03-30到45級.md:79｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
03-30到45級.md:81｜標籤｜僅法師,薩滿,牧師,聖騎士,術士,德魯伊｜Mage/Shaman/Priest/Paladin/Warlock/Druid only
03-30到45級.md:82｜標籤｜僅盜賊｜Rogue only
03-30到45級.md:84｜危險說明｜南海鎮有 55 級聯盟衛兵。交赫爾庫拉的復仇時從鎮外到墓地，避免從鎮中穿行。｜Level 55 Alliance guards patrol Southshore. Go around town to reach the grave for Helcular's Revenge.
03-30到45級.md:85｜危險說明｜雪人洞入口刷新集中。找赫爾庫拉魔棒可先清外圍，進洞前留一條撤退線。｜Respawns are dense at the yeti cave entrance. Clear the outside while looking for Helcular's Rod. Keep an escape route before going in.
03-30到45級.md:95｜標籤｜有前置｜Has prerequisite
03-30到45級.md:96｜交通步驟｜抵達落錘鎮後開尤爾達飛行點 73.02, 32.70。｜Learn Urda's flight path on arrival in Hammerfall (73.02, 32.70).

03-30到45級.md:119｜步驟說明｜先在同一位醫生交 97539，才會出現補給任務。｜Turn in 97539 to the same doctor to unlock the supply quest.
03-30到45級.md:120｜標籤｜有前置｜Has prerequisite
03-30到45級.md:121｜標籤｜有前置｜Has prerequisite
03-30到45級.md:122｜交通步驟｜飛幽暗城整理技能與背包，到布瑞爾南側飛艇塔搭奧格瑪線。到奧格瑪後，已開亂風崗就直接選該飛點；未開則飛陶拉祖營地，沿南路搭大升降梯下谷底，再往東搭亂風崗升降梯。｜Fly to Undercity to train and clear your bags. Take the zeppelin south of Brill to Orgrimmar. Fly to Freewind Post if unlocked. Otherwise fly to Camp Taurajo, take the Great Lift down and ride the Freewind Post lift up.
03-30到45級.md:124｜站內取捨｜先清落錘鎮近郊迅猛龍、辛迪加與東南邊枯木。已到 32 級時，進階的 678、701 留阿拉希高地 落錘鎮。｜Clear the raptors and Syndicate mobs near Hammerfall and the Witherbark mobs to the southeast. If you're already level 32, save the later 678 and 701 quests for the return visit.
03-30到45級.md:125｜站內取捨｜病房重新補給與蛛絲縫線是永恆新增。先交 97539 才接 92519。已到 32 級可留第二趟。｜Ward Restocking and Silky Sutures are new in Forever. Turn in 97539 to unlock 92519. Save them for the next visit if you're already level 32.
03-30到45級.md:126｜站內提醒｜前往千針石林前若未到 32，從落錘鎮到枯木村外圍（約 68, 69）打普通枯木食人妖，避免深入多怪的營地。｜Below level 32? Grind normal Witherbark trolls outside the village (around 68, 69) before leaving for Thousand Needles. Stay out of the crowded camp.
03-30到45級.md:128｜練怪說明｜枯木村外圍，密度高、普通遠程怪。從坡緣拉出單隻，靠近原任務區，適合補到 32 級。｜Dense normal ranged mobs outside Witherbark Village. Pull singles from the slope near the quest area. Grind to 32.
03-30到45級.md:129｜練怪說明｜枯木村東側，密度高、普通施法怪。可打斷治療並沿屋外清，留意附近更高等的枯木獵頭者。｜Dense normal casters in eastern Witherbark Village. Interrupt heals and clear around the buildings. Watch for higher-level Witherbark Headhunters.
03-30到45級.md:135｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
03-30到45級.md:137｜危險說明｜枯木村屋內的巫醫會補血，屋前有較高等的獵頭者。優先沿田地邊緣清，留打斷。｜Witherbark Witch Doctors heal inside the huts, and higher-level Headhunters stand outside. Clear from the edge of the fields and save an interrupt.
03-30到45級.md:147｜交通步驟｜先開亂風崗奈瑟飛行點 45.14, 49.11，再沿路向東南進閃光平原。｜Learn Nyse's Freewind Post flight path (45.14, 49.11), then follow the road southeast into the Shimmering Flats.

03-30到45級.md:175｜步驟說明｜打 1147 時掉破碎的異種蠍殼，撿到後要點物品才會接到任務。｜Loot the Cracked Silithid Carapace during 1147. Right-click it to start the quest.

03-30到45級.md:179｜交通步驟｜在閃光平原收完任務，沿谷底原路回亂風崗，搭升降梯上飛點，再飛石爪山脈烈日石居。從烈日石居往西南穿過焦炭谷進淒涼之地。｜After the Shimmering Flats, retrace your route and take the lift up to Freewind Post. Fly to Sun Rock Retreat, then go southwest through the Charred Vale into Desolace.
03-30到45級.md:181｜站內取捨｜閃光平原六個接任務點相近，先接齊再繞一圈。車手送件 1111 只在下一趟經棘齒城時做。交完可向碼頭管理員迪茲維格接給克拉維爾的零件（1112），留給下次經千針石林 閃光平原賽道時交。｜Pick up all six Shimmering Flats quests before making a loop. Do the 1111 delivery on your next Ratchet visit. Then take Parts for Kravel (1112) from Wharfmaster Dizzywig and turn it in at the racetrack on your next Shimmering Flats visit.
03-30到45級.md:182｜站內取捨｜保留流放者馬特克 1106 到荒蕪之地 卡加斯，兄弟 5361 到淒涼之地 葬影村，奈辛瓦里 5762 到荊棘谷 格羅姆高與藏寶海灣。｜Save Martek the Exiled (1106) for Kargath, Brother (5361) for Shadowprey Village, and Nesingwary (5762) for the Grom'gol and Booty Bay leg.
03-30到45級.md:183｜站內提醒｜若 1146 尚未交，略過 1147。影片提醒蟲洞內怪物等級高，打到洞口一帶就回頭。1148 若完成，留塵泥沼澤 蕨牆村途經十字路口時交。｜Skip 1147 if you haven't turned in 1146. The video warns about higher-level mobs deep in the hive. Kill near the entrance, then leave. If you finish 1148, turn it in at the Crossroads on the way to Brackenwall Village.
03-30到45級.md:184｜站內提醒｜32–34 級帶可與淒涼之地 葬影村合併累積。閃光平原未到 33 可在賽道南側（約 76, 85）打烏龜、禿鷲與蠍子，再去淒涼之地。｜Combine this level 32–34 leg with Shadowprey Village. Below level 33? Grind turtles, vultures, and scorpids south of the racetrack (around 76, 85), then head to Desolace.
03-30到45級.md:186｜練怪說明｜閃光平原賽道南側，密度高、普通怪。地勢開闊，可沿鹽地逐隻挑選，適合 32 級補經驗。｜Dense normal mobs south of the Shimmering Flats racetrack. Pick off singles across the open salt flats at level 32.
03-30到45級.md:187｜練怪說明｜同一片鹽地往東，密度中等、普通怪。與蜥蜴輪打，可順便收鹽殼龜殼。｜Moderate density of normal mobs farther east on the salt flats. Alternate with lizards and collect Hardened Tortoise Shells.
03-30到45級.md:188｜練怪說明｜賽道東南，密度中等、普通怪。沿地表輪打即可，留意近處其他鹽地野獸；有蠍毒任務可一起收。｜Moderate density of normal mobs southeast of the racetrack. Circle aboveground and watch for other beasts. Collect Salty Scorpid Venom if needed.
03-30到45級.md:194｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
03-30到45級.md:195｜標籤｜僅法師,薩滿,牧師,聖騎士,術士,德魯伊｜Mage/Shaman/Priest/Paladin/Warlock/Druid only
03-30到45級.md:198｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
03-30到45級.md:200｜危險說明｜閃光平原蟲洞深處的異種蠍密集且等級較高。完成瘋狂的蟲群後從洞口原路退出。｜Higher-level silithid pack the back of the Shimmering Flats hive. After The Swarm Grows, retrace your steps to the entrance.
03-30到45級.md:214｜標籤｜有前置｜Has prerequisite
03-30到45級.md:215｜標籤｜有前置｜Has prerequisite
03-30到45級.md:219｜交通步驟｜沿南路過吉爾吉斯村，到葬影村開薩隆飛行點 21.60, 74.13，綁爐石。｜Follow the south road past the Gelkis village. Learn Thalon's flight path (21.60, 74.13) and set your hearth in Shadowprey Village.
03-30到45級.md:226｜粗體註記｜海岸 → 雷斧堡壘 → 東側薩特｜Coast → Thunder Axe Fortress → satyrs to the east

03-30到45級.md:260｜步驟說明｜交完大道劫匪原地接，留到荊棘谷 藏寶海灣的旅店交。｜Pick up here after Highway Robbery. Turn it in at the Booty Bay inn.
03-30到45級.md:262｜粗體註記｜西岸納迦與海島，完成後回葬影村｜West coast naga and islands, then return to Shadowprey Village
03-30到45級.md:263｜步驟說明｜到葬影村找吉納澤林對話拿兩條魚，和西岸行程一起跑。｜Talk to Jinar'Zillen in Shadowprey Village for two fish. Pair with west coast quests.

03-30到45級.md:277｜交通步驟｜爐石回葬影村。｜Hearth to Shadowprey Village.
03-30到45級.md:282｜交通步驟｜從葬影村飛奧格瑪，出城到杜洛塔飛艇塔（1411 50.80, 13.60），搭往荊棘谷 格羅姆高的飛艇。｜Fly from Shadowprey Village to Orgrimmar. At the Durotar zeppelin tower (1411 50.80, 13.60), board for Grom'gol in Stranglethorn Vale.
03-30到45級.md:284｜站內取捨｜大道劫匪與集骨者一起跑，順手點營火再去比布里的小屋。三段皆為任務等級 40、最低 30 級，亡命之徒留到荊棘谷 藏寶海灣交。｜Do Highway Robbery and Bone Collector together. Click the campfire on the way to Bibbly's hut. All three quests are level 40 and require level 30. Save the On the Lam turn-in for Booty Bay.
03-30到45級.md:285｜站內取捨｜吉爾吉斯線 1368／1370 順南路。已選瑪格拉姆或聲望相反時，跳過這兩步與淒涼之地 葬影村的吉爾吉斯後續。｜Do Gelkis quests 1368 and 1370 on the south road. Skip both and the Shadowprey Village Gelkis follow-ups if you chose the Magram or have the wrong reputation.
03-30到45級.md:286｜站內取捨｜葬影村去西岸時一起做兩個水域任務與上古之書。雷斧堡壘先打聖光節杖與埃魯索斯之手，若進度不足再到第二趟補交。｜On the Shadowprey Village coast loop, do both water quests and the ancient book together. At Thunder Axe Fortress, do the Sceptre of Light and Hand of Iruxos first. If short on XP, turn in on your second visit.
03-30到45級.md:287｜站內取捨｜沒遇到車隊就直接走，不原地等護送。保留荊棘谷狩獵 5763 到下一站。｜Move on if the caravan isn't there. Don't wait for the escort. Save 5763 for the next stop in Stranglethorn Vale.
03-30到45級.md:288｜站內提醒｜前往荊棘谷前若未到 34，在科多墓地周圍打普通半人馬（約 56, 60–68），或在西岸打滑刃納迦（35.91, 28.84）。｜Below level 34? Grind normal centaurs around the Kodo Graveyard (around 56, 60–68) or Slitherblade naga on the west coast (35.91, 28.84) before leaving for Stranglethorn Vale.
03-30到45級.md:290｜練怪說明｜科多墓地東側外圍，密度較低、普通怪。留意其他腐化鳥，離墓地任務近，適合順手補少量經驗。｜Sparse normal mobs east of the Kodo Graveyard. Watch for other carrion birds. Pick up a little XP on the graveyard quest loop.
03-30到45級.md:291｜練怪說明｜西岸水邊，密度高、普通怪。沿岸挑落單，留意同區巫女，西岸任務可以一起清。｜Dense normal mobs by the west coast. Pick off singles and watch for nearby sorceresses. Pair with the other coastal quests.
03-30到45級.md:292｜練怪說明｜西岸納迦區南端，密度中等、普通施法怪。把怪拉向岸邊再打，避免水下龍蝦人連帶入戰。｜Moderate density of normal casters at the south end of the west-coast naga area. Pull them onto shore to avoid makrura adds.
03-30到45級.md:298｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
03-30到45級.md:300｜危險說明｜西岸納迦點近水下甲殼蝦人。先把施法怪拉到沙灘，避免水下同時進兩群。｜The west-coast naga are near underwater makrura. Pull casters onto the beach to avoid aggroing both packs underwater.
03-30到45級.md:308｜交通步驟｜在奧格瑪城外飛艇塔搭格羅姆高線，抵達後開塞斯塔飛行點 32.54, 29.35。已在荊棘谷者直接到營地。｜Take the Grom'gol zeppelin from outside Orgrimmar. Learn Thysta's flight path (32.54, 29.35). If you're already in Stranglethorn Vale, head straight to camp.

03-30到45級.md:316｜步驟說明｜石板在水下遺跡外牆，可從外側游過去，避開巡邏的精英魚人。｜Swim to the slab on the outer wall of the sunken ruins. Avoid elite murloc patrols.
03-30到45級.md:318｜標籤｜前置：暗礁海 629｜Prereq: The Vile Reef (629)
03-30到45級.md:318｜步驟說明｜水中的敵人（95773）要先交這個才接得到。｜Turn this in to unlock Enemies in the Water (95773).
03-30到45級.md:319｜交通步驟｜已開藏寶海灣飛點就從格羅姆高飛過去。初訪沿荊棘谷南向大路到藏寶海灣，開格林戈飛行點 26.87, 77.10。接完第一輪任務再飛回格羅姆高。｜Fly from Grom'gol to Booty Bay if unlocked. Otherwise follow the road south and learn Gringer's flight path (26.87, 77.10). Pick up the first batch before flying back.

03-30到45級.md:442｜標籤｜36級起｜Lv 36+
03-30到45級.md:443｜交通步驟｜格羅姆高搭飛艇回奧格瑪，再飛十字路口或陶拉祖營地。｜Take the zeppelin from Grom'gol to Orgrimmar, then fly to the Crossroads or Camp Taurajo.
03-30到45級.md:445｜站內取捨｜藏寶海灣初訪就交亡命之徒並買酒完成「你在想櫻桃酒嗎？」。之後會去阿拉希高地東南離岸島，再接後續盜卻無道。｜Turn in On the Lam on your first Booty Bay visit. Buy the wine for Cherry for Your Thoughts? Take the follow-up when you visit the island off southeastern Arathi Highlands.
03-30到45級.md:446｜站內取捨｜祖昆達找得到吉米克斯才跑鑰匙與護送，鑰匙與遭竊貨物同區。已有人護送可直接繼續主線。[台服任務紀錄](https://wowamobi.com/quests/97329)｜Do the keys and escort only if you find Gimix at Zul'Kunda. The keys and Stolen Shipment are in the same area. If another player is escorting him, keep questing. [zhTW quest record](https://wowamobi.com/quests/97329)
03-30到45級.md:447｜站內取捨｜藏寶海灣第 1 次到訪主要開飛點並接任務；約 35 級只交第一批：189、201、575、605、213，及已做完的 97328／97331。交 575 和 605 才開 577 和 600。｜On your first Booty Bay visit, unlock the flight path and pick up quests. At around level 35, turn in only 189, 201, 575, 605, and 213, plus 97328 and 97331 if done. Turn in 575 and 605 to unlock 577 and 600.
03-30到45級.md:448｜站內取捨｜先別交 600 風險投資公司（Venture Company Mining）、628 刨花皮靴（Excelsior），留荊棘谷 藏寶海灣併南谷回收。577 完成後留荊棘谷 藏寶海灣先交，再接 628。｜Save Venture Company Mining (600) and Excelsior (628) for the Booty Bay return after the southern loop. Turn in 577 first on that visit to unlock 628.
03-30到45級.md:449｜站內取捨｜42 級回訪才排血帆 595→597→599→604→608，併 576／587、621、606→607→609。先別排 348／349 熱疫、594→630 瓶中信、8551 船長的箱子、580 酒和 3721 OOX，見荊棘谷 藏寶海灣的 45 級後清單。影片的分次交原則保留，具體 ID 為路線配置。｜Save Bloodsail 595 → 597 → 599 → 604 → 608 for the level 42 return. Pair with 576, 587, 621, and 606 → 607 → 609. Save 348/349, 594 → 630, 8551, 580, and 3721 for the level 45+ Booty Bay list. Follow the video's staggered turn-ins and use these quest IDs to plan them.
03-30到45級.md:450｜站內取捨｜先把獵龍解到 195，再和 568 一起打鞭尾迅猛龍。605 先打北邊的晶脊蜥蜴，第一趟無須繞去南谷。｜Advance Raptor Mastery to 195, then kill lashtail raptors for it and 568 together. Kill the northern Crystal Spine Basilisks for 605. Skip the southern detour on this visit.
03-30到45級.md:451｜站內取捨｜若 34 級空白起步，先做三條獵線頭兩輪，並做格羅姆高與血頂食人妖群。深喉獵豹同時解 192／570，普通辛達爾 188 同圈處理。585 的三件戰利品留荊棘谷 藏寶海灣和裂骨項鏈一起做。荊棘谷的青山 338–342 有散頁再交。｜Starting fresh at 34? Do the first two rounds of all three hunting chains, plus the Grom'gol and Bloodscalp quests. Shadowmaw Panthers count for 192 and 570. Kill Sin'Dall for 188 on the same loop. Save the three trophies for 585 and the Split Bone Necklace for Booty Bay. Turn in The Green Hills of Stranglethorn (338–342) if you have the pages.
03-30到45級.md:452｜站內提醒｜35 級可組沉沒之城（The Drowned City，35–40）。先確認隊伍與相關任務，從格羅姆高西邊海底入場。｜Run The Drowned City at level 35 with a group (recommended 35–40). Check your quests first. Enter underwater west of Grom'gol.
03-30到45級.md:453｜站內提醒｜約 34–35 級先在北谷打血頂食人妖（29.76, 21.62）；36 級後轉格羅姆高東南的巨魔營地（35.55, 30.92），缺多少就在這裡補到 37 再搭飛艇。先交營地裡已完成的任務。｜At around 34–35, grind Bloodscalp trolls in northern Stranglethorn (29.76, 21.62). From 36, switch to the ogre camp southeast of Grom'gol (35.55, 30.92). Grind to 37 as needed and turn in any finished quests at the camp before boarding the zeppelin.
03-30到45級.md:455｜練怪說明｜北谷血頂遺跡，密度中等、普通怪。沿外牆挑落單，留意附近的血頂薩滿，適合 34 級補經驗。可同趟收旋風武器任務用的血頂獠牙【僅戰士】。｜Moderate density of normal mobs at the northern Bloodscalp ruins. Pull singles along the outer walls and watch for shamans. Grind at 34. Warriors can collect Bloodscalp Tusks for their Whirlwind weapon.
03-30到45級.md:455｜標籤｜僅戰士｜Warrior only
03-30到45級.md:456｜練怪說明｜格羅姆高以北的林地，密度高、普通怪。沿路找單隻，避開下水後的鹽鱗精英，可順做迅猛龍獵殺。｜Dense normal mobs in the woods north of Grom'gol. Pick off singles along the road and avoid elite Saltscale mobs in the water. Pair with raptor hunting.
03-30到45級.md:457｜練怪說明｜格羅姆高東南巨魔營地外圍，密度中等、普通怪。避開巫醫與稀有怪羅洛克，36 級後可就近補到 37。｜Moderate density of normal mobs outside the ogre camp southeast of Grom'gol. Avoid witch doctors and rare Roloch. Grind from level 36 to 37.
03-30到45級.md:463｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
03-30到45級.md:468｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
03-30到45級.md:470｜危險說明｜暗礁海遺跡有鹽鱗精英。從海面下潛貼外牆找石板，留足呼吸時間折返。｜Elite Saltscale murlocs guard the ruins. Dive from the surface and follow the outer wall to the tablet. Leave enough air for the return swim.
03-30到45級.md:471｜危險說明｜祖昆達廢墟的吉米克斯護送會走過巡邏路。接護送前先清營地外側。｜Gimix's escort through the Ruins of Zul'Kunda crosses a patrol route. Clear the outside of the camp before starting.
03-30到45級.md:479｜標籤｜有前置且已完成｜Has prerequisite
03-30到45級.md:479｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
03-30到45級.md:480｜交通步驟｜從陶拉祖營地往東進塵泥沼澤，先停在路邊燒毀的旅店。｜Head east from Camp Taurajo into Dustwallow Marsh. Stop first at the burned-out inn by the road.
03-30到45級.md:484｜交通步驟｜蕨牆村｜Brackenwall Village
03-30到45級.md:484｜步驟說明｜向沙爾迪開飛行點。｜Unlock the flight path with Shardi.
03-30到45級.md:485｜交通步驟｜保留先前綁在淒涼之地 葬影村的爐石，留給下一站回程。｜Keep your Shadowprey Village hearth for the return on the next leg.
03-30到45級.md:505｜粗體註記｜北路護送 → 水光莊園 → 海邊｜North road escort → Swamplight Manor → coast
03-30到45級.md:507｜標籤｜順路到棘齒城才交｜Turn in when passing Ratchet

03-30到45級.md:538｜交通步驟｜回蕨牆村，在飛行地圖選葬影村。若未顯示可達航線，就先飛十字路口轉乘。保留爐石給淒涼之地 葬影村集會所回程。｜Return to Brackenwall Village and fly to Shadowprey Village. If the route is unavailable, change flights at the Crossroads. Save your hearth for the return from Mannoroc Coven.
03-30到45級.md:540｜站內取捨｜黑色盾牌 1251、可疑的蹄印 1268、雷瑟上尉 1269 三件在同一座燒毀旅店。先接齊再進村。｜Pick up The Black Shield (1251), Suspicious Hoofprints (1268), and Lieutenant Paval Reethe (1269) at the same burned inn before entering the village.
03-30到45級.md:541｜站內取捨｜舒心草帶 3 份再出城。月鋼寬劍已有就交，特地買或鍛造會增加折返。1270 在棘齒城交，當趟不路過就保留或略過。｜Bring 3 Soothing Spices before leaving town. Turn in the Moonsteel Broadsword if you have one. Buying or crafting it adds a detour. Turn in 1270 at Ratchet if passing, or save or skip it.
03-30到45級.md:542｜站內可跳過｜挑戰莫格穆洛克（Challenge Overlord Mok’Morokk）1173。影片建議略過。這條線前幾個任務最低 38 級，37 級到站先走北沼澤群。｜Skip Challenge Overlord Mok'Morokk (1173), as the video suggests. The first few quests in that chain require level 38. Start in the northern marsh if you arrive at 37.
03-30到45級.md:543｜站內之後順路｜若接了 1240，可在荊棘谷 藏寶海灣交給格羅姆高的肯維雷。後續 1261 要回蕨牆村，只有再回塵泥時才續做。黑色盾牌 1276 留雷霆崖順路。｜If you have 1240, turn it in to Kin'weelay on the Booty Bay leg. Continue 1261 only if you'll return to Brackenwall Village. Save The Black Shield (1276) for Thunder Bluff.
03-30到45級.md:544｜站內提醒｜蕨牆村和淒涼之地 葬影村共用 37→38 的經驗帶。若淒涼回訪的任務已交過，可在塵泥北邊打普通蛛怪和迅猛龍，靠塵泥沼澤 蕨牆村的北沼澤任務怪點補到 38。｜Brackenwall Village and the Shadowprey Village return together cover levels 37–38. If you've already turned in the Desolace quests, grind normal spiders and raptors in northern Dustwallow Marsh until 38.
03-30到45級.md:546｜練怪說明｜北沼澤枯藤地，密度高、普通怪。與其他枯藤怪混雜，沿陸地逐隻清，等級貼近離站門檻。｜Dense normal mobs in the northern swamp among the other Withervine mobs. Pull singles from dry ground to reach the next stop's level.
03-30到45級.md:547｜練怪說明｜北沼澤東側，密度中等、普通怪。留意毒傷和迅猛龍巡邏，枯藤區有人清怪時可換點。｜Moderate density of normal mobs in the eastern part of the northern swamp. Watch for poison damage and raptor patrols. Move here if Withervine mobs are being farmed.
03-30到45級.md:548｜練怪說明｜北沼澤林緣，密度高、普通怪。旁邊有鱷魚與其他迅猛龍，沿岸挑單隻，打到 38 即可離站。｜Dense normal mobs along the northern swamp's treeline. Pull singles along the shore and watch for crocolisks and other raptors. Leave at 38.
03-30到45級.md:553｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
03-30到45級.md:554｜標籤｜僅法師,薩滿,牧師,聖騎士,術士,德魯伊｜Mage/Shaman/Priest/Paladin/Warlock/Druid only
03-30到45級.md:556｜危險說明｜北沼澤的毒蜘蛛與迅猛龍巡邏路重疊。沿外側挑單隻，避開草叢內的交會點。｜Poisonous spiders and raptor patrols overlap in the northern marsh. Pull singles from the edge and avoid the spots where patrols meet in the brush.
03-30到45級.md:564｜標籤｜有前置｜Has prerequisite
03-30到45級.md:565｜交通步驟｜從葬影村出發，先走幽靈崗哨，再沿南路往瑪諾洛克集會所。｜From Shadowprey Village, go to Ghost Walker Post first. Follow the south road to Mannoroc Coven.
03-30到45級.md:567｜標籤｜吉爾吉斯線、有前置｜Gelkis chain with a prerequisite
03-30到45級.md:567｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
03-30到45級.md:568｜標籤｜有前置｜Has prerequisite
03-30到45級.md:568｜步驟說明｜對集會所的傳送門使用泰迦給的埃盧梭斯之手，完成六次放逐。｜Use Taiga's Hand of Iruxos on the portal in the hall to banish six demons.
03-30到45級.md:569｜步驟說明｜在白骨之谷放磁鐵箱，先退開再逐隻擊殺靠過來的幽靈。｜Set the crate down in the Valley of Bones. Step back and pull the ghosts one by one.
03-30到45級.md:569｜標籤｜掉率 100%｜Drop rate: 100%
03-30到45級.md:571｜標籤｜有前置｜Has prerequisite
03-30到45級.md:572｜交通步驟｜仍綁在葬影村時用爐石回村；從其他站加入且綁在別處就沿路步行回飛點。再飛奧格瑪補技能。｜Hearth to Shadowprey if bound there. Otherwise run back to the flight master. Fly to Orgrimmar to train.
03-30到45級.md:574｜站內取捨｜影片有這趟回訪。37 級缺經驗時，補做東南側半人馬和附近的燃燒軍團傳送門；淒涼之地 葬影村交過埃盧梭斯之手才接得到 5581。幽靈電漿可用箱子引出怪物後逐隻處理。｜The video includes this return trip. If short on XP at level 37, do the southeastern centaur quests and the nearby Burning Legion portal. Turn in Hand of Iruxos to unlock 5581. Use the crate to draw out ghosts for Ghost-o-plasm, then kill them one at a time.
03-30到45級.md:575｜站內取捨｜盎格庫爾 1373 的目標在悲傷沼澤。先接，留悲傷沼澤 斯通納德順路做。1374 在回村交 1373 後才接得到，留往後補。｜Accept Ongeku (1373) now and do it on the Stonard leg. Turn it in at the village to unlock 1374, which you can save for later.
03-30到45級.md:576｜站內提醒｜還未到 38，就在瑪諾洛克集會所外圈（約 50.40, 70.40）打普通惡魔；若殺得慢，可回科多墓地東南的半人馬區。｜Below level 38? Grind normal demons around the edge of Mannoroc Coven (around 50.40, 70.40). If kills are slow, switch to the centaurs southeast of the Kodo Graveyard.
03-30到45級.md:578｜練怪說明｜瑪諾洛克集會所北外圈，密度高、普通怪。留意周邊其他惡魔。可順便拿魔化金線血袍任務需要的次級地獄火石【僅術士】。｜Dense normal mobs north of Mannoroc Coven. Watch for nearby demons. Warlocks can collect a Lesser Infernal Stone for Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe.
03-30到45級.md:578｜標籤｜僅術士｜Warlock only
03-30到45級.md:579｜練怪說明｜集會所同一片外圈，密度中等、普通施法怪。用地形拉出群怪，可與次級地獄火輪打。｜Moderate density of normal casters on the same outer edge of Mannoroc Coven. Use terrain to pull them away from packs. Alternate with Lesser Infernals.
03-30到45級.md:580｜練怪說明｜集會所東側，密度中等、普通怪。沿外緣找單隻，避開南面的精英領主；若外圈人多，可換到這裡補經驗。｜Moderate density of normal mobs east of Mannoroc Coven. Pick off singles around the edge and avoid the elite lord to the south. Use this spot if the outer loop is crowded.
03-30到45級.md:586｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
03-30到45級.md:588｜危險說明｜瑪諾洛克集會所南側有精英領主。若只要補經驗或材料，在東側打法師獵手即可。｜Elite lords roam south of Mannoroc Coven. For XP or materials, stick to Mage Hunters on the east side.
03-30到45級.md:598｜交通步驟｜在奧格瑪城外飛艇塔搭提里斯法林地線。從布瑞爾南塔下船後到幽暗城，飛塔倫米爾並綁爐石。｜Board the Tirisfal zeppelin outside Orgrimmar. From Brill's south tower, head to Undercity, fly to Tarren Mill and set your hearth.

03-30到45級.md:602｜步驟說明｜兩名囚犯各有一把鑰匙，從敦霍爾德城堡的守衛取得後再開腳鐐。｜Loot both keys from Durnholde guards, then free the two prisoners.

03-30到45級.md:629｜交通步驟｜去完辛迪加營地後向東過索拉丁之牆，重返阿拉希高地。｜After the Syndicate camp, go east through Thoradin's Wall back into Arathi Highlands.
03-30到45級.md:631｜站內取捨｜塔倫米爾先確認 498／549，兩個前置可在敦霍爾德城堡同一趟做。進山後交 533 才接 503，高迪爾和瓦杜斯的辛迪加營地目標一起找。｜Check 498 and 549 in Tarren Mill. Do both prerequisites at Durnholde Keep on one trip. In Alterac, turn in 533 to unlock 503, then look for Gol'dir and Vardus at the Syndicate camps.
03-30到45級.md:632｜站內可跳過｜意志之冠 518–521 要進精英食人魔區，並在末段回幽暗城交件，有隊伍再開整條。｜Group for The Crown of Will (518–521). The chain goes through elite ogres and ends with a turn-in at Undercity.
03-30到45級.md:633｜站內提醒｜與阿拉希高地 落錘鎮合計練到 40；到阿拉希高地 落錘鎮再看等級差額。若缺少量經驗，可先打辛迪加營地的普通成員（58.44, 70.00），再往落錘鎮。｜Use this leg and Hammerfall to reach level 40. Check your XP when you arrive. If you're just short, grind normal Syndicate mobs (58.44, 70.00) before heading to Hammerfall.
03-30到45級.md:635｜練怪說明｜辛迪加營地外圍，密度高、普通怪。留意隱匿及巫師，沿營地邊緣找單隻，只補少量就往落錘鎮。｜Dense normal mobs outside the Syndicate camp. Watch for stealthed mobs and wizards. Pick off singles for a little XP before Hammerfall.
03-30到45級.md:636｜練怪說明｜破碎嶺外側山路，密度高、普通怪。城內另有精英，留在外圍可少繞路，適合單人補怪。｜Dense normal mobs along the mountain road outside the Ruins of Alterac. Stay outside to avoid the elites and keep solo grinding on route.
03-30到45級.md:641｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
03-30到45級.md:643｜標籤｜僅法師,薩滿,牧師,聖騎士,術士,德魯伊｜Mage/Shaman/Priest/Paladin/Warlock/Druid only
03-30到45級.md:644｜標籤｜僅盜賊｜Rogue only
03-30到45級.md:646｜危險說明｜破碎嶺廢墟城內有精英巨魔。清普通蠻卒時留在外側山路，等隊伍到了再進。｜Elite ogres are inside the Ruins of Alterac. Fight normal Brutes along the outer road until your group arrives.

03-30到45級.md:700｜步驟說明｜部落在落錘鎮交 688 後向薩魯克接，留到荒蕪之地。｜Turn in 688 at Hammerfall, then pick up from Zaruk. Save for Badlands.
03-30到45級.md:702｜粗體註記｜法迪爾海灣｜Faldir's Cove
03-30到45級.md:708｜步驟說明｜先清教授附近的怪，接任務後跟教授進洞再回海灣。｜Clear around the professor. Escort him into the cave, then back to Booty Bay.
03-30到45級.md:715｜步驟說明｜接 666 領取尋寶護目鏡，戴上找水下寶石；同一趟處理 662 與 664。｜Accept 666 for the goggles. Wear them for the underwater gems. Pair with 662 and 664.
03-30到45級.md:724｜交通步驟｜回落錘鎮。已開羅格瑪飛點且斯通納德飛點也已開，可直接飛羅格瑪。首次去羅格瑪而斯通納德飛點已開，先選斯通納德。尚未開斯通納德則飛格羅姆高，沿荊棘谷大道北上暮色森林，繞開夜色鎮守衛，從東口經逆風小徑進悲傷沼澤。格羅姆高飛點未開時，可經幽暗城到布瑞爾南方飛艇塔轉格羅姆高線。｜Return to Hammerfall. If Rog'mar and Stonard are unlocked, fly to Rog'mar. On a first visit, fly to Stonard instead. If Stonard is locked, fly to Grom'gol and run north through Duskwood, skirting Darkshire's guards. Go east through Deadwind Pass into Swamp of Sorrows. If Grom'gol is locked, take its zeppelin from the tower south of Brill.
03-30到45級.md:724｜步驟提醒｜還沒開這個飛行點，第一次要用跑的｜Flight path locked. Travel there on foot the first time.
03-30到45級.md:726｜站內取捨｜石拳、迅猛龍與辛迪加進階任務可在回訪時一起清。低階版沒做過就跳過同名後續。禁錮之石 651 順環線摸完，652 弗茲魯克適合有隊伍才追。｜Do the later Boulderfist, raptor, and Syndicate quests together on the return visit. Skip follow-ups if you missed the earlier quest of the same name. Click the stones for 651 on the loop and save Fozruk (652) for a group.
03-30到45級.md:727｜站內取捨｜法迪爾海灣一次接打撈、水下寶藏和船長的復仇。先完成 665 解鎖 666，接 666 領尋寶護目鏡，並順手做水下的 662／664。669 留到荊棘谷 藏寶海灣，670 回海灣的交件另候順路。｜Pick up the salvage, underwater treasure, and captain quests at Faldir's Cove. Finish 665 to unlock 666 and get the goggles. Do 662 and 664 underwater on the same trip. Save 669 for Booty Bay and turn in 670 on a later Faldir's Cove visit.
03-30到45級.md:728｜站內取捨｜影片建議激流堡有餘力再做。要省跑圖，先做水晶和落錘近郊，激流堡後段 643–646 可跳。｜The video treats Stromgarde as optional. Do the crystals and the objectives near Hammerfall first. Skip Stromgarde quests 643–646 to save travel time.
03-30到45級.md:729｜站內提醒｜途經斯通納德先開飛點。悲傷沼澤任務留悲傷沼澤 斯通納德。｜Unlock the flight path when you pass through Stonard. Save the Swamp of Sorrows quests for the Stonard leg.
03-30到45級.md:730｜站內提醒｜前往大河林地前若未到 40，先清落錘鎮東側乾鬚峽谷的普通狗頭人（約 84, 31）。怪物開始轉灰時，改打枯木村外圍的普通枯木食人妖（約 68, 69）。｜Below level 40? Grind normal kobolds in Drywhisker Gorge east of Hammerfall (around 84, 31). Once they turn gray, switch to normal Witherbark trolls outside the village (around 68, 69).
03-30到45級.md:732｜練怪說明｜落錘鎮東側枯鬚峽谷深處，密度中等、普通怪。洞道狹窄且可能碰到稀有地卜師弗林塔格，從入口逐段推進。｜Moderate density of normal mobs deep in Drywhisker Gorge, east of Hammerfall. Clear the narrow cave in stages. Watch for rare Geomancer Flintdagger.
03-30到45級.md:733｜練怪說明｜枯鬚峽谷洞道，密度高、普通怪。與勘探員混合，可和水晶任務同趟，留意洞內回頭時的重生。｜Dense normal mobs mixed with prospectors in the Drywhisker tunnels. Pair with the crystal quest. Watch for respawns on the way out.
03-30到45級.md:734｜練怪說明｜落錘鎮西北水元素區，密度高、普通怪。比狗頭人稍高等，可打到 40。可同趟收集旋風武器任務的元素符咒【僅戰士】。｜Dense normal water elementals northwest of Hammerfall. They're slightly higher-level than the kobolds and good through 40. Warriors can collect charms for their Whirlwind weapon.
03-30到45級.md:734｜標籤｜僅戰士｜Warrior only
03-30到45級.md:740｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
03-30到45級.md:742｜危險說明｜激流堡的守衛會在門洞集結。交符印鏈前先分開拉守衛，別從屋內同時開兩群。｜Stromgarde guards gather in the gateways. Pull them separately before turning in the sigil chain and avoid aggroing two packs from inside a building.
03-30到45級.md:743｜危險說明｜法迪爾海灣沉船有水下怪，進船前先戴尋寶潛水鏡並注意氧氣。｜Underwater mobs guard the Faldir's Cove wrecks. Equip your Treasure Hunting Goggles and watch your breath before entering.
03-30到45級.md:751｜交通步驟｜斯通納德｜Stonard
03-30到45級.md:751｜步驟說明｜由悲傷沼澤地面路線抵達時，向布雷依克開點；已直達羅格瑪的角色略過。｜Unlock the flight path with Breyk if coming overland from the Swamp. Otherwise skip.
03-30到45級.md:752｜交通步驟｜從斯通納德出發，已開羅格瑪可直飛。首次依影片 26:56–27:13 由悲傷沼澤進大河林地，沿南側道路經 Terral’s Watch（2548 約 60, 64）北上羅格瑪。已由落錘鎮直達羅格瑪可直接找飛行管理員。｜Fly from Stonard if you've unlocked Rog'mar. On your first visit, enter Riverglades from the Swamp of Sorrows, follow the road along the south side past Terral's Watch (2548 about 60, 64), then head north to Rog'mar (video 26:56–27:13). If you flew in from Hammerfall, go straight to the flight master.
03-30到45級.md:752｜步驟提醒｜還沒開這個飛行點，第一次要用跑的｜Flight path locked. Travel there on foot the first time.
03-30到45級.md:753｜交通步驟｜羅格瑪｜Rog'mar
03-30到45級.md:753｜步驟說明｜向 Grakna 開飛行點。｜Unlock the flight path with Grakna.
03-30到45級.md:754｜交通步驟｜向 Innkeeper Toka（2548 57.58, 45.47）綁爐石。｜Set your hearth with Innkeeper Toka (2548 57.58, 45.47).

03-30到45級.md:851｜步驟說明｜對年幼野豬用任務道具，將牠們趕回農場。｜Use the quest item on young boars to herd them back to the farm.

03-30到45級.md:860｜步驟說明｜用任務道具引出 41 級精英 Ombassa，先找隊友。｜Group up, then use the quest item to summon Ombassa, a level 41 elite.

03-30到45級.md:862｜交通步驟｜已開卡加斯就從羅格瑪直飛。初訪沿影片 27:55–28:03 所示路線，從暮光營地北面的西側山口進荒蕪之地，往西北到卡加斯開飛點。爐石仍綁羅格瑪供後續回訪。｜Fly from Rog'mar to Kargath if unlocked. On a first visit, use the west pass north of the Twilight camp to enter Badlands, then go northwest to Kargath (video 27:55–28:03). Keep your Rog'mar hearth for the return.
03-30到45級.md:862｜步驟提醒｜還沒開這個飛行點，第一次要用跑的｜Flight path locked. Travel there on foot the first time.
03-30到45級.md:864｜站內取捨｜第一次先清農場、豺狼人、河岸及羅格瑪周邊野獸。Chogg’Zac 95427 和後續送頭線留有隊伍再做，博德羅克的野豬和採石可直接接。42 級以上的暮光和海岸留大河林地博德羅克與火線港，照影片分兩次跑。｜On the first visit, clear the farm, gnolls, riverbank, and beasts around Rog'mar. Save Chogg'Zac (95427) and its follow-up for a group. Pick up the Bolder'ok boar and quarry quests now. Save the level 42+ Twilight and coastal quests for the Bolder'ok and Powderfuse Port return.
03-30到45級.md:866｜站內取捨｜在這站先開羅格瑪飛點，往返卡加斯或斯通納德可少跑地面。補給可找 Toka。｜Unlock Rog'mar's flight path to cut travel to Kargath and Stonard. See Toka for supplies.
03-30到45級.md:867｜站內提醒｜交完當站任務若未到 41，在 Na’zok 農場南側（70.62, 33.08）補普通野豬，或在羅格瑪南側野獸區（約 61, 50）續打。博德羅克的進階暮光任務留大河林地博德羅克與火線港。｜Below level 41 after turn-ins? Grind normal boars south of Na'zok's farm (70.62, 33.08) or beasts south of Rog'mar (around 61, 50). Save the later Bolder'ok Twilight quests for the Powderfuse Port return.
03-30到45級.md:869｜練怪說明｜羅格瑪南側草地，資料庫點位密集、普通怪。附近有 41–42 級精英野獸，沿路挑單隻；可同步補 96107 的羽毛。｜Dense normal mobs south of Rog'mar. Pick off singles along the road, avoid the level 41–42 elite beasts, and collect feathers for 96107.
03-30到45級.md:869｜標籤｜台服客戶端｜zhTW client
03-30到45級.md:870｜練怪說明｜羅格瑪以南的遠境堡斥候區，密度高、普通怪。留意牧師與其他斥候一起入戰，沿河外圍清並順做 94483。｜Dense normal mobs in the Farholde scout area south of Rog'mar. Clear along the river for 94483 and avoid pulling priests and scouts together.
03-30到45級.md:870｜標籤｜台服客戶端｜zhTW client
03-30到45級.md:871｜練怪說明｜南岸偏西，密度中等、普通施法怪。先打斷治療，別同時拉斥候；已走 94483 西段時可順手補。｜Moderate density of normal casters on the western end of the south bank. Interrupt heals and keep scouts out of the pull. Grind here on the west leg of 94483.

03-30到45級.md:881｜危險說明｜羅格瑪以南有遠境堡斥候和牧師。先拉落單的斥候，避免牧師一起入戰。｜Farholde scouts and priests roam south of Rog'mar. Pull lone scouts to avoid bringing in priests.
03-30到45級.md:882｜危險說明｜陽光林地的暮光儀式洞道狹窄。先清洞口後再拆儀式圈，別讓暗影法師在背後重生。｜The Twilight ritual cave in Sunnyglade is narrow. Clear the entrance before disrupting the ritual circles. Watch for shadowmancers respawning behind you.

03-30到45級.md:891｜交通步驟｜需要補技能與騎術時再離開，回來可飛卡加斯。｜Leave to train skills or learn Riding if needed. Fly back to Kargath afterward.

03-30到45級.md:937｜交通步驟｜已學騎術就由卡加斯直飛格羅姆高；從格羅姆高再往藏寶海灣。尚未學時依種族前往騎術訓練師，若人在奧格瑪或幽暗城附近，才搭飛艇去格羅姆高。｜If you know Riding, fly from Kargath to Grom'gol, then on to Booty Bay. Otherwise visit your racial riding trainer. If you're near Orgrimmar or Undercity, take the Grom'gol zeppelin.
03-30到45級.md:939｜站內取捨｜石元素與荒蕪試劑 2258 共享一部分怪點，先接齊再打。山狗下顎骨要 30，接著一路清，夠等就走。｜The rock elementals overlap with Badlands Reagent Run (2258). Pick up both quests before fighting. Loot 30 coyote jaws as you go and move on once you reach the target level.
03-30到45級.md:940｜站內取捨｜冰霜之油、發條式同步協調陀螺儀和藥水都已備好才做 713–715。破碎的聯盟 793 留更高等或有隊伍。｜Do 713–715 only if you have Frost Oil, a Gyrochronatom, and the potion. Save Broken Alliances (793) for a higher level or a group.
03-30到45級.md:941｜站內之後順路｜1420 向赫格拉姆報到（Report to Helgrum）留斯通納德，2202／2418 等副本任務只在有奧達曼團時做。｜Save Report to Helgrum (1420) for Stonard. Do 2202, 2418, and similar dungeon quests only with an Uldaman group.
03-30到45級.md:942｜站內提醒｜影片把 40 級學騎術放在這次主城轉場。已滿 40 且有金幣，可以在路過本族訓練師時先學。參見文末「職業任務」及「40 級各族騎術」。｜The video trains riding on this level 40 city trip. If you're level 40 and can afford it, visit your race's riding trainer while passing through. See the class quests and level 40 riding notes below.
03-30到45級.md:943｜站內提醒｜離開卡加斯前若未到 42，在荒蕪之地西南打普通巨型石元素（約 6.65, 73.85）。石元素點擁擠時，沿卡加斯東南山脊打山狗和禿鷲。｜Below level 42? Grind normal Greater Rock Elementals in southwest Badlands (around 6.65, 73.85). If that spot is crowded, switch to coyotes and vultures on the ridge southeast of Kargath.
03-30到45級.md:945｜練怪說明｜卡加斯南方山壁，密度高、普通怪。附近有火煙食人魔，沿岩壁清外側；42 級前覺得吃力就改打山脊。｜Dense normal mobs along the cliff south of Kargath. Clear outside along the rocks and watch for Firegut Ogres. Switch to the ridge if it's too tough before 42.
03-30到45級.md:946｜練怪說明｜卡加斯東南山脊，密度中等、普通怪。避開精英與稀有巡邏，適合 41 級單練或石元素區擁擠時換點。｜Moderate density of normal mobs on the ridge southeast of Kargath. Avoid elite and rare patrols. Solo grind at 41 or switch here if the elementals are crowded.
03-30到45級.md:947｜練怪說明｜卡加斯東南坡地，密度中等、普通怪。可與山脊巡行者輪打；有禿鷲翅膀或胃囊任務時一併收。｜Moderate density of normal mobs on the slope southeast of Kargath. Alternate with the ridge mobs. Pick up buzzard wings or gizzards if needed.
03-30到45級.md:953｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
03-30到45級.md:955｜危險說明｜荒蕪之地東側有 39–40 級精英石窟先知與石窟猛擊者。過奧達曼外圈時保持距離。｜Level 39–40 elite Stonevault Seers and Brawlers roam the east Badlands. Give them a wide berth when skirting Uldaman.
03-30到45級.md:965｜交通步驟｜到格羅姆高後先搭飛行點往藏寶海灣，開下一批任務；若上一站出發點離格羅姆高近，可先取營地的任務。｜On arrival at Grom'gol, fly to Booty Bay for the next quest batch. Pick up camp quests first if you started nearby.

03-30到45級.md:1047｜步驟說明｜翻血帆船上的謎題物品接任務，交點在下一站悲傷沼澤的橋下。｜Start on the Bloodsail ship. Turn in under the bridge in Swamp of Sorrows.

03-30到45級.md:1053｜交通步驟｜交完血帆與討債後，從所在的藏寶海灣或格羅姆高選斯通納德。還沒開斯通納德飛點就先飛格羅姆高，循暮色森林東口、逆風小徑的地面路線。｜After the Bloodsail and debt quests, fly to Stonard from Booty Bay or Grom'gol. If locked, fly to Grom'gol and take the road through eastern Duskwood and Deadwind Pass.
03-30到45級.md:1055｜站內取捨｜藏寶海灣第 2 趟先交 669／600／628 等已完成任務。血帆 595→597→599 先跑近岸短段，開 604 同做 576／587；交 604 才接 608 打三船首領。討債 609 需先交 606→607。影片要求逐環回港，這幾個解鎖點照走。｜On the second Booty Bay visit, turn in completed quests such as 669, 600, and 628. Do Bloodsail 595 → 597 → 599 near shore, then pair 604 with 576 and 587. Turn in 604 to unlock 608 for the three captains. Turn in 606 → 607 to unlock 609. Return to town for those unlocks.
03-30到45級.md:1056｜站內先別交｜若已完成 348 荊棘谷熱疫（Stranglethorn Fever）或 8551 船長的箱子（The Captain’s Chest），保留到 45 級後的港口整理；尚未做則後續有隊伍或剛好經過目標再接。348 是 45 級任務，8551 是 47 級任務。｜Save completed Stranglethorn Fever (348, level 45) and The Captain's Chest (8551, level 47) for the level 45+ Booty Bay turn-in. If you haven't done them, pick them up later with a group or when passing the targets.
03-30到45級.md:1057｜站內先別排｜594→630 瓶中信（Message in a Bottle）是 45 級才可接的海島支線。580 威士忌斯利姆的酒（Whiskey Slim’s Lost Grog，任務等級 50）留辛特蘭蒐集。3721 你自己的 OOX（An OOX of Your Own，任務等級 50）留三張地圖的護送都解完再回港。｜Message in a Bottle (594 → 630) is an island chain that requires level 45. Collect Whiskey Slim's Lost Grog (580, level 50) in the Hinterlands. Save An OOX of Your Own (3721, level 50) until all three escorts are done, then return to Booty Bay.
03-30到45級.md:1058｜站內取捨｜可在血帆船上先接 624 科泰羅的謎題（Cortello’s Riddle），到悲傷沼澤 斯通納德時順路解第一段。628 和 600 沒做完就順路補，避免為單件又飛一次。先處理岸上的 609 再上船。｜Pick up Cortello's Riddle (624) on the Bloodsail ships and do the first leg when passing Stonard. Finish 628 and 600 along the way if needed to avoid another flight. Do 609 ashore before boarding.
03-30到45級.md:1059｜站內提醒｜荊棘谷 藏寶海灣至大河林地博德羅克與火線港合計練到 45。若此站想先補少量經驗，收完血帆三船後打岸邊的普通血帆海盜（約 32, 79）。｜The Booty Bay and Bolder'ok/Powderfuse Port legs together take you to level 45. If you're just short here, grind normal Bloodsail pirates on the shore after the three ships (around 32, 79).
03-30到45級.md:1061｜練怪說明｜藏寶海灣外海灘，密度高、普通怪。先清岸上，留意其他玩家也在解血帆任務；船線做完可就近補經驗。｜Dense normal mobs on the beaches outside Booty Bay. Clear ashore first and watch for players doing Bloodsail quests. Grind here after the ship quests.
03-30到45級.md:1062｜練怪說明｜血帆南側岸邊，密度高、普通施法怪。先清同群近戰，再拉術士；岸上循環可省上船時間。｜Dense normal casters on the southern Bloodsail shore. Clear nearby melee mobs first, then pull the warlocks. Loop ashore to save boarding time.
03-30到45級.md:1068｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
03-30到45級.md:1074｜危險說明｜莫什奧格丘陵的巨魔種類多且有精英。打格羅姆高進攻計畫時從山腳拉，避免一次進營地。｜Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mound has several ogre types, including elites. For the Grom'gol plan, pull from the foot of the hill and stay out of the camp.
03-30到45級.md:1075｜危險說明｜血帆船上樓梯窄、出口少。登船前清岸邊，逐層打完再下船。｜The Bloodsail ships have narrow stairs and few exits. Clear the shore before boarding, then clear each deck before leaving.
03-30到45級.md:1085｜交通步驟｜在斯通納德確認布雷依克飛行點 46.07, 54.83。｜Check that Breyk's Stonard flight path is unlocked (46.07, 54.83).
