03-30到45級.md:1110｜步驟說明｜先清籠邊與出口的怪，開籠後跟加林走，交件在路線末段的保險箱。｜Clear the cage and exit. Escort Galen and turn in at his strongbox at the end.
03-30到45級.md:1117｜標籤｜下沉沒的神廟再做｜Do with Sunken Temple
03-30到45級.md:1117｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
03-30到45級.md:1118｜交通步驟｜從斯通納德直飛大河林地羅格瑪。若從本段中途加入且未開羅格瑪飛點，循大河林地通往羅格瑪的地面路線，抵達後先開飛點。｜Fly from Stonard to Rog'mar in Riverglades. Joining midway without the flight path? Run there by road and unlock it on arrival.
03-30到45級.md:1120｜站內取捨｜加林的逃亡 1393 是影片提到的護送，沿路清怪再開籠。交件在保險箱，毋須回籠邊。｜Clear the path for Galen's Escape (1393) before opening the cage. Turn it in at the strongbox at the end of the escort.
03-30到45級.md:1121｜站內之後順路｜1116 夢境之塵（Dream Dust in the Swamp）在這裡打，回藏寶海灣交；1373 盎格庫爾（Ongeku）在這裡打，回淒涼之地交；625 留下一次塵泥沼澤。｜Do Dream Dust in the Swamp (1116) and Ongeku (1373) here. Turn in 1116 at Booty Bay and 1373 in Desolace. Save 625 for your next Dustwallow Marsh visit.
03-30到45級.md:1122｜站內取捨｜缺乏補給 698→699、海中的威脅 1422→1426→1427→1428、1430 新鮮的螃蟹腿（Fresh Meat）留 47 級後的東南海岸回訪，影片在約 30:50 才走這一帶。｜Save Lack of Surplus (698 → 699), Threat From the Sea (1422 → 1426 → 1427 → 1428), and Fresh Meat (1430) for the southeast coast return at level 47+. The video goes there around 30:50.
03-30到45級.md:1123｜站內提醒｜西側送完科泰羅卷軸再去避難營地，和水晶任務一起回收兩條迷失者支線。若要補少量經驗，可打淚水之池外圈的普通沼澤怪（約 60, 55），或下一站到東風海岸再補。｜Turn in Cortello's scroll on the west side, then go to Fallow Sanctuary. Do the crystal quest and both Lost Ones chains together. Need a little XP? Grind normal mobs around the Pool of Tears (around 60, 55), or catch up at Eastwind Shore.
03-30到45級.md:1125｜練怪說明｜淚水之池北側外圈，密度中等、普通怪。從陸側拉，避免引到同區綠色龍人；靠近原路線，適合短暫補怪。｜Moderate density of normal mobs north of the Pool of Tears. Pull from dry land to avoid green dragonkin. Use this on-route spot for a little XP.
03-30到45級.md:1126｜練怪說明｜斯通納德東南魚人區，密度中等、普通怪。先挑營地外落單的魚人，避免追進同群怪，適合 42–43 級。｜Moderate density of normal murlocs southeast of Stonard. Pull singles from outside the camp without chasing into packs. Good at 42–43.
03-30到45級.md:1127｜練怪說明｜同一片魚人區南緣，密度中等、普通怪。留意同區更高等的神諭者，44 級前可與噴墨魚人輪打。｜Moderate density of normal mobs at the south edge of the same murloc camp. Watch for higher-level Oracles and alternate with Inkspitters before 44.
03-30到45級.md:1133｜標籤｜僅法師,薩滿,牧師,聖騎士,術士,德魯伊｜Mage/Shaman/Priest/Paladin/Warlock/Druid only
03-30到45級.md:1135｜危險說明｜找加林之前先清籠旁和營地出口。打開籠後再拉怪容易同時顧不到護送與自己的血量。｜Clear the cage area and camp exit before talking to Galen. Pulling after opening the cage makes it harder to keep both of you alive.
03-30到45級.md:1143｜粗體註記｜博德羅克與北邊暮光營地｜Bolder'ok and the northern Twilight camp
03-30到45級.md:1145｜交通步驟｜已交暮光不再並帶著巨人之地，才往北線找鈍拳。做完北線先回羅格瑪交鈍拳的命令，再往西去暮光之罩。跳過這條鏈時從羅格瑪直接往東到火線港。｜Take the north loop to Clugfist only after turning in Twilight No More! and taking Land of Giants. Return to Rog'mar with Clugfist's Decree before heading west to Twilight's Shroud. If skipping the chain, go east from Rog'mar to Powderfuse Port.

03-30到45級.md:1237｜站內取捨｜北線與暮光之罩整條選做。已做暮光不再的角色可先回博德羅克，交鈍拳的命令後在羅格瑪接迷途的戰士。火線港第一次清海盜順手拿走私貨物，第二次收火藥桶與殺投彈手並送走私快遞，交完再出海炸船。海怪線要繞洞穴，經驗不足且 NPC 有提供任務時再做。｜The north loop and Twilight's Shroud chain are optional. If you've done Twilight No More!, return to Bolder'ok. Turn in Clugfist's Decree, then pick up The Wayward Warrior at Rog'mar. Loot the smuggled goods on the first Powderfuse Port pirate loop. On the second, collect the kegs, kill the Bombardiers, and deliver the smuggler's package before sabotaging the ships. The sea monster is a cave detour. Do it only if short on XP and the NPC offers it.
03-30到45級.md:1239｜站內可跳過｜Bloodmaster’s Ring 競技場、94768、95882 和克羅多克要塞留有隊伍再做。｜Save the Bloodmaster's Ring arena, 94768, 95882, and Krol'dok Stronghold for a group.
03-30到45級.md:1240｜站內提醒｜不足 45 就在東風海岸（約 84, 35–43）沿岸打東海海盜與火槍手，港口附近可以補給。40–45 級有隊伍可下克羅多克要塞（Krol’dok Stronghold），先接羅格瑪的 94968／94972。｜Below level 45? Grind Eastsea Buccaneers and Musketeers along Eastwind Shore (around 84, 35–43). Restock by the port. At 40–45, run Krol'dok Stronghold with a group after taking 94968 and 94972 in Rog'mar.
03-30到45級.md:1241｜站內交通｜到 45 級後在火線港碼頭（2548 80.60, 54.60）搭中立船到塔納利斯 熱砂港（1446 68.60, 23.00），再往加基森。若要留在東部王國，可沿路回羅格瑪飛行點。從塔納利斯抵港的部落角色同樣要由陸路去羅格瑪開飛點。｜At level 45, take the neutral boat from Powderfuse Port (2548 80.60, 54.60) to Steamwheedle Port (1446 68.60, 23.00), then head to Gadgetzan. To stay in the Eastern Kingdoms, return to the Rog'mar flight path. If arriving from Tanaris, go overland to unlock it.
03-30到45級.md:1243｜練怪說明｜火線港北側東風海岸，資料庫點位密集、普通怪。與火槍手混合，沿沙灘逐隻拉；可同步完成 95119。｜Dense normal mobs at Eastwind Shore north of Powderfuse Port. Pull singles along the beach among the musketeers. Pair with 95119.
03-30到45級.md:1244｜練怪說明｜東風海岸中段，資料庫點位密集、普通遠程怪。與海盜交錯，近戰可利用地形拉到岸側；適合補到 45 級。｜Dense normal ranged mobs in central Eastwind Shore among the pirates. Melee can use terrain to draw them ashore. Grind to 45.

03-30到45級.md:1253｜危險說明｜偵察大師伐加斯是精英。組到隊伍再靠近，先把周圍巡邏分開。｜Scoutmaster Vargas is elite. Wait for your group before approaching, and pull the nearby patrols separately.
03-30到45級.md:1254｜危險說明｜東風水濱的火槍手容易在遠處加入戰鬥。清海盜時沿沙灘拉開，炸船前清上船路。｜Eastsea Musketeers can join from range. Pull pirates along the beach and clear the boarding path before sabotaging the ships.

04-45到60級.md:16｜交通步驟｜在大河林地 火線港 2548 80.60, 54.60 搭熱砂港線，在塔納利斯 1446 68.60, 23.00 下船。從奧格瑪出發且已開加基森飛行點可搭鳥；初訪可由亂風崗經閃光平原南坡步行到加基森。｜Board the boat at Powderfuse Port in Riverglades (2548 80.60, 54.60) and get off at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris (1446 68.60, 23.00). Fly from Orgrimmar if Gadgetzan is unlocked. On your first visit, you can also run from Freewind Post through the Shimmering Flats and down the south ramp to Gadgetzan.
04-45到60級.md:18｜粗體註記｜港口先接，再入城整備｜Pick up at the port, then resupply in town
04-45到60級.md:25｜步驟說明｜菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地在費拉斯做，塔納利斯 加基森與砂槌營地回熱砂港交。｜Do in Feralas. Turn in at Steamwheedle Port during the Tanaris visit.
04-45到60級.md:26｜步驟說明｜砂槌營地順路做，屆時回熱砂港交。｜Do at Dunemaul Compound. Turn in at Steamwheedle Port.
04-45到60級.md:26｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:27｜交通步驟｜熱砂港沿大道往西到加基森。找部落飛行管理員布科雷克·怒拳（1446 51.60, 25.44）開飛行點，向旅店老闆菲茲格瑞博（1446 52.51, 27.91）暫綁爐石。到費拉斯莫沙徹營地再改綁。｜Follow the road west to Gadgetzan. Learn the Horde flight path from Bulkrek Ragefist (1446 51.60, 25.44) and set your hearth with Innkeeper Fizzgrimble (1446 52.51, 27.91). Rebind in Camp Mojache later.
04-45到60級.md:30｜步驟說明｜打算下祖爾法拉克才接。｜Pick up only if running Zul'Farrak.
04-45到60級.md:30｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional

04-45到60級.md:47｜步驟說明｜打南海海盜，開海盜掉落的手提箱取得時刻表，再從背包點時刻表接。｜Loot a pirate's footlocker, then right-click the schedule inside to start the quest.

04-45到60級.md:48｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:49｜交通步驟｜沿海岸北返熱砂港，一次交港口海盜與貨物。｜Follow the coast north to Steamwheedle Port and turn in the pirate and cargo quests together.
04-45到60級.md:54｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:55｜步驟說明｜先留，悲傷沼澤 斯通納德與東風海岸在藏寶海灣交。｜Save for the Stonard/Eastwind Shore leg. Turn in at Booty Bay.
04-45到60級.md:56｜交通步驟｜回加基森交廢土第二批與通緝；爐石已綁加基森就直接回。｜Return to Gadgetzan for the second Wastewander batch and the wanted quests. Hearth if bound there.
04-45到60級.md:60｜站內取捨｜第一次熱砂港把海盜帽、擊殺、通緝與貨箱一起清。TUGs 先排菲拉斯再回頭清港口海盜；本路線從火線港乘船到熱砂港，可先清海岸並保留同樣的影片站序。｜Do the pirate hats, kills, bounty, and crates together on the first Steamwheedle Port visit. TUGs does Feralas first and returns for the pirates. Take the boat from Powderfuse Port and clear the coast now to keep the video's stop order.
04-45到60級.md:61｜站內取捨｜3520 留菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地做；97530 留砂槌營地；2874 留到前往悲傷沼澤時在荊棘谷 藏寶海灣交。｜Save 3520 for Camp Mojache, 97530 for the Dunemaul Compound, and 2874 for the Booty Bay turn-in on the way to Swamp of Sorrows.
04-45到60級.md:62｜站內提醒｜未到下一站所需等級，廢土營地 59.40,24.71、落帆海灣入口 70.90,42.48 的一般怪可循環打。已組祖爾法拉克可帶 2865、2768、3042，塔納利斯 加基森與砂槌營地交。｜Need XP for the next stop? Grind normal mobs at the Wastewander camp (59.40, 24.71) or Lost Rigger Cove entrance (70.90, 42.48). Bring 2865, 2768, and 3042 if you have a Zul'Farrak group, then turn in on the Gadgetzan and Dunemaul leg.
04-45到60級.md:65｜練怪說明｜落帆海灣入口，普通怪密集，海賊任務容易撞隊。沿外側往海灘清，可同步收海盜任務掉落。｜Dense normal mobs at the Lost Rigger Cove entrance. Other players may be doing pirate quests. Clear toward the beach along the edge and collect their drops.
04-45到60級.md:66｜練怪說明｜碼頭外沿的普通怪，海賊入口被搶怪時換點。從外緣拉，避免同時引到碼頭守怪。｜Normal mobs outside the docks. Switch here if the pirate entrance is busy. Pull from the edge to avoid the dock guards.
04-45到60級.md:72｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:75｜危險說明｜卡利夫會巡邏，身邊可能帶護衛。先清沿途廢土強盜，等他走到開闊處再打。｜Caliph patrols and may have guards. Clear the nearby Wastewander Bandits and pull him when he reaches open ground.
04-45到60級.md:83｜交通步驟｜已有莫沙徹飛點可從加基森直接飛。初訪照影片從加基森北行上閃光平原，經千針石林沿西路入菲拉斯。｜Fly from Gadgetzan to Camp Mojache if unlocked. On a first visit, head north into the Shimmering Flats and take the west road through Thousand Needles into Feralas.
04-45到60級.md:83｜步驟提醒｜還沒開這個飛行點，第一次要用跑的｜Flight path locked. Travel there on foot the first time.
04-45到60級.md:84｜交通步驟｜莫沙徹營地｜Camp Mojache
04-45到60級.md:84｜步驟說明｜向夏恩開飛行點。｜Unlock the flight path with Shyn.
04-45到60級.md:85｜交通步驟｜向旅店老闆格盧爾（1444 74.80, 45.18）綁爐石。｜Set your hearth with Innkeeper Greul (1444 74.80, 45.18).
04-45到60級.md:93｜粗體註記｜營地周邊與北面戈杜尼前半段｜Around camp and first Gordunni quests to the north
04-45到60級.md:95｜標籤｜掉率 60%｜Drop rate: 60%
04-45到60級.md:97｜步驟說明｜在戈杜尼營地的藍色土丘旁使用任務鏟子。｜Use the quest shovel next to the blue mound at Gordunni Camp.
04-45到60級.md:98｜步驟說明｜點北側地面的戈杜尼卷軸。｜Click the Gordunni Scroll on the ground at the north end.
04-45到60級.md:107｜步驟說明｜計時一小時。先去南邊木爪嶺，打完五隻立即回交。｜One-hour timer. Kill five in Woodpaw Hills to the south, then return immediately.
04-45到60級.md:118｜粗體註記｜中央精靈龍，向西到深痕谷｜Faerie dragons in the middle, then west to Feral Scar Vale
04-45到60級.md:120｜標籤｜掉率 95%｜Drop rate: 95%
04-45到60級.md:121｜步驟說明｜塔納利斯 加基森與砂槌營地回熱砂港再交。｜Turn in at Steamwheedle Port after the Gadgetzan/Dunemaul Compound leg.
04-45到60級.md:122｜步驟說明｜深痕谷洞內外的雪人掉厚重的雪人皮。｜Kill Rage Scar Yetis in and around the cave for Thick Yeti Hide.
04-45到60級.md:122｜標籤｜掉率 60%｜Drop rate: 60%
04-45到60級.md:123｜交通步驟｜打完深痕谷，爐石回莫沙徹營地集中交。｜After Feral Scar Vale, hearth to Camp Mojache and turn in together.
04-45到60級.md:128｜步驟說明｜到營地西北的恐怖圖騰聚落，打角後回營。｜Get the horns at the Grimtotem camp northwest of Camp Mojache, then return.
04-45到60級.md:128｜標籤｜掉率 80%｜Drop rate: 80%
04-45到60級.md:132｜粗體註記｜往悲傷沼澤途中，先在奧格瑪開費拉斯後續｜Stop in Orgrimmar for the Feralas follow-up en route to Swamp of Sorrows
04-45到60級.md:134｜交通步驟｜從莫沙徹飛奧格瑪（通常經陶拉祖等已開飛點）。爐石維持莫沙徹，清完悲傷沼澤東岸後可用來直接回費拉斯。｜Fly from Camp Mojache to Orgrimmar, usually via Camp Taurajo or other unlocked stops. Keep your Camp Mojache hearth for after the eastern Swamp of Sorrows loop.
04-45到60級.md:139｜步驟說明｜留菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地與怒痕堡回莫沙徹交。｜Save for the Rage Scar Hold leg. Turn in at Camp Mojache.
04-45到60級.md:141｜站內取捨｜木爪豺狼前置一路做到 2903，開菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地與怒痕堡東南祖卡什兩個可一起做的任務。｜Follow the Woodpaw gnoll chain through 2903 to unlock the two overlapping Zukk'ash quests southeast of Camp Mojache.
04-45到60級.md:142｜站內取捨｜有撿到 OOX-22/FE 定位器可留在背包；護送與海岸巨人／水元素留待回訪菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地。｜Keep the OOX-22/FE Distress Beacon if it drops. Save the escort, coastal giants, and water elementals for your Camp Mojache return.
04-45到60級.md:143｜站內提醒｜未到 47 級可補深痕谷雪人 55.29,53.76，或營地北側戈杜尼巨魔 75.13,34.86；打完拉回營地交件。｜Below level 47? Grind yetis in Feral Scar Vale (55.29, 53.76) or Gordunni ogres north of Camp Mojache (75.13, 34.86), then return to camp to turn in.
04-45到60級.md:146｜練怪說明｜深痕谷外坡，普通雪人較集中，可連打並收雪人皮。洞口有同任務玩家，沿坡輪替。｜Normal yetis cluster on the outer slopes of Feral Scar Vale. Loop the slope for yeti hides if questers are at the cave entrance.
04-45到60級.md:147｜練怪說明｜深痕谷西南，普通雪人等級稍高。從外側拉近戰怪，避開密集洞口。｜Slightly higher-level normal yetis southwest of Feral Scar Vale. Pull melee mobs from outside and avoid the crowded cave mouth.
04-45到60級.md:153｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:154｜標籤｜僅法師,薩滿,牧師,聖騎士,術士,德魯伊｜Mage/Shaman/Priest/Paladin/Warlock/Druid only
04-45到60級.md:156｜危險說明｜莫沙徹北邊的戈杜尼營地混有法師和蠻兵。挖鈷礦前先清撤退路，不要一路往營地深處跑。｜The Gordunni camp north of Camp Mojache has both casters and brutes. Clear your exit before digging for cobalt and stay out of the back of the camp.
04-45到60級.md:164｜交通步驟｜從奧格瑪飛棘齒城，搭船到藏寶海灣。爐石留莫沙徹。｜Fly from Orgrimmar to Ratchet and take the boat to Booty Bay. Keep your Camp Mojache hearth.
04-45到60級.md:166｜粗體註記｜藏寶海灣順手交件｜Booty Bay turn-ins along the way
04-45到60級.md:170｜步驟說明｜悲傷沼澤 斯通納德若已收齊夢境之塵才交。｜Turn in at Stonard only once you have all the Dream Dust.
04-45到60級.md:170｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:171｜步驟說明｜留辛特蘭 惡齒村與辛薩羅在辛特蘭海岸拾酒，荊棘谷 藏寶海灣經藏寶海灣再交。｜Pick up the grog on the Hinterlands coast. Turn in when you revisit Booty Bay.
04-45到60級.md:173｜粗體註記｜斯通納德到東南海岸｜Stonard to the southeast coast
04-45到60級.md:175｜交通步驟｜由藏寶海灣飛悲傷沼澤斯通納德。若未開該點，沿荊棘谷北路經暮色森林東緣和逆風小徑到斯通納德，找布雷依克（1435 46.07, 54.83）開飛行點。｜Fly from Booty Bay to Stonard. If locked, run north through Stranglethorn Vale, then along eastern Duskwood and through Deadwind Pass. Learn the flight path from Breyk (1435 46.07, 54.83).
04-45到60級.md:178｜步驟說明｜先在淚水之池西南沼澤打鹽齒鱷魚，不夠可沿岸找。｜Kill Saltjaw Crocolisks southwest of the Pool of Tears. Check the shore for more.
04-45到60級.md:178｜標籤｜掉率 25%｜Drop rate: 25%
04-45到60級.md:179｜步驟說明｜沿東風海岸北段打巨型海蟹，南下前先收十條腿。｜Kill crabs along the northern coast. Collect ten legs before heading south.
04-45到60級.md:179｜標籤｜掉率 12%｜Drop rate: 12%
04-45到60級.md:182｜標籤｜掉率 80%｜Drop rate: 80%
04-45到60級.md:187｜步驟說明｜沿東南海灘打沼澤魚人三種各十隻，再回卡塔爾。｜Kill ten of each of the three murloc types on the southeast beach. Return to Katar.
04-45到60級.md:188｜步驟說明｜沿東南海灘打沼澤魚人三種各十隻，再回卡塔爾。｜Kill ten of each of the three murloc types on the southeast beach. Return to Katar.
04-45到60級.md:189｜步驟說明｜沿東南海灘打沼澤魚人三種各十隻，再回卡塔爾。｜Kill ten of each of the three murloc types on the southeast beach. Return to Katar.
04-45到60級.md:193｜步驟說明｜交完 1427 要走回卡塔爾接下一段。順著海岸往北補魚人智者，交前確認三種各十隻。｜After 1427, see Katar. Find Oracles farther north. Check all three kill counts.
04-45到60級.md:194｜步驟說明｜交完 1427 要走回卡塔爾接下一段。順著海岸往北補魚人智者，交前確認三種各十隻。｜After 1427, see Katar. Find Oracles farther north. Check all three kill counts.
04-45到60級.md:195｜步驟說明｜交完 1427 要走回卡塔爾接下一段。順著海岸往北補魚人智者，交前確認三種各十隻。｜After 1427, see Katar. Find Oracles farther north. Check all three kill counts.
04-45到60級.md:196｜交通步驟｜沿同路西返斯通納德，向達爾交螃蟹腿。｜Retrace your route west to Stonard and turn the crab legs in to Dar.
04-45到60級.md:198｜交通步驟｜交完後用爐石回莫沙徹營地。爐石未綁莫沙徹時飛藏寶海灣，搭棘齒城船再飛莫沙徹。｜Hearth to Camp Mojache after the turn-in. Otherwise fly to Booty Bay, take the Ratchet boat and fly to Camp Mojache.
04-45到60級.md:200｜站內取捨｜悲傷沼澤 斯通納德已做北側的迷失者與護送。這趟只補海岸；先交 698／699 才開魚人鏈，螃蟹在去程收、回程交。｜The northern Lost Ones and escort are already done. This time, stick to the coast. Turn in 698 and 699 to unlock the murloc chain. Collect crab legs on the way out and turn them in on the way back.
04-45到60級.md:201｜站內提醒｜隊伍要進沉沒的神廟，可以先處理悲傷沼澤 斯通納德接的 1429；交點實際在辛特蘭，該線留辛特蘭 惡齒村與辛薩羅以後。若未滿 47 級，東風海岸一般巨型海蟹可在 91.00,70.80 附近補；接近 49 時補等優先打下一站較高等的怒痕雪人。｜Running Sunken Temple? Start with 1429 from Stonard. It turns in in the Hinterlands, so save it for the Revantusk Village and Jintha'Alor leg. Below level 47, grind normal giant crabs near Eastwind Shore (91.00, 70.80). Near level 49, grind the higher-level Rage Scar Yetis at the next stop.
04-45到60級.md:204｜練怪說明｜悲傷沼澤東岸的普通螃蟹，分布很密、可剝皮。只適合剛進站或差一小截，與海岸任務玩家共用。｜Dense normal crabs along the eastern Swamp of Sorrows coast. Skin them as you go. Best on arrival or for a small XP top-up alongside coastal quests.
04-45到60級.md:205｜練怪說明｜若接近 49，等下一站飛菲拉斯再打。怒痕堡普通雪人等級較合適，外坡能分開拉，洞口容易碰到任務隊。｜If you're near 49, wait until Feralas. Normal yetis at Rage Scar Hold are a better level. Pull singles on the outer slopes and avoid the busy cave entrance.
04-45到60級.md:211｜標籤｜僅法師,薩滿,牧師,聖騎士,術士,德魯伊｜Mage/Shaman/Priest/Paladin/Warlock/Druid only
04-45到60級.md:213｜危險說明｜東風海岸的魚人常並排站，噴墨者與智者會從後方加怪。由岸上單拉，別追進水中。｜Murlocs stand close together on Eastwind Shore, and Ink Sprayers and Oracles can add from behind. Pull singles from shore and don't chase into the water.
04-45到60級.md:222｜粗體註記｜回營開後續，先做東南與南側｜Pick up the follow-ups at camp, then clear southeast and south
04-45到60級.md:226｜步驟說明｜留辛特蘭。打梟獸後對屍體使用任務容器，留菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地回莫沙徹交。｜Use the container on Hinterlands owlbeast corpses. Turn in at Camp Mojache.
04-45到60級.md:227｜步驟說明｜沿路保留天然材料，完整收集與交件留菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地。｜Save Natural Materials as you go. Finish collecting and turn in at Camp Mojache.
04-45到60級.md:227｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:228｜步驟說明｜塔納利斯 加基森與破碎石柱在塔納利斯斷柱交瑪爾馮。｜Turn in to Marvon at the Broken Pillar in Tanaris.
04-45到60級.md:229｜步驟說明｜先留，到費伍德森林擊殺灰熊及掠奪者，菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地回莫沙徹交。｜Save for Felwood's bears and maulers. Turn in at Camp Mojache on the next visit.
04-45到60級.md:230｜標籤｜掉率 100%｜Drop rate: 100%
04-45到60級.md:231｜標籤｜掉率 100%｜Drop rate: 100%
04-45到60級.md:233｜標籤｜掉率 100%｜Drop rate: 100%
04-45到60級.md:234｜交通步驟｜順著大路回莫沙徹，交菲拉斯的食人魔和祖卡什的入侵，下一趟再去北方雪人。｜Follow the road back to Camp Mojache for The Ogres of Feralas and The Zukk'ash Infestation. Save the northern yetis for the next loop.
04-45到60級.md:239｜步驟說明｜留塔納利斯 加基森與砂槌營地經奧格瑪一併交。｜Turn in with the other quests when you pass Orgrimmar on the Tanaris leg.
04-45到60級.md:240｜步驟說明｜留塔納利斯 加基森與砂槌營地經奧格瑪交。｜Save for the Orgrimmar turn-in on the Tanaris leg.
04-45到60級.md:242｜粗體註記｜怒痕雪人與回程｜Rage Scar yetis and the return trip
04-45到60級.md:244｜步驟說明｜沿主路往西，繞到怒痕堡 55.73,33.05 取十張毛皮。｜Follow the road west to Rage Scar Hold (55.73, 33.05). Collect ten pelts.
04-45到60級.md:244｜標籤｜掉率 70%｜Drop rate: 70%
04-45到60級.md:245｜步驟說明｜怒痕雪人掉完美毛皮才接。｜Accept only if a Rage Scar Yeti drops the Pristine Yeti Hide.
04-45到60級.md:245｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:246｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:247｜交通步驟｜雪人任務完成後爐石回莫沙徹營地；爐石仍在冷卻就沿大路步行回去。交完再飛加基森。｜Hearth to Camp Mojache when the yetis are done, or take the main road back. Turn in and fly to Gadgetzan.
04-45到60級.md:249｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:251｜站內取捨｜怒痕雪人與深痕谷雪人是兩批；先在菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地交 2822，再清這次的 7734。7738 只在掉落時交。｜Rage Scar Yetis and the Feral Scar Vale yetis are separate objectives. Turn in 2822 at Camp Mojache, then do 7734. Turn in 7738 only if the item drops.
04-45到60級.md:252｜站內取捨｜魚人鏈後由爐石回來可省一次跨海。辛特蘭 惡齒村與辛薩羅再取 3123 梟獸精華，後續 3124–3129 留菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地。｜Hearth back after the murloc chain to save a crossing. Collect the owlbeast essence for 3123 on the Hinterlands leg. Save 3124–3129 for Camp Mojache.
04-45到60級.md:253｜站內提醒｜影片回費拉斯時接近 49 級；需要補等時，可在怒痕堡 55.73,33.05 至 54.39,33.10 外圈循環打怒痕雪人，優先單拉。｜The video returns to Feralas near level 49. If short on XP, grind Rage Scar Yetis on the outer loop from 55.73, 33.05 to 54.39, 33.10. Pull singles.
04-45到60級.md:256｜練怪說明｜怒痕堡外坡的普通雪人。沿坡轉一圈並收雪人皮，洞內有人搶時留外圈。｜Normal yetis on the outer slopes of Rage Scar Hold. Loop the slope for yeti hides if the cave is busy.
04-45到60級.md:257｜練怪說明｜同一營地的高等普通雪人，可混打補到 49。窄洞容易同時拉到兩隻，先清門邊。｜Higher-level normal yetis in the same camp. Mix them in to reach 49. Clear by the entrance first to avoid double pulls in the narrow cave.
04-45到60級.md:263｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:264｜標籤｜僅法師,薩滿,牧師,聖騎士,術士,德魯伊｜Mage/Shaman/Priest/Paladin/Warlock/Druid only
04-45到60級.md:266｜危險說明｜怒痕雪人洞門窄，老年怒痕雪人會和門口怪同時進戰。先打外圍再進洞。｜The yeti cave entrance is narrow. Elder Rage Scar Yetis can pull with the mobs at the mouth. Clear outside before entering.
04-45到60級.md:274｜交通步驟｜從莫沙徹飛加基森，在加基森暫綁爐石。｜Fly from Camp Mojache to Gadgetzan and set your hearth there for now.
04-45到60級.md:276｜粗體註記｜加基森接齊，西側先完成水樣與腐化之巢｜Pick up at Gadgetzan, then go west for the water sample and Noxious Lair
04-45到60級.md:282｜步驟說明｜順路遇到沙漠廢料才撿。｜Loot desert scraps if you pass them.
04-45到60級.md:282｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional

04-45到60級.md:297｜步驟說明｜標記為物件實測出現點。廢料可由聯盟任務丟出，沒看到就沿加基森外圍找。｜Pin marks a confirmed spawn. Alliance quests can drop scraps. Check outside Gadgetzan.

04-45到60級.md:314｜步驟說明｜路過奧格瑪暗巷區交，與 7732 一起完成前置。｜Turn in at the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. Do the prerequisites with 7732.

04-45到60級.md:330｜交通步驟｜加基森飛奧格瑪。先到暗巷區找基爾茲賓，再去暗木小屋交戈杜尼寶珠。｜Fly from Gadgetzan to Orgrimmar. See Zilzibin Drumlore in the Drag, then turn in The Gordunni Orb at Darkbriar Lodge.
04-45到60級.md:338｜站內取捨｜北方水池交完先開 82；交 82 開 10 再一起跑砂槌、灌木谷與南方蟲巢。｜Turn in at the northern pool to unlock 82. Turn in 82 to unlock 10, then do the Dunemaul, Thistleshrub Valley, and southern hive objectives in one loop.
04-45到60級.md:339｜站內取捨｜有隊伍可下祖爾法拉克，四項副本任務可同場做。無隊伍直接略過四項及 4787。｜Run Zul'Farrak if you have a group and do all four dungeon quests together. Otherwise, skip them and 4787.
04-45到60級.md:340｜站內取捨｜先交 32 與 7732；4494 需 50 級，若已到門檻可在暗巷區確認，完整後續留塔納利斯 加基森與破碎石柱。｜Turn in 32 and 7732 first. Quest 4494 requires level 50. Check the Cleft of Shadow once eligible and save the full follow-up for the Gadgetzan and Broken Pillar leg.
04-45到60級.md:341｜站內提醒｜未滿50，砂槌營地 40.75,50.67 的普通巨魔集中且掉布；想在灼熱峽谷升級就先保留這一小段經驗缺口。｜Below level 50? Grind clustered normal ogres for cloth at Dunemaul Compound (40.75, 50.67). If you want to ding in Searing Gorge, leave yourself a small XP gap.
04-45到60級.md:344｜練怪說明｜砂槌營地外側，普通近戰怪多，掉布並與食人魔任務重疊。有人搶怪可沿外圍移動。｜Dense normal melee mobs outside Dunemaul Compound. Collect cloth and do the ogre quests. Keep moving along the edge if the camp is busy.
04-45到60級.md:345｜練怪說明｜西側異種蠍巢外的普通怪密集且等級較高。只沿巢口單拉，窄道容易引到一群。｜Dense, higher-level normal mobs outside the western silithid hive. Pull singles near the entrance. Avoid packs in the narrow tunnels.
04-45到60級.md:351｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:353｜危險說明｜森提帕爾蟲巢入口容易連拉。只在巢口外沿空地打，不要為了一隻追進窄道。｜The Centipaar hive entrance is easy to overpull. Fight on open ground outside the hive and don't chase mobs into the narrow tunnel.
04-45到60級.md:361｜交通步驟｜從奧格瑪飛棘齒城，跨海前到棘齒城碼頭接安戈洛導引；再坐船到藏寶海灣並飛荒蕪之地卡加斯。｜Fly from Orgrimmar to Ratchet. Pick up the Un'Goro lead-in at the docks before taking the boat to Booty Bay. Fly to Kargath.
04-45到60級.md:362｜步驟說明｜最低 49 級；安戈洛環形山 馬紹爾營地安戈洛火羽山打，貧瘠之地 棘齒城回棘齒城交。｜Requires 49. Do at Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro. Turn in at Ratchet.
04-45到60級.md:363｜交通步驟｜由卡加斯向西南沿道路進灼熱峽谷，走北側大道到瑟銀哨塔。｜Take the southwest road out of Kargath into Searing Gorge, then follow the northern road to Thorium Point.
04-45到60級.md:364｜交通步驟｜瑟銀哨塔｜Thorium Point
04-45到60級.md:364｜步驟說明｜向部落飛行管理員格瑞沙開點。｜Unlock the Horde flight path with Grisha.

04-45到60級.md:424｜站內交通｜先在瑟銀哨塔開部落飛點，完成後可飛幽暗城或落錘鎮，再接辛特蘭。｜Unlock the Horde flight path at Thorium Point. Fly to Undercity or Hammerfall before continuing to the Hinterlands.
04-45到60級.md:425｜站內取捨｜四組殺怪可沿同一圈完成，7728 掉落不足先交別組；7701 與 7722 在同一洞內，能組隊再順路清。｜Clear the four kill objectives on one loop. If you're short on drops for 7728, turn in the others first. Do 7701 and 7722 in the same cave if you have a group.
04-45到60級.md:426｜站內取捨｜瑟銀哨塔交完已達 50 可以離站。火炬後半與東南木製廁所各需額外折返，缺經驗再做。｜Leave Thorium Point once turn-ins get you to level 50. The later torch quests and the southeastern Wooden Outhouse both require backtracking. Do them only if you need XP.
04-45到60級.md:427｜站內提醒｜尚差少量經驗，在大熔爐東側外圈 44.76,38.72 打重型作戰傀儡，或回北坡 41.21,23.33 打普通黑鐵工頭。｜Need a little XP? Grind Heavy War Golems east of the Cauldron (44.76, 38.72) or normal Dark Iron Taskmasters on the northern slope (41.21, 23.33).
04-45到60級.md:430｜練怪說明｜大熔爐東緣的普通魔像，沿高處外圈打，可同步解擊殺。任務玩家多時別下熔爐底。｜Normal golems on the east rim of the Cauldron. Stay high along the rim and count kills for the quest. Avoid the floor if other players are there.
04-45到60級.md:431｜練怪說明｜瑟銀哨塔南側的普通黑鐵怪，回飛點前可連打並補任務掉落。營地內可能連拉。｜Normal Dark Iron mobs south of Thorium Point. Pick up kills and quest drops before returning to the flight path. Watch for adds inside the camp.
04-45到60級.md:436｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:438｜危險說明｜工頭瑪托留斯在熔渣之池一帶的黑鐵礦洞深處。用隊伍逐段清通道，獨行可跳過懸賞。｜Overseer Maltorius is deep in the Dark Iron mine by the Slag Pit. Clear the tunnels with your group. Skip the bounty if solo.
04-45到60級.md:446｜交通步驟｜從灼熱峽谷飛惡齒村。未開點先飛塔倫米爾，從敦霍爾德城堡北側山口進辛特蘭，沿大道往東，下海岸往南到惡齒村。｜Fly from Searing Gorge to Revantusk Village. If locked, fly to Tarren Mill and use the pass north of Durnholde Keep. Follow the Hinterlands road east, then go south along the coast.
04-45到60級.md:446｜步驟提醒｜還沒開這個飛行點，第一次要用跑的｜Flight path locked. Travel there on foot the first time.
04-45到60級.md:447｜交通步驟｜惡齒村｜Revantusk Village
04-45到60級.md:447｜步驟說明｜向格卡斯開飛行點。｜Unlock the flight path with Gorkas.
04-45到60級.md:448｜交通步驟｜任務期間可綁惡齒村爐石。｜You can set your hearth at Revantusk Village for this leg.
04-45到60級.md:450｜粗體註記｜惡齒村接任務 → 海岸｜Pick up at Revantusk Village → coast
04-45到60級.md:460｜步驟說明｜路上看到稀少的鋒喙獅鷲獸才做。｜Do it only if you spot a rare Razorbeak gryphon.

04-45到60級.md:461｜步驟說明｜需要繞到東北神廟。｜Detour to the temple to the northeast.

04-45到60級.md:506｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜7862 要打 80 隻精英，沒有現成隊伍便略。辛薩羅難以單刷時，先做沿岸與內陸任務。｜Quest 7862 requires 80 elite kills. Skip it without a group. If Jintha'Alor is too hard to solo, do the coast and inland quests first.
04-45到60級.md:507｜站內取捨｜先別交｜580 到藏寶海灣交；3123 到莫沙徹營地交；2641、4787 留塔納利斯 加基森與破碎石柱。｜Turn in 580 at Booty Bay and 3123 at Camp Mojache. Save 2641 and 4787 for the Gadgetzan and Broken Pillar leg.
04-45到60級.md:508｜站內提醒｜未到 52 級可在辛特蘭沿岸補海龜、梟獸，或與隊伍清辛薩羅。｜Below level 52? Grind turtles or owlbeasts in the Hinterlands, or clear Jintha'Alor with a group.
04-45到60級.md:512｜練怪說明｜惡齒村北側海灘的普通龜，可沿岸直線輪打和剝皮。和採龜肉的玩家共用，無需闖辛薩羅精英區。｜Normal turtles on the beach north of Revantusk Village. Follow the shore, skin them, and share the beach with turtle meat questers. Skip the Jintha'Alor elites.
04-45到60級.md:518｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only

04-45到60級.md:521｜危險說明｜辛薩羅上層有成群邪枝精英與治療怪。組隊沿階梯逐層清，未組隊留在海岸。｜Elite Vilebranch trolls and healers pack upper Jintha'Alor. Clear one tier at a time with a group. Stick to the coast if solo.
04-45到60級.md:522｜危險說明｜加莫里塔是沿岸巡邏的精英海龜。補普通海龜時留意牠，沒有隊伍就讓開。｜Gammerita is an elite turtle that patrols the coast. Watch for her while grinding normal turtles, and give her room if you're solo.
04-45到60級.md:530｜交通步驟｜從惡齒村飛悲傷沼澤斯通納德，沿南方道路進詛咒之地。到北部兩名血法師（50.55, 14.20／50.64, 14.30）。｜Fly from Revantusk Village to Stonard, then follow the road south into the Blasted Lands. Visit the two Bloodmages in the north (50.55, 14.20 and 50.64, 14.30).

04-45到60級.md:555｜站內取捨｜值得做｜五個採集一起打。全交共需顎骨 ×5、野豬肺 ×6、蠍螯 ×6、蜥蜴腦 ×11、禿鷲砂囊 ×14。每次交任務會扣材料。｜Do all five collection quests together. Bring 5 jowls, 6 boar lungs, 6 pincers, 11 basilisk brains, and 14 vulture gizzards. Each turn-in consumes its materials.
04-45到60級.md:556｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜先交掉落較快的任務。禿鷲或蜥蜴競爭激烈時，留下未完成的 2601 或 2603，繼續荊棘谷 藏寶海灣。｜Turn in the quests with faster drops first. If vultures or basilisks are contested, save unfinished 2601 or 2603 and head to Booty Bay.
04-45到60級.md:557｜站內提醒｜想補經驗可留在北部 46–53, 15–27 沿山坡打野獸。南面有較高等敵人。｜Need XP? Grind beasts on the northern slopes (46–53, 15–27). Higher-level mobs are farther south.
04-45到60級.md:561｜練怪說明｜血法師營地東側有一整片普通蠍，順收蠍鉗並可剝皮。怪多時由路邊往外打，避開精英巡邏。｜Normal scorpids east of the Bloodmage camp. Collect pincers and skin them. Pull away from the road when crowded and watch for elite patrols.
04-45到60級.md:567｜標籤｜僅法師,薩滿,牧師,聖騎士,術士,德魯伊｜Mage/Shaman/Priest/Paladin/Warlock/Druid only
04-45到60級.md:569｜危險說明｜血法師營地以南的怪群等級比北坡高。只做北部收集時留在山坡外圈。｜The mobs south of the Bloodmage camp are higher level than those on the northern slopes. Stick to the outer slopes for the northern collection quests.
04-45到60級.md:577｜步驟說明｜悲傷沼澤 斯通納德與東風海岸接、辛特蘭 惡齒村與辛薩羅在辛特蘭撿酒。｜Accept on the Stonard/Eastwind Shore stop. Collect grog in the Hinterlands.

04-45到60級.md:587｜交通步驟｜從藏寶海灣搭船到棘齒城，再飛奧格瑪。前往艾薩拉 瓦羅莫克前，可在奧格瑪找貝爾戈洛姆接 3504。｜Take the boat to Ratchet and fly to Orgrimmar. You can pick up 3504 from Belgrom before heading to Valormok in Azshara.
04-45到60級.md:589｜站內取捨｜值得做｜本趟優先交 50 級的 580。荊棘谷 格羅姆高與藏寶海灣、荊棘谷 藏寶海灣的低等任務已分次處理；仍在日誌而且已完成的，也可在同一趟港口回交。｜Turn in the level 50 quest 580 first. The lower-level Stranglethorn quests were split between earlier visits. Turn in any still in your log if complete.
04-45到60級.md:590｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜若沒有辛特蘭的酒或待交任務，這站只搭船轉場。船長的箱子 8551 與荊棘谷熱疫 348 要出城再回，缺經驗或有隊伍時再做。｜No Hinterlands grog or completed quests? Just take the boat. The Captain's Chest (8551) and Stranglethorn Fever (348) require a round trip outside town. Save them for extra XP or a group.
04-45到60級.md:591｜站內提醒｜藏寶海灣為中立港口，從客船前往棘齒城，避免誤上其他渡船。｜Booty Bay is a neutral port. Board the passenger boat to Ratchet and make sure you're on the right ferry.
04-45到60級.md:594｜練怪說明｜藏寶海灣這一站以交件和搭船為主。缺 53 級可沿原路到下一站艾薩拉再打普通血精靈，任務點易撞隊，可在營地外圈補。｜Use Booty Bay for turn-ins and the boat. If below 53, grind normal blood elves in Azshara instead. Pull along the camp edge if questers are there.
04-45到60級.md:600｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:608｜步驟說明｜奧格瑪榮譽谷接。新版背叛線的導引。｜Accept in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. Starts the updated Betrayed chain.
04-45到60級.md:609｜步驟說明｜可選；先接，留待安戈洛環形山 馬紹爾營地安戈洛打暴掠龍。｜Optional. Pick up now, then kill Ravasaurs in Un'Goro.

04-45到60級.md:610｜交通步驟｜已有艾薩拉飛行點，從奧格瑪飛瓦羅莫克。初訪從梣谷碎木崗哨往東，先到羅哈圖，再走瓦羅莫克。｜Fly from Orgrimmar to Valormok if you've unlocked the Azshara flight path. On your first visit, run east from Splintertree Post, stop at Loh'atu, then continue to Valormok.
04-45到60級.md:610｜步驟提醒｜還沒開這個飛行點，第一次要用跑的｜Flight path locked. Travel there on foot the first time.
04-45到60級.md:612｜粗體註記｜西面羅哈圖 → 瓦羅莫克接齊｜Loh'atu in the west → pickups at Valormok

04-45到60級.md:657｜站內取捨｜值得做｜薩拉斯營地、三枚印記和雷姆托里放在一趟；埃達拉斯廢墟同步拾四塊石板與納迦符石。｜Do the Thalassian Base Camp, three marks, and Rimtori on one loop. Collect all four tablets and the naga runes in the Ruins of Eldarath.
04-45到60級.md:658｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜影片跳過兩個組隊任務。【影片】永恆版可確認為精英的候選有 Ley of the Land（91685）與 Deadliest Catch（91611），本站兩個都略過。｜The video skips two group quests. Forever lists Ley of the Land (91685) and Deadliest Catch (91611) as elite candidates. Skip both on this visit.
04-45到60級.md:659｜站內取捨｜之後順路｜3542 交幽暗城的安德隆·甘特（1458 54.81, 76.33），可留東瘟疫之地 聖光之願禮拜堂轉場。城市寄回任務要重返艾薩拉，本路線可省掉。｜Turn in 3542 to Andron Gant in Undercity (1458 54.81, 76.33) during the Light's Hope Chapel transfer. Skip the follow-up that sends you back to Azshara.
04-45到60級.md:660｜站內提醒｜未滿 53 級時可補埃達拉斯廢墟納迦或薩拉斯營地血精靈，打怪時順手找任務掉落。｜Below level 53? Grind naga at the Ruins of Eldarath or blood elves at the Thalassian Base Camp while looking for quest drops.
04-45到60級.md:664｜練怪說明｜薩拉斯營地普通血精靈等級正合適，順收血精靈任務掉落。營地內可能連拉法系，從外緣打。｜Normal blood elves at Thalassian Base Camp are a good level for XP and quest drops. Pull along the edge to avoid linking casters inside.
04-45到60級.md:665｜練怪說明｜埃達拉斯廢墟的普通納迦，路過可順收納迦任務。貼廢墟外牆單拉，避開內側密集法系。｜Normal naga at the Ruins of Eldarath. Pair with the naga quests. Pull singles along the outer wall and avoid dense caster packs inside.
04-45到60級.md:671｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:672｜標籤｜僅法師,薩滿,牧師,聖騎士,術士,德魯伊｜Mage/Shaman/Priest/Paladin/Warlock/Druid only
04-45到60級.md:674｜危險說明｜埃達拉斯廢墟內側的納迦法系怪密集。撿石板時沿外牆進出，打斷後把怪拖出房間。｜Naga casters pack the inner Ruins of Eldarath. Hug the outer wall while collecting tablets. Interrupt casters and pull them out of the rooms.
04-45到60級.md:682｜交通步驟｜使用初訪已開的莫沙徹營地飛行點。若由這一站開始且未開點，可先飛千針石林亂風崗，沿谷底大路向西進菲拉斯，再找夏恩開點。｜Fly to Camp Mojache if unlocked. Joining here with no flight path? Fly to Freewind Post, follow the valley west into Feralas and learn the Camp Mojache flight path from Shyn.
04-45到60級.md:683｜步驟說明｜菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地與怒痕堡接，辛特蘭用容器收梟獸靈魂。｜Accept on the Camp Mojache/Dire Maul stop. Trap owlbeast souls in the Hinterlands.
04-45到60級.md:684｜步驟說明｜完成再回巫醫接下一種。｜Return to the witch doctor for the next quest.

04-45到60級.md:709｜站內取捨｜值得做｜3123 在莫沙徹營地交，接續 3124–3127；每個階段都要先交，下一種容器才拿得到。｜Turn in 3123 at Camp Mojache, then do 3124–3127. Turn in each step to get the next container.
04-45到60級.md:710｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜3128 材料缺太多就跳；北泉支線與較遠的西部巨人同一趟，有時間再做。｜Skip 3128 if you're short on materials. Pair the northern spring side quests with the western giants if you have time.
04-45到60級.md:711｜站內提醒｜若差少量經驗可在 69.45, 44.95 打精靈龍，或去西北鷹身人營地。｜Need a little XP? Grind Sprite Darters at 69.45, 44.95 or head to the harpy camp to the northwest.
04-45到60級.md:714｜練怪說明｜北泉鷹身人營地外圍的普通怪，若正在做北泉任務可順收掉落。單為經驗不必從營地折返，留到下站。｜Normal mobs outside the Northspring harpy camp. Collect drops if you're doing the Northspring quests. For XP alone, skip the return trip and grind at the next stop.
04-45到60級.md:715｜練怪說明｜若鷹身人點被佔，可改打東南側普通猩猩；空地好退，沿外側避開多隻連拉。｜If the harpies are taken, grind normal gorillas to the southeast. Use the open ground to retreat and pull singles from outside.

04-45到60級.md:741｜交通步驟｜若有遠古之卵，先往東去熱砂港交。其餘玩家可直接南下破碎石柱。｜If you have the Ancient Egg, turn it in at Steamwheedle Port to the east. Otherwise go straight south to the Broken Pillar.

04-45到60級.md:755｜站內取捨｜值得做｜加基森先把 2641→2662 三段交完，接安戈洛任務後再去破碎石柱。｜Turn in the three quests from 2641 through 2662 in Gadgetzan. Pick up the Un'Goro quests before heading to the Broken Pillar.
04-45到60級.md:756｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜3444 要折返棘齒城；此站可只做 3380 和 3161。若為副本鏈而接 3444，可在貧瘠之地 棘齒城取石環後另約一趟回交。｜Quest 3444 sends you back to Ratchet. Do just 3380 and 3161 on this visit if you prefer. If you take 3444 for the dungeon chain, get the Stone Circle in Ratchet and turn it in on another trip.
04-45到60級.md:757｜站內取捨｜之後順路｜4504 和有前置的 4496 都在安戈洛環形山 馬紹爾營地做。4324 燃燒平原 烈焰峰與黑石山交。｜Do 4504 and 4496 at Marshal's Refuge after completing the prerequisite for 4496. Turn in 4324 on the Flame Crest and Blackrock Mountain leg.
04-45到60級.md:758｜站內提醒｜還差經驗可在斷柱附近解 3161 並打砂槌巨魔；塔納利斯也可組隊打祖爾法拉克。｜Need XP? Do 3161 by the Broken Pillar and kill Dunemaul ogres, or find a Zul'Farrak group in Tanaris.
04-45到60級.md:761｜練怪說明｜哈札里巢外的普通蠍，等級較接近本段，密度足。留在地表，洞口附近容易連拉。｜Dense, level-appropriate normal scorpids outside the Gaping Chasm. Stay aboveground to avoid extra pulls near the entrance.
04-45到60級.md:762｜練怪說明｜去斷柱或安戈洛前，沿南路打普通蜥蜴。刷新分散，較不會被砂槌營地任務隊分走。｜Kill normal lizards along the southern road before the Broken Pillar or Un'Goro. Scattered spawns are less contested than Dunemaul Compound.

04-45到60級.md:827｜交通步驟｜從加基森飛棘齒城，搭船到藏寶海灣，再飛荒蕪之地卡加斯。暴掠龍爪留在幽暗城轉回奧格瑪時順路交。｜Fly from Gadgetzan to Ratchet, take the boat to Booty Bay, then fly to Kargath in the Badlands. Save the White Ravasaur Claws for Orgrimmar on your way back through Undercity.
04-45到60級.md:829｜站內取捨｜值得做｜能量水晶、恐龍材料、焦油和血瓣花一路並行。走近中部前留意巡邏魔暴龍。｜Collect Power Crystals, dinosaur parts, tar, and Bloodpetal flowers as you go. Watch for patrolling devilsaurs near the middle of the crater.
04-45到60級.md:830｜站內取捨｜先別交｜3908 留冬泉谷；4502、4147 留棘齒城。4292、三座水晶塔、猩猩、火羽山救援與究根問底留安戈洛環形山 馬紹爾營地。｜Save 3908 for Winterspring and 4502 and 4147 for Ratchet. Save 4292, the three pylons, the gorillas, the Fire Plume Ridge rescue, and It's Dangerous to Go Alone for Marshal's Refuge.
04-45到60級.md:831｜站內取捨｜之後順路｜4300 若已打齊爪子，下次經奧格瑪找傑斯雷蒙（1454 55.52, 34.08）交。4507 需在南邊孵化並打王，可跳過。｜If you've collected the claws for 4300, turn in to Jes'rimon in Orgrimmar (1454 55.52, 34.08) next time you pass through. Skip 4507 if you don't want to hatch the egg and fight the boss in the south.
04-45到60級.md:832｜站內提醒｜若差一點到 54 級，可在北部焦油怪（51.77, 25.14）或馬紹爾營地東邊雙帆龍（50.78, 19.90）補經驗。｜Just short of level 54? Grind tar mobs in the north (51.77, 25.14) or diemetradons east of Marshal's Refuge (50.78, 19.90).
04-45到60級.md:836｜練怪說明｜營地南側的普通焦油怪，可順收黏稠焦油。刷新靠水邊，沿岸單拉並留意魔暴龍巡邏。｜Normal tar mobs south of camp. Pick up Super Sticky Tar as you go. Pull singles from the water's edge and watch for devilsaur patrols.
04-45到60級.md:837｜練怪說明｜東北猩猩洞口的普通猩猩。與猩猩任務重疊，洞內易連拉，外圈有人就回焦油池。｜Normal gorillas outside the northeastern cave. Pair with the gorilla quests. Avoid extra pulls inside. Return to the tar pits if the outside is busy.
04-45到60級.md:842｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:844｜危險說明｜安戈洛平原有 54–55 級精英魔暴龍巡邏。北上營地走東緣，看到牠先讓路。｜Level 54–55 elite devilsaurs patrol Un'Goro. Follow the east edge north to camp and give them a wide berth.
04-45到60級.md:853｜粗體註記｜卡加斯先接 → 黑石山 → 烈焰峰｜Pick up at Kargath → Blackrock Mountain → Flame Crest
04-45到60級.md:855｜步驟說明｜在卡加斯接，東部巨槌石交。｜Accept at Kargath. Turn in at Dreadmaul Rock to the east.
04-45到60級.md:856｜步驟說明｜在卡加斯接，燃燒平原打傀儡與元素。｜Accept at Kargath. Kill golems and elementals in Burning Steppes.
04-45到60級.md:857｜步驟說明｜在卡加斯接。想去黑石山才做。｜Accept at Kargath only if you're heading to Blackrock Mountain.
04-45到60級.md:857｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:858｜交通步驟｜若已開烈焰峰飛行點，可從卡加斯直接飛過去。初訪則經灼熱峽谷黑石山穿到燃燒平原，再沿北側往東到烈焰峰。｜Fly from Kargath to Flame Crest if unlocked. Otherwise take Blackrock Mountain through Searing Gorge into Burning Steppes and head east along the north side.
04-45到60級.md:858｜步驟提醒｜還沒開這個飛行點，第一次要用跑的｜Flight path locked. Travel there on foot the first time.
04-45到60級.md:859｜步驟說明｜在副本入口外，注意周圍巡邏。｜Watch for patrols outside the dungeon entrance.
04-45到60級.md:859｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional

04-45到60級.md:860｜步驟說明｜向瓦格魯克開飛行點。｜Unlock the flight path with Vahgruk.
04-45到60級.md:861｜步驟說明｜塔納利斯 加基森與破碎石柱熱砂港接才交。｜Turn in only if you picked it up in Steamwheedle Port on the Tanaris leg.
04-45到60級.md:861｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:862｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional

04-45到60級.md:872｜步驟說明｜要先使用道具，殺掉之後拾取留下的精華。｜Use the quest item first. Kill the target and loot the essence it leaves behind.
04-45到60級.md:874｜步驟說明｜可與石板路線同打。｜Kill the targets on the same trip as the tablets.

04-45到60級.md:877｜步驟說明｜留冬泉谷永望鎮交菲諾克。｜Save to turn in to Felnok Steelspring in Everlook.
04-45到60級.md:878｜交通步驟｜從烈焰峰飛卡加斯，交鼻環、碎片與做完的派隆。｜Fly from Flame Crest to Kargath. Turn in Sha'ni's Nose-Ring and the shards. Turn in the Pyron quest if you've finished it.
04-45到60級.md:881｜步驟說明｜想接後續黑石深淵支線再往東去。｜Go east only for the Blackrock Depths follow-up.

04-45到60級.md:885｜交通步驟｜從卡加斯飛幽暗城，準備經西瘟疫之地進東瘟疫之地。｜Fly from Kargath to Undercity before crossing Western Plaguelands into Eastern Plaguelands.
04-45到60級.md:887｜站內取捨｜值得做｜卡加斯先接 3821、4061，烈焰峰開點後集中跑巨槌石與索瑞森廢墟。｜Pick up 3821 and 4061 in Kargath. Unlock the Flame Crest flight path before making a loop through Dreadmaul Rock and the Ruins of Thaurissan.
04-45到60級.md:888｜站內取捨｜先別交｜4808 先接，留冬泉谷永望鎮交。｜Accept 4808 now and save the turn-in for Everlook.
04-45到60級.md:889｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜3906、4062 要去黑石山或多一趟荒蕪之地，單練缺時間可略。想打黑石深淵可另外接後續。｜Skip 3906 and 4062 if short on time. They require a trip into Blackrock Mountain or another Badlands run. Take the follow-up separately if you're running Blackrock Depths.
04-45到60級.md:890｜站內提醒｜差經驗就打索瑞森廢墟周圍的黑鐵矮人和傀儡；黑石深淵可組隊，先在卡加斯與烈焰峰把地城任務接齊。｜Need XP? Grind Dark Iron dwarves and golems around the Ruins of Thaurissan. If running Blackrock Depths with a group, pick up the dungeon quests in Kargath and Flame Crest first.
04-45到60級.md:894｜練怪說明｜索瑞森廢墟外側的普通傀儡，沿外牆可連打並補廢墟擊殺。留意混在廢墟間的施法怪。｜Normal golems outside the Ruins of Thaurissan. Follow the outer wall and count kills for the ruins quest. Watch for casters among the rubble.
04-45到60級.md:895｜練怪說明｜同一片廢墟的普通矮人，可順路補布料及擊殺。施法怪與巡邏可能一起進戰，從斷牆外拉。｜Normal dwarves in the same ruins. Collect cloth and count kills. Pull from outside the broken walls to avoid adding casters and patrols.
04-45到60級.md:902｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:904｜危險說明｜通往黑石深淵的礦場走道狹窄，征服者派隆會在路上巡邏。先清入口的普通怪再動手。｜The quarry passage to Blackrock Depths is narrow, and Overmaster Pyron patrols it. Clear normal mobs at the entrance before pulling him.
04-45到60級.md:905｜危險說明｜索瑞森廢墟施法怪和巡邏會一起進戰。從斷牆外拉，別站在兩條巡邏路交叉處。｜Casters and patrols in the Ruins of Thaurissan can pull together. Pull from outside the broken walls and stay clear of patrol crossings.
04-45到60級.md:913｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:914｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:915｜交通步驟｜從幽暗城城外往東走到亡靈壁壘，再穿過西瘟疫之地進東瘟疫之地。沿南側主路往東，不進斯坦索姆。｜Head east from outside Undercity through the Bulwark and Western Plaguelands. Follow the southern road east through Eastern Plaguelands and stay out of Stratholme.
04-45到60級.md:916｜步驟說明｜離主路較遠。若只想開聖光之願飛行點可略。｜Off the main road. Skip if you're only unlocking the Light's Hope flight path.
04-45到60級.md:916｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:917｜步驟說明｜離主路較遠。若只想開聖光之願飛行點可略。｜Off the main road. Skip if you're only unlocking the Light's Hope flight path.
04-45到60級.md:917｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:918｜步驟說明｜離主路較遠。若只想開聖光之願飛行點可略。｜Off the main road. Skip if you're only unlocking the Light's Hope flight path.
04-45到60級.md:918｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:919｜交通步驟｜聖光之願禮拜堂｜Light's Hope Chapel
04-45到60級.md:919｜步驟說明｜向喬吉亞開部落飛行點。｜Unlock the Horde flight path with Georgia.
04-45到60級.md:920｜步驟說明｜永恆版書籍。禮拜堂內靠後左側，取書後在幽暗城交。｜The Forever book is at the back left of the chapel. Turn it in in Undercity.
04-45到60級.md:921｜步驟說明｜採 QuestieDB 永恆版地圖座標。｜Coordinates from QuestieDB Forever.
04-45到60級.md:922｜交通步驟｜由禮拜堂飛幽暗城，若手上有圖書館任務可順路交。｜Fly from Light's Hope Chapel to Undercity. Turn in library quests if you have any.
04-45到60級.md:923｜步驟說明｜QuestieDB 與 Wowhead 單一任務頁列奧蘭；Wowhead 永恆版圖書館指南另列歐文·薩得（1458 73.40, 33.00），兩人都在幽暗城法師區。先依遊戲可交提示。｜Oran and Owen Thadd are in Undercity's Magic Quarter. Check which offers the turn-in.
04-45到60級.md:924｜交通步驟｜留在東部王國。下一站從幽暗城往東到亡靈壁壘。｜Stay in the Eastern Kingdoms. The next leg goes east from Undercity to the Bulwark.
04-45到60級.md:926｜站內取捨｜值得做｜首次到東瘟疫先開聖光之願飛行點，禮拜堂書在同一處。提里奧、納薩諾斯和達隆郡主要任務留到後段。｜Unlock Light's Hope Chapel on your first Eastern Plaguelands visit and pick up the book there. Save the main Tirion, Nathanos, and Darrowshire quests for later.
04-45到60級.md:927｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜6164 要繞到恐懼谷，純轉場可略過。若影片拾的是禮拜堂裡的書，對應永恆版 84398。｜Quest 6164 is a Terrordale detour. Skip it if you're just passing through. If the video shows the book inside the chapel, that's Forever quest 84398.
04-45到60級.md:928｜站內提醒｜未滿 54 級可在聖光之願外沿道路打普通瘟疫怪，或到下一站清費爾斯通農場（約 38, 56）的普通亡靈。｜Below level 54? Grind normal plague mobs along the road outside Light's Hope, or normal undead at Felstone Field (around 38, 56) on the next leg.
04-45到60級.md:932｜練怪說明｜聖光之願西南的普通腐肉蟲，沿路能單拉，也可順收弗丁任務需要的腐肉蟲肉。避開北邊高等亡靈群。｜Normal Carrion Grubs southwest of Light's Hope Chapel. Pull singles along the road and collect Slabs of Carrion Worm Meat for Tirion. Avoid higher-level undead packs north.
04-45到60級.md:933｜練怪說明｜禮拜堂西側空地的普通蝙蝠，補經驗後可快速回補給。與瘟疫蝙蝠任務重疊，遇到玩家時往南轉。｜Normal bats in the clearing west of Light's Hope Chapel. Pair with the plaguebat quest and return to resupply. Shift south if the area is busy.
04-45到60級.md:939｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:941｜危險說明｜走恐懼谷找收據冊時，屋內和樓梯上的亡靈可能同時拉到。先清樓下再上樓。｜The undead inside the house and on the stairs can pull together while you're looking for the ledger. Clear downstairs first.
04-45到60級.md:949｜交通步驟｜從幽暗城出城，沿提里斯法林地東路到亡靈壁壘（1420 83.13, 68.94）。保留幽暗城的飛行點，方便本段末尾交城內支線。｜Leave Undercity and follow the east road through Tirisfal Glades to the Bulwark (1420 83.13, 68.94). Keep the Undercity flight path handy for city turn-ins at the end of this leg.
04-45到60級.md:950｜步驟說明｜接完就在德靈頓旁的箱子領瓶中火，與任務提供的天譴軍旗都要帶上。｜Take Bottled Flame from the chest by Derington. Bring the Scourge Banner too.
04-45到60級.md:951｜步驟說明｜先用瓶中火燒帳篷，再使用軍旗。｜Burn the tent with the Bottled Flame, then use the banner.
04-45到60級.md:952｜步驟說明｜先用瓶中火燒帳篷，再使用軍旗。｜Burn the tent with the Bottled Flame, then use the banner.
04-45到60級.md:958｜交通步驟｜從壁壘向東進費爾斯通農場，先收天譴大鍋樣本，再繞詹妮絲的房子與馬廄。｜Go east from the Bulwark to Felstone Field. Take the Scourge Cauldron sample, then check Janice's house and the stables.
04-45到60級.md:959｜步驟說明｜先確認身上有范蒂絲給的空瓶。｜Check that you have the empty vial from the quest giver.
04-45到60級.md:959｜標籤｜掉率 100%｜Drop rate: 100%
04-45到60級.md:961｜步驟說明｜拿到樣本後，在同一口大鍋接回程。｜Collect the sample, then accept the return quest at the same cauldron.
04-45到60級.md:963｜步驟說明｜包裹位於馬廄內，靠近後與物件互動。｜Interact with the package inside the stable.
04-45到60級.md:965｜步驟說明｜選部落版 5023，返回幽暗城交；本地只取包裹。｜Choose Horde quest 5023. Collect the package here and turn it in at Undercity.
04-45到60級.md:966｜交通步驟｜由費爾斯通農場往東到達爾松之淚。這裡先解房屋日記與鑰匙，天譴大鍋留下一趟。｜Go east from Felstone Field to Dalson's Tears. Do the farmhouse diary and key now. Save the Scourge Cauldron for next time.
04-45到60級.md:970｜步驟說明｜日記讀完再找遊蕩的骷髏。開廁所後農夫會出現。｜Read the journal, then find a Wandering Skeleton. Open the outhouse to spawn the farmer.
04-45到60級.md:971｜步驟說明｜日記讀完再找遊蕩的骷髏。開廁所後農夫會出現。｜Read the journal, then find a Wandering Skeleton. Open the outhouse to spawn the farmer.
04-45到60級.md:971｜標籤｜掉率 66%｜Drop rate: 66%
04-45到60級.md:972｜步驟說明｜日記讀完再找遊蕩的骷髏。開廁所後農夫會出現。｜Read the journal, then find a Wandering Skeleton. Open the outhouse to spawn the farmer.
04-45到60級.md:973｜步驟說明｜先清廁所周圍，開櫃後可立即交件。｜Clear around the outhouse. Open the cache and turn in right away.
04-45到60級.md:974｜步驟說明｜先清廁所周圍，開櫃後可立即交件。｜Clear around the outhouse. Open the cache and turn in right away.
04-45到60級.md:974｜標籤｜掉率 97%｜Drop rate: 97%
04-45到60級.md:975｜步驟說明｜先清廁所周圍，開櫃後可立即交件。｜Clear around the outhouse. Open the cache and turn in right away.
04-45到60級.md:976｜交通步驟｜沿安多哈爾外緣逐塔走，再回壁壘。塔門有高等守衛時先等巡邏離開。｜Circle Andorhal, visiting each tower, then return to the Bulwark. Wait for high-level guards to patrol away before approaching the doors.
04-45到60級.md:977｜步驟說明｜在門口即可使用火炬，毋須進塔打守衛。｜Use the torch at the doorway. You can leave the guards inside.
04-45到60級.md:981｜交通步驟｜回幽暗城，先在公會登記處附近交城內包裹。｜Return to Undercity and turn in the package near the guild registrar.
04-45到60級.md:987｜步驟說明｜先保留半個護符，西瘟疫之地 亡靈壁壘到費爾斯通農場交。｜Keep the half amulet. Turn in at Felstone Field on the Bulwark visit.
04-45到60級.md:988｜交通步驟｜幽暗城外的飛艇塔搭往奧格瑪的飛艇。｜Take the Orgrimmar zeppelin from the tower outside Undercity.
04-45到60級.md:990｜站內交通｜要去亡靈壁壘須步行。西側往提里斯法林地或幽暗城，走城外飛艇回奧格瑪。｜Walk to the Bulwark. Head west for Tirisfal Glades or Undercity, and take the zeppelin outside Undercity back to Orgrimmar.
04-45到60級.md:991｜站內取捨｜值得做｜費爾斯通農場的瘟疫鍋和包裹在同一處，回城可把 5023、5049 一起交。｜The Felstone Field cauldron and package are at the same farm. Turn in 5023 and 5049 together when you get back to town.
04-45到60級.md:992｜站內取捨｜之後順路｜本趟完成第一口鍋，達爾松之淚的 5231 與安多哈爾的通靈學院任務留下一輪。傑雷米亞的好運護符 5050／5051 後段回西瘟疫才做。｜Do the first cauldron now. Save 5231 at Dalson's Tears and the Scholomance quests at Andorhal for the next loop. Do Good Luck Charm (5050/5051) when you return to Western Plaguelands.
04-45到60級.md:993｜站內提醒｜未到55級，可補費爾斯通農場外圍的普通骷髏和食屍鬼（約38, 56）；避開安多哈爾內的高等精英。｜Below level 55? Grind normal skeletons and ghouls around Felstone Field (around 38, 56). Avoid higher-level elites in Andorhal.
04-45到60級.md:996｜練怪說明｜費爾斯通農場普通亡靈，瘟疫鍋路線順路，農田外比屋群好拉。任務玩家多時在外圍移動。｜Normal undead at Felstone Field on the cauldron loop. Pull outside the fields, away from the buildings, and keep moving if questers are there.
04-45到60級.md:997｜練怪說明｜同農場普通食屍鬼，能補上骷髏刷新空檔。不要追怪進安多哈爾。｜Normal ghouls on the same farm. Kill them between skeleton respawns. Don't chase mobs into Andorhal.
04-45到60級.md:1003｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1004｜標籤｜僅法師,薩滿,牧師,聖騎士,術士,德魯伊｜Mage/Shaman/Priest/Paladin/Warlock/Druid only
04-45到60級.md:1005｜標籤｜僅盜賊｜Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1007｜危險說明｜安多哈爾中央有 61 級精英『召喚者』阿拉基。標記哨塔時沿城邊走，不要穿中央廣場。｜Araj the Summoner is a level 61 elite in central Andorhal. Stick to the edge of town when marking towers and stay out of the square.
04-45到60級.md:1015｜步驟說明｜艾薩拉 瓦羅莫克接，並在安戈洛環形山 馬紹爾營地打齊白色暴掠龍爪。｜Accept at Valormok. Farm White Ravasaur Claws in Un'Goro.
04-45到60級.md:1015｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:1016｜交通步驟｜從奧格瑪飛梣谷碎木崗哨，沿大道西行後從梣谷北路進費伍德森林，先停南端的翡翠聖地。｜Fly to Splintertree Post, follow the road west, then take the north road into Felwood. Stop first at Emerald Sanctuary.
04-45到60級.md:1018｜步驟說明｜血琥珀在費伍德北段；下一站順路打鐵木樹人，晚一點回南端交。｜Collect Blood Amber in north Felwood. Kill treants next. Turn in back south.
04-45到60級.md:1021｜步驟說明｜完成後木喉熊怪聲望上升。若還是敵對，後續到北營地再補。｜Earn Timbermaw rep. If still hostile, grind at the northern camp later.
04-45到60級.md:1023｜步驟說明｜先接，下一站到費伍德最北邊交。｜Accept now. Turn in at the north end of Felwood on the next leg.
04-45到60級.md:1024｜交通步驟｜沿主路往北先經加德納爾，再到血毒崗哨。｜Follow the main road north through Jaedenar to Bloodvenom Post.
04-45到60級.md:1025｜交通步驟｜血毒崗哨｜Bloodvenom Post
04-45到60級.md:1025｜步驟說明｜向布拉卡爾開飛行點。｜Unlock the flight path with Brakkar.
04-45到60級.md:1029｜交通步驟｜沿主路北行一小段到碎痕谷，完成腐蝕調查，再走西側薩特月井和南端獸人營地回翡翠聖地。｜Follow the road north to Shatter Scar Vale for the corruption survey. Loop back to Emerald Sanctuary via the western satyr moonwell and southern orc camp.
04-45到60級.md:1030｜步驟說明｜務必走到任務勘查區，單殺元素不會完成全部目標。｜Visit the survey area too. Killing elementals alone won't complete it.
04-45到60級.md:1031｜步驟說明｜此處和加德納爾中央另一口月井是兩個不同目標。｜This moonwell and the one in central Jaedenar are separate objectives.
04-45到60級.md:1032｜步驟說明｜目標在南端營地深處；沿坡道清掉周邊怪再拉。｜Target is deep in the south camp. Clear along the ramp before pulling.
04-45到60級.md:1032｜標籤｜掉率 100%｜Drop rate: 100%
04-45到60級.md:1035｜步驟說明｜下趟用空水壺到加德納爾中央月井裝水。｜Fill the empty canteen at the central Jaedenar moonwell on your next visit.
04-45到60級.md:1036｜交通步驟｜回血毒崗哨，交水樣與洛爾的爪子；視需要在這裡補給。｜Return to Bloodvenom Post to turn in the water sample and Rell's claw. Restock if needed.
04-45到60級.md:1040｜站內交通｜血毒崗哨開飛行點，下站仍由此出發。若途經梣谷碎木崗哨，沿大道繞過聯盟城鎮的守衛。｜Unlock Bloodvenom Post now and leave from there on the next leg. If passing through Splintertree Post, follow the main road around the Alliance town and its guards.
04-45到60級.md:1041｜站內取捨｜值得做｜南部死木熊怪直接開木喉聲望；加德納爾、南段洛爾和碧火薩特月井可連著跑。｜Kill southern Deadwood furbolgs to start earning Timbermaw reputation. Do Jaedenar, the southern lore quests, and the Jadefire moonwell in one loop.
04-45到60級.md:1042｜站內取捨｜之後順路｜4102 先接，北邊拿齊血琥珀。採完後晚點再回南部交，省下立刻折返一趟。｜Accept 4102 and collect the Blood Amber up north. Save the turn-in for your next trip south.
04-45到60級.md:1043｜站內提醒｜未到55級時，優先在碎痕谷外圈（約41, 42）打普通元素，或補木喉聲望的死木熊怪。｜Below level 55? Grind normal elementals on the edge of Shatter Scar Vale (around 41, 42) or Deadwood furbolgs for Timbermaw reputation.
04-45到60級.md:1046｜練怪說明｜碎痕谷外圈的普通元素，和熱能擊殺任務重疊。入口有任務玩家時從外側向內輪打。｜Normal elementals around Shatter Scar Vale count toward the kill quest. If the entrance is busy, work from the edge inward.
04-45到60級.md:1047｜練怪說明｜同一片普通元素點，有較高等的變種，與熱能野獸混打。地形窄，留意成對刷新。｜Mix higher-level normal elementals with the other elementals at the same spot. Watch for paired spawns in the narrow terrain.
04-45到60級.md:1052｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1056｜危險說明｜碎痕谷熱能元素會在坑邊成對刷新。從坡口單拉，別往坑底跨到下一群。｜Shatter Scar Vale elementals spawn in pairs along the pit. Pull from the top of the ramp and stay out of the bottom to avoid the next pack.
04-45到60級.md:1065｜步驟說明｜下站冬泉谷打梟獸，後續回血毒崗哨交。｜Kill owlbeasts in Winterspring, then turn in at Bloodvenom Post.
04-45到60級.md:1066｜交通步驟｜先往南去加德納爾中央月井，取水後走回翡翠聖地交件。之後才回碧火薩特月井放出小貓。｜Go south to Jaedenar's central moonwell, collect water and turn it in at Emerald Sanctuary. Release the kitten at the Jadefire moonwell afterward.
04-45到60級.md:1069｜步驟說明｜留到棘齒城南面的水之先知伊斯倫交。｜Save the turn-in for Islen Waterseer south of Ratchet.
04-45到60級.md:1070｜步驟說明｜放貓後別走太快或飛走；到溫娜身邊須先點小貓交還，才能交任務。｜Walk with the kitten. Click it by Winna before turning in.
04-45到60級.md:1072｜交通步驟｜離開血毒崗哨，沿主路北上鐵木森林與死木村，最北端在木喉洞口找納菲恩。｜Follow the main road north from Bloodvenom Post through Irontree Woods and Deadwood Village. Find Nafien at the Timbermaw entrance.
04-45到60級.md:1073｜步驟說明｜收齊先保留，下次回南費伍德再向梅貝絲交。｜Save the items for Maybess when you next visit south Felwood.
04-45到60級.md:1073｜標籤｜掉率 100%｜Drop rate: 100%
04-45到60級.md:1074｜標籤｜若先前已接｜If already accepted
04-45到60級.md:1074｜步驟說明｜需已在莫沙徹營地接取；菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地回營地交。｜Requires pickup at Camp Mojache. Turn in there.
04-45到60級.md:1078｜步驟說明｜北營地清完再確認聲望，仍敵對就加刷死木怪直到冷淡。｜Check Timbermaw rep after the north camp. If hostile, grind Deadwood until Unfriendly.
04-45到60級.md:1080｜步驟說明｜從洞內往冬泉谷出口走，出洞找薩爾法。｜Take the Winterspring exit from the cave and find Salfa outside.
04-45到60級.md:1081｜交通步驟｜木喉熊怪聲望到「冷淡」後進洞，沿冬泉谷出口走。洞內不打木喉熊怪。｜At Unfriendly with Timbermaw Hold, enter the tunnel and take the Winterspring exit. Avoid attacking the Timbermaw furbolgs.
04-45到60級.md:1083｜站內交通｜血毒崗哨補給後沿大道向北。洞內看分岔，走往冬泉谷的出口。｜Restock at Bloodvenom Post, then follow the main road north. At the fork inside the tunnel, take the Winterspring exit.
04-45到60級.md:1084｜站內取捨｜值得做｜北部鐵木森林一起解血琥珀與墮落的力量，最後才刷死木熊怪聲望。｜Do Blood Amber and the Irontree strength quest together in northern Irontree Woods. Grind Deadwood reputation last.
04-45到60級.md:1085｜站內取捨｜之後順路｜已打完 4102 先留物品，往後回翡翠聖地再交。5158 留棘齒城。｜Keep the items for 4102 if you're done. Turn in on your next Emerald Sanctuary visit. Save 5158 for Ratchet.
04-45到60級.md:1086｜站內提醒｜木喉聲望達「冷淡」即可安全走洞。若聲望仍是敵對，或未到56級，可在北死木村（約62, 8）補熊怪。｜Reach Unfriendly with Timbermaw Hold to pass safely through the tunnel. If still Hostile or below level 56, grind furbolgs at northern Deadwood Village (around 62, 8).
04-45到60級.md:1089｜練怪說明｜北死木村普通熊怪，去木喉要塞前順打，可補聲望及羽毛。營帳間容易連拉，先清外圈。｜Normal furbolgs in northern Deadwood Village. Grind rep and collect feathers before Timbermaw Hold. Clear around the tents first to avoid adds.
04-45到60級.md:1090｜練怪說明｜同村靠大道的普通熊怪，遇到聲望團可沿路側挑落單怪。不要打木喉守衛。｜Normal furbolgs near the main road in the same village. Pick off singles by the road if a rep group is there. Leave Timbermaw guards alone.
04-45到60級.md:1095｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1097｜危險說明｜木喉要塞仍對你敵對時，洞內的守衛可能成群加入戰鬥。先打外面的死木熊怪升到冷淡再穿洞。｜If you're still Hostile with Timbermaw Hold, the tunnel guards can pull in groups. Grind Deadwood furbolgs outside until Unfriendly before going through.
04-45到60級.md:1105｜標籤｜若費伍德森林 血毒崗哨與木喉要塞已接｜If accepted on the Bloodvenom Post/Timbermaw Hold leg
04-45到60級.md:1106｜標籤｜若費伍德森林 血毒崗哨與木喉要塞已接｜If accepted on the Bloodvenom Post/Timbermaw Hold leg
04-45到60級.md:1107｜步驟說明｜可在永望鎮東側的冬泉村解。後續還要西返，可等下次回洞口再交。｜Do in Winterfall Village east of Everlook. Turn in on the next trip west to the tunnel.
04-45到60級.md:1107｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:1108｜交通步驟｜從洞口向南去冰火溫泉，先接多諾瓦的熊怪任務，再去西部冬泉熊怪營地。｜Head south from the tunnel to Frostfire Hot Springs and pick up Donova's furbolg quests before going to the western Winterfall camp.
04-45到60級.md:1109｜標籤｜若安戈洛環形山 馬紹爾營地已接｜If accepted on the Marshal's Refuge leg
04-45到60級.md:1110｜標籤｜若安戈洛環形山 馬紹爾營地已接｜If accepted on the Marshal's Refuge leg
04-45到60級.md:1111｜步驟說明｜菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地北菲拉斯取藥劑；下次回冰火溫泉再交。｜Get the elixir in north Feralas. Turn in when you return to Frostfire Hot Springs.
04-45到60級.md:1114｜標籤｜掉落才接｜Accept if it drops
04-45到60級.md:1114｜步驟說明｜熊怪會掉空的火酒瓶，撿到後點開；這是月光林地 永夜港至冬泉谷 霜語峽谷熊怪鏈的前置；若還沒掉，到冬泉村外繼續打普通熊怪。｜Right-click Empty Firewater Flask to start the chain. Farm Winterfall furbolgs if needed.
04-45到60級.md:1116｜標籤｜若有火酒瓶｜If you have the Firewater Flask
04-45到60級.md:1117｜標籤｜若有火酒瓶｜If you have the Firewater Flask
04-45到60級.md:1118｜步驟說明｜留到下一趟北費伍德，找死木營帳中的蒸鍋。｜Save for the next north Felwood trip. Find the cauldron inside the Deadwood tent.
04-45到60級.md:1119｜交通步驟｜向東往永望鎮，沿路清兩類梟獸。｜Head east to Everlook and clear both kinds of wildkin on the way.
04-45到60級.md:1120｜交通步驟｜永望鎮｜Everlook
04-45到60級.md:1120｜步驟說明｜向尤格雷克開飛行點。｜Unlock the flight path with Yugrek.
04-45到60級.md:1121｜交通步驟｜向旅店老闆維茲奇（1452 61.36, 38.83）綁爐石。｜Set your hearth with Innkeeper Vizzie (1452 61.36, 38.83).
04-45到60級.md:1122｜標籤｜若費伍德森林 血毒崗哨與木喉要塞已接｜If accepted on the Bloodvenom Post/Timbermaw Hold leg
04-45到60級.md:1122｜步驟說明｜打完留到回費伍德血毒崗哨再交。｜Save the turn-in for your next visit to Bloodvenom Post.
04-45到60級.md:1123｜標籤｜若燃燒平原 烈焰峰與黑石山已接｜If accepted on the Flame Crest/Blackrock Mountain leg
04-45到60級.md:1124｜標籤｜若燃燒平原 烈焰峰與黑石山已接｜If accepted on the Flame Crest/Blackrock Mountain leg
04-45到60級.md:1125｜標籤｜需先完成4808｜Requires quest 4808
04-45到60級.md:1127｜步驟說明｜下一趟到亡靈壁壘交銀色黎明軍官加魯什。｜Turn in to Argent Officer Garush at the Bulwark next time.
04-45到60級.md:1128｜步驟說明｜留往東瘟疫之地聖光之願禮拜堂交。｜Save the turn-in for Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
04-45到60級.md:1129｜步驟說明｜與永望鎮的報告一起帶到東瘟疫，東瘟疫之地 聖光之願禮拜堂在達隆郡交。｜Bring the Everlook report too. Turn this in at Darrowshire in Eastern Plaguelands.
04-45到60級.md:1130｜標籤｜精英｜Elite
04-45到60級.md:1130｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:1131｜交通步驟｜先清永望鎮東面的雪怪洞穴與周邊，再視進度繞北邊和東側。｜Clear the yeti cave and surrounding area east of Everlook, then loop north and east if needed.
04-45到60級.md:1132｜步驟說明｜下一段需要雪怪角，晚一趟再接 977。｜Bring a yeti horn for the next quest. Pick up 977 on a later trip.
04-45到60級.md:1132｜標籤｜掉率 33%｜Drop rate: 33%
04-45到60級.md:1134｜標籤｜需先完成4808｜Requires quest 4808
04-45到60級.md:1134｜標籤｜掉率 20%｜Drop rate: 20%
04-45到60級.md:1135｜標籤｜需先完成4808｜Requires quest 4808
04-45到60級.md:1136｜步驟說明｜下次順路去燃燒平原才回覆丁奇。｜Report back to Tinkee the next time you pass through Burning Steppes.
04-45到60級.md:1136｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:1137｜標籤｜精英｜Elite
04-45到60級.md:1137｜步驟說明｜56 級精英，組隊再打。｜Group up for the level-56 elite.
04-45到60級.md:1137｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:1138｜標籤｜精英｜Elite
04-45到60級.md:1138｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:1139｜標籤｜需折返洞口｜Return to the cave entrance
04-45到60級.md:1139｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:1140｜標籤｜需折返洞口｜Return to the cave entrance
04-45到60級.md:1140｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:1142｜站內交通｜初到永望鎮開鳥點並綁爐石。下一站飛菲拉斯莫沙徹營地。若未開飛行點，可先飛千針石林亂風崗，沿大路西行到菲拉斯開點。｜Unlock Everlook's flight path and set your Hearthstone. Fly to Camp Mojache next. If its flight path is locked, fly to Freewind Post and take the road west to Feralas to unlock it.
04-45到60級.md:1143｜站內取捨｜值得做｜冰火溫泉的多諾瓦任務先交齊，梟獸沿路清；永望鎮雪怪、奇美拉可在同趟做。｜Turn in Donova's quests at Frostfire Hot Springs and kill owlbeasts as you go. Do the Everlook yetis and chimaeras on the same loop.
04-45到60級.md:1144｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜尤西烏斯是精英，8464 須往西折返洞口。有隊伍或還缺進度再做。｜Ursius is elite, and 8464 sends you back west to the cave. Do them if you have a group or still need XP.
04-45到60級.md:1145｜站內取捨｜之後順路｜永望鎮報告與尼古拉斯公爵的書先放任務欄，東部王國下一輪一起交。｜Keep the Everlook report and Duke Nicholas's book in your quest log. Turn both in on the next Eastern Kingdoms loop.
04-45到60級.md:1146｜站內提醒｜還不到56級就打永望鎮東邊的普通雪怪（約64, 40）或東側冬泉村外圍熊怪，避開巡邏精英。｜Below level 56? Grind normal yetis east of Everlook (around 64, 40) or furbolgs outside Winterfall Village. Avoid the elite patrol.
04-45到60級.md:1149｜練怪說明｜永望鎮東側的普通雪人，靠補給點且可順收毛皮。洞口常有同任務玩家，先沿山腳打。｜Normal yetis east of Everlook, near supplies. Collect fur as you go. Start at the foot of the mountain if the cave mouth is busy.
04-45到60級.md:1150｜練怪說明｜冬泉村外圈的普通熊怪，補木喉聲望與相關掉落。村內施法怪容易連拉，避開精英巡邏。｜Normal furbolgs outside Winterfall Village for Timbermaw rep and drops. Avoid elite patrols and linked casters inside.
04-45到60級.md:1156｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1158｜危險說明｜永望鎮北邊有精英碎齒熊尤西烏斯巡邏。單打普通熊時繞開，已組隊再做牠的任務。｜Ursius, an elite Shardtooth bear, patrols north of Everlook. Give him a wide berth while grinding normal bears. Do his quest with a group.
04-45到60級.md:1159｜危險說明｜冬泉村內的薩滿祭司和巡邏熊怪容易成群。缺經驗就沿村外找落單守衛。｜Shamans and furbolg patrols can pull together in Winterfall Village. If you need XP, pick off lone guards outside.
04-45到60級.md:1167｜交通步驟｜從永望鎮飛莫沙徹營地；這一趟先回營地交菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地與怒痕堡的費伍德支線，已接視靈藥劑再去北邊。｜Fly from Everlook to Camp Mojache. Turn in the Felwood side quest you picked up on the Camp Mojache and Rage Scar Hold leg. Head north if you've picked up The Videre Elixir.
04-45到60級.md:1168｜標籤｜若費伍德森林 血毒崗哨與木喉要塞已完成｜If done on the Bloodvenom Post/Timbermaw Hold leg
04-45到60級.md:1169｜交通步驟｜若身上有 3909，沿菲拉斯大道向西至岔路，再朝雙塔山與北邊的烏鴉風廢墟。｜If you have 3909, follow the road west to the fork, then go toward the Twin Colossals and Ravenwind Ruins.
04-45到60級.md:1170｜標籤｜若冬泉谷 永望鎮已接｜If accepted in Everlook
04-45到60級.md:1170｜步驟說明｜格雷甘交換藥劑是 4041 的對話流程；本趟只取藥，別喝，留給冬泉谷多諾瓦交。｜Get Gregan's elixir for 4041. Don't drink it. Take it to Donova in Winterspring.
04-45到60級.md:1171｜交通步驟｜打算補海岸支線才去被遺忘的海岸。若手上有菲拉斯定位器，可先去深痕谷洞穴接護送，再順路走到海岸。｜Only visit the Forgotten Coast for the optional quests. If you have the Feralas beacon, pick up the Feral Scar Vale cave escort on the way.
04-45到60級.md:1171｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:1172｜步驟說明｜定位器為野怪掉落，已撿到才接。｜Accept only if you loot the locator from a mob.
04-45到60級.md:1172｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
