04-45到60級.md:1183｜交通步驟｜回莫沙徹營地飛棘齒城。已完成 2767 且想交件時，可由棘齒城搭船往返藏寶海灣；其餘直接在棘齒城辦交接。｜Return to Camp Mojache and fly to Ratchet. If you've finished 2767 and want to turn it in, take the boat to Booty Bay and back. Otherwise do your turn-ins in Ratchet.
04-45到60級.md:1185｜站內交通｜主要轉場為永望鎮飛莫沙徹、莫沙徹飛棘齒城。若已安排藏寶海灣交件，可用棘齒城對開的船補交。｜Fly Everlook → Camp Mojache → Ratchet. If you're due to turn in at Booty Bay, take the boat from Ratchet.
04-45到60級.md:1186｜站內取捨｜值得做｜菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地與怒痕堡接、費伍德做的 4120 是回村就能交的任務。｜Accept 4120 on the Camp Mojache and Dire Maul leg, do it in Felwood, then turn it in on your return to camp.
04-45到60級.md:1187｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜海岸支線在西側，定位器沒掉就不找；只有想補經驗或要去雙塔山時才把海岸並入。｜The coastal quests are west of camp. Don't go looking for the beacon if it hasn't dropped. Add the coast only if you need XP or plan to visit the Twin Colossals.
04-45到60級.md:1188｜站內提醒｜此站沒有必須單獨練等的門檻。若差56，先到下一站交件，再把經驗差留給後段同等怪區。｜There's no separate level target here. If you're still below 56, do the next stop's turn-ins first and catch up later on mobs your level.
04-45到60級.md:1191｜練怪說明｜若已在北泉交件，可清營地外圍的普通鷹身人，順收北泉任務掉落。怪等偏低，若還差一大截就去冬泉谷。｜If you've turned in at Northspring, clear normal harpies outside for quest drops. If you're still far from the next level, grind in Winterspring.
04-45到60級.md:1192｜練怪說明｜若差 56 級，上一站離開永望鎮前優先在這片補。普通雪人集中，外坡比洞口好拉。｜If below 56, grind here before leaving Everlook. Normal yetis cluster here, and the outer slopes are easier to pull than the cave mouth.
04-45到60級.md:1198｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1199｜標籤｜僅法師,薩滿,牧師,聖騎士,術士,德魯伊｜Mage/Shaman/Priest/Paladin/Warlock/Druid only
04-45到60級.md:1201｜危險說明｜被遺忘的海岸巨人要先用壓縮器縮小再打。等海元素走開後逐隻處理。｜Use Zorbin's Ultra-Shrinker on the giants at the Forgotten Coast before fighting them. Wait for the water elementals to move away and pull one at a time.
04-45到60級.md:1209｜標籤｜若走藏寶海灣轉船｜If taking the boat via Booty Bay
04-45到60級.md:1209｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:1210｜交通步驟｜到棘齒城後先交工程任務，再沿岸往南找水之先知伊斯倫。｜Turn in the engineering quest in Ratchet, then follow the coast south to Islen Waterseer.
04-45到60級.md:1211｜標籤｜若安戈洛環形山 馬紹爾營地已採滿灰燼｜If you collected all the ash on the Marshal's Refuge leg
04-45到60級.md:1212｜標籤｜若安戈洛環形山 馬紹爾營地已接｜If accepted on the Marshal's Refuge leg
04-45到60級.md:1213｜標籤｜若安戈洛環形山 馬紹爾營地已接｜If accepted on the Marshal's Refuge leg
04-45到60級.md:1214｜標籤｜若費伍德森林 血毒崗哨與木喉要塞已接｜If accepted on the Bloodvenom Post/Timbermaw Hold leg
04-45到60級.md:1215｜標籤｜若費伍德森林 血毒崗哨與木喉要塞已接｜If accepted on the Bloodvenom Post/Timbermaw Hold leg
04-45到60級.md:1216｜標籤｜需先完成5158｜Requires quest 5158
04-45到60級.md:1216｜步驟說明｜保留淨化水。後段回費伍德翡翠聖地再交格雷塔。｜Keep the purified water for Greta at Emerald Sanctuary later.
04-45到60級.md:1217｜交通步驟｜回棘齒城飛奧格瑪，搭城外前往提里斯法林地的飛艇。抵達後沿提里斯法林地東路前往亡靈壁壘。｜Fly from Ratchet to Orgrimmar and take the Tirisfal Glades zeppelin. On arrival, follow the east road to the Bulwark.
04-45到60級.md:1219｜站內交通｜棘齒城飛奧格瑪後，換城外幽暗城方向飛艇。抵達提里斯法林地，沿東路到亡靈壁壘。｜Fly from Ratchet to Orgrimmar, then take the Undercity zeppelin outside town. In Tirisfal Glades, follow the road east to the Bulwark.
04-45到60級.md:1220｜站內取捨｜值得做｜已完成安戈洛灰燼和車間支線就一起交給莉芙，海岸再接伊斯倫回費伍德的信。｜Turn in the Un'Goro ash and workshop quests to Liv if done. Pick up the letter for Felwood from Islen on the coast.
04-45到60級.md:1221｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜若身上沒有棘齒城可交任務，可由菲拉斯直接飛奧格瑪轉飛艇。｜If you have no Ratchet turn-ins, fly straight from Feralas to Orgrimmar and take the zeppelin.
04-45到60級.md:1222｜站內提醒｜棘齒城的怪等級偏低。未到 56 級可在轉飛艇前飛回永望鎮打東側普通雪人（約 64, 40），或到西瘟疫之地 亡靈壁壘在費爾斯通農場（約 38, 56）打普通亡靈。｜Ratchet mobs are low level. Below 56? Grind normal yetis east of Everlook (around 64, 40) before taking the zeppelin, or normal undead at Felstone Field (around 38, 56) on the Bulwark leg.
04-45到60級.md:1225｜練怪說明｜棘齒城只辦交接。缺 56 級時沿原路搭飛艇，到下一站費爾斯通農場再打。普通骷髏多，從田埂拉，避開血色巡邏。｜Ratchet is just for turn-ins and transit. If below 56, take the zeppelin and grind normal skeletons at Felstone Field. Pull from the field edge and avoid Scarlet patrols.
04-45到60級.md:1231｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1232｜標籤｜僅法師,薩滿,牧師,聖騎士,術士,德魯伊｜Mage/Shaman/Priest/Paladin/Warlock/Druid only
04-45到60級.md:1240｜交通步驟｜從棘齒城飛奧格瑪並轉乘飛艇，抵達提里斯法林地後，沿幽暗城外的大路往東走到亡靈壁壘。｜Fly from Ratchet to Orgrimmar and take the zeppelin to Tirisfal Glades. Follow the main road east from outside Undercity to the Bulwark.
04-45到60級.md:1249｜步驟說明｜先清鍋邊的普通亡靈，靠近鍋會引出護鍋者。｜Clear normal undead around the cauldron. Approach to spawn the guardian.
04-45到60級.md:1249｜標籤｜掉率 100%｜Drop rate: 100%
04-45到60級.md:1255｜步驟說明｜先清鍋邊的普通亡靈，靠近鍋會引出護鍋者。｜Clear normal undead around the cauldron. Approach to spawn the guardian.
04-45到60級.md:1255｜標籤｜掉率 100%｜Drop rate: 100%
04-45到60級.md:1264｜步驟說明｜與兩口瘟疫之鍋同趟收，回壁壘交樣本時一起交。｜Collect on the two-cauldron loop. Turn in with the samples at the Bulwark.
04-45到60級.md:1269｜步驟說明｜先清鍋邊的普通亡靈，靠近鍋會引出護鍋者。｜Clear normal undead around the cauldron. Approach to spawn the guardian.
04-45到60級.md:1269｜標籤｜掉率 100%｜Drop rate: 100%
04-45到60級.md:1273｜站內交通｜第 1 步由飛艇塔往亡靈壁壘。打完蓋羅恩農場後沿主路向東去東瘟疫。｜At step 1, head from the zeppelin tower to the Bulwark. After Gahrron's Withering, follow the main road east to Eastern Plaguelands.
04-45到60級.md:1274｜站內取捨｜值得做｜瘟疫之鍋按接續順序做，嚎哭鬼屋順路完成兩段野生動物。｜Do the cauldron quests in order. Do both wildlife quests while passing the Writhing Haunt.
04-45到60級.md:1275｜站內取捨｜先別交｜5236 留西瘟疫之地 亡靈壁壘，5901 在東瘟疫之地 聖光之願禮拜堂完成、回西瘟疫之地 亡靈壁壘交。｜Save 5236 for the Bulwark. Do 5901 on the Light's Hope Chapel leg and turn it in back at the Bulwark.
04-45到60級.md:1276｜站內提醒｜同為 56–57 級帶，接著去東瘟疫之地 聖光之願禮拜堂。壁壘旁接了 964 才開始累積骸骨碎片。打算自備通靈學院鑰匙的角色，交完就接 5514，並帶兩塊瑟銀錠帶去塔納利斯 加基森，再進安戈洛環形山。｜Continue to Light's Hope Chapel in the level 56–57 range. Pick up 964 by the Bulwark before collecting Skeletal Fragments. If you want your own Scholomance key, turn it in, take 5514, and bring 2 Thorium Bars to Gadgetzan before entering Un'Goro.
04-45到60級.md:1279｜練怪說明｜達爾松之淚的普通骷髏，跑瘟疫鍋可順收骸骨碎片。北側會遇到血色巡邏，打外側。｜Grind normal skeletons at Dalson's Tears for Skeletal Fragments on the cauldron loop. Stay outside and watch for Scarlet patrols to the north.
04-45到60級.md:1280｜練怪說明｜嚎哭鬼屋附近的普通食屍鬼，等級較合適，和下一口鍋同路。屋門口密集，從田邊開始。｜Normal ghouls near the Writhing Haunt are a good level and on the way to the next cauldron. Start at the field edge to avoid the crowded doorway.
04-45到60級.md:1284｜危險說明｜達爾松之淚北側有血色巡邏。收瘟疫鍋材料時從田埂拉骷髏，別往北穿營地。｜Scarlet patrols roam north of Dalson's Tears. Pull skeletons from the edge of the field while gathering cauldron materials. Don't cut north through camp.
04-45到60級.md:1292｜交通步驟｜過西界後沿索多里爾河岸找提里奧，接齊再向南上主路。｜Cross the western border and find Tirion along the Thondroril River. Pick up his quests, then head south to the main road.
04-45到60級.md:1301｜步驟說明｜拾取零件時可能出現鬼魂，先清門口。｜Clear the entrance first. Ghosts may spawn when you loot the parts.
04-45到60級.md:1305｜步驟說明｜腐質只有約 10 分鐘有效期，收齊後當場研磨。｜The rot lasts about 10 minutes. Grind it on the spot once you have enough.
04-45到60級.md:1311｜交通步驟｜確認聖光之願禮拜堂的部落飛行點已開；首次到訪找喬吉亞（1423 70.53, 47.55）。接著沿路北上打瘟疫木林一圈。｜Unlock Light's Hope Chapel with Georgia (1423 70.53, 47.55) if needed. Then head north for a loop through Plaguewood.
04-45到60級.md:1312｜步驟說明｜沿瘟疫木林外圍找蟻丘，避開斯坦索姆門口的精英。｜Check termite mounds along Plaguewood's edge. Avoid elites by Stratholme.
04-45到60級.md:1315｜標籤｜掉率 80%｜Drop rate: 80%
04-45到60級.md:1317｜步驟說明｜殺完要點剛出現的靈魂，單純擊殺不會累計。｜Click each spawned soul after the kill. Kills alone don't count.
04-45到60級.md:1324｜步驟說明｜要做完提里奧的三個狩獵任務才會出現。｜Complete Tirion's three hunting quests to unlock this one.
04-45到60級.md:1325｜步驟說明｜要做完提里奧的三個狩獵任務才會出現。｜Complete Tirion's three hunting quests to unlock this one.
04-45到60級.md:1326｜步驟說明｜要做完提里奧的三個狩獵任務才會出現。｜Complete Tirion's three hunting quests to unlock this one.
04-45到60級.md:1327｜交通步驟｜完成後從禮拜堂飛幽暗城，再搭飛艇去奧格瑪。｜After the loop, fly from Light's Hope Chapel to Undercity and take the Orgrimmar zeppelin.
04-45到60級.md:1329｜站內交通｜在交 6030 與接 5211 後開禮拜堂飛行點；末步飛幽暗城後轉飛艇。｜Turn in 6030 and pick up 5211, then unlock the chapel flight path. At the final step, fly to Undercity and transfer to the zeppelin.
04-45到60級.md:1330｜站內取捨｜先別交｜5901 與 5152 回西瘟疫之地 亡靈壁壘交。｜Turn in 5901 and 5152 on your return to the Bulwark.
04-45到60級.md:1331｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜暗翼蝠（Duskwing, Oh How I Hate Thee...，6135）在東瘟疫，是精英巡邏目標；按影片的取捨略過。｜Duskwing is an elite patrol in Eastern Plaguelands. Skip Duskwing, Oh How I Hate Thee... (6135), as the video does.
04-45到60級.md:1332｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜6024 要在墓穴與祖爾瑪夏間來回，5781 點墓土後會引來一群傭兵，趕路可以略過。｜Skip 6024 if you're in a hurry. It sends you between the crypt and Zul'Mashar. For 5781, clicking the grave dirt spawns a group of mercenaries.
04-45到60級.md:1333｜站內提醒｜進度落後可在瘟疫木林外圍（約 29, 28）打普通蝙蝠、犬與食屍鬼。要到 57 級可等菲拉斯 亂羽高地前補。｜Behind on XP? Grind normal bats, hounds, and ghouls around the edge of Plaguewood (around 29, 28). You can wait to reach 57 until before the Frayfeather Highlands leg.
04-45到60級.md:1336｜練怪說明｜瘟疫木林外圍的普通亡靈。可順路補居民靈魂相關任務，避開較高等的縫合憎惡及巡邏。｜Normal undead outside Plaguewood. Pair with the quests for residents' souls. Avoid higher-level stitched abominations and patrols.
04-45到60級.md:1337｜練怪說明｜同區道路外的普通瘟疫犬，等級貼近本段、空地較好拉。有人清亡靈時可改沿外圈找狗。｜Normal plaguehounds off the road in the same area. They're a good level and easy to pull in the open. Switch to the outer loop if the undead are busy.
04-45到60級.md:1343｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1345｜危險說明｜瘟疫木林靠近斯坦索姆的一側有高等縫合憎惡和巡邏。採白蟻或找食屍鬼時走外圍。｜Higher-level stitched abominations and patrols roam the Stratholme side of Plaguewood. Stick to the edge when collecting termites or killing ghouls.
04-45到60級.md:1354｜交通步驟｜從奧格瑪飛雷霆崖，在城下接信差的引導，再往長者高地找大德魯伊。｜Fly from Orgrimmar to Thunder Bluff. Pick up the courier's lead-in at the base, then find the Arch Druid on Elder Rise.
04-45到60級.md:1355｜步驟說明｜此為部落前往永夜港的引導；做過 1004 或 1018 的角色可直接找哈繆爾。｜Horde breadcrumb to Nighthaven. Go straight to Hamuul if you've done 1004 or 1018.
04-45到60級.md:1356｜步驟說明｜此為部落前往永夜港的引導；做過 1004 或 1018 的角色可直接找哈繆爾。｜Horde breadcrumb to Nighthaven. Go straight to Hamuul if you've done 1004 or 1018.
04-45到60級.md:1357｜步驟說明｜此為部落前往永夜港的引導；做過 1004 或 1018 的角色可直接找哈繆爾。｜Horde breadcrumb to Nighthaven. Go straight to Hamuul if you've done 1004 or 1018.
04-45到60級.md:1359｜交通步驟｜從雷霆崖飛血毒崗哨，往北繞死木村到 1448 60.20, 5.84 的死木蒸鍋，接著走木喉要塞往月光林地岔路。｜Fly to Bloodvenom Post. Go north through Deadwood Village to the cauldron (1448 60.20, 5.84), then take the Timbermaw Hold fork to Moonglade.
04-45到60級.md:1367｜交通步驟｜月光林地｜Moonglade
04-45到60級.md:1367｜步驟說明｜往月光林地西南側，向法斯托恩開部落飛行點。｜Unlock the Horde flight path with Faustron in southwest Moonglade.
04-45到60級.md:1368｜交通步驟｜再穿木喉要塞去冬泉谷。｜Cross Timbermaw Hold again to reach Winterspring.
04-45到60級.md:1370｜站內交通｜第 2 步飛雷霆崖，第 7 步飛費伍德並走木喉要塞，在月光林地西南開飛行點，再步行進冬泉谷。｜At step 2, fly to Thunder Bluff. At step 7, fly to Felwood and go through Timbermaw Hold. Unlock the flight path in southwest Moonglade, then walk into Winterspring.
04-45到60級.md:1371｜站內取捨｜值得做｜先接 1124 和 5527，希利蘇斯南風村能接著做同一區的任務。｜Accept 1124 and 5527 first. The follow-up quests at Southwind Village share the same area.
04-45到60級.md:1372｜站內取捨｜先別交｜5085 到冬泉谷 永望鎮交；5527 在希利蘇斯 塞納里奧要塞拾取，留月光林地 永夜港交。｜Turn in 5085 at Everlook. Pick up 5527 at Cenarion Hold and save the turn-in for Nighthaven.
04-45到60級.md:1373｜站內提醒｜木喉熊怪若還會主動攻擊，先在要塞外打死木熊怪或完成費伍德森林 翡翠聖地與血毒崗哨至冬泉谷 永望鎮的聲望任務；通過要塞後可立刻接冬泉谷 永望鎮。｜If Timbermaw furbolgs still attack you, kill Deadwood furbolgs outside or finish the reputation quests from the Emerald Sanctuary and Bloodvenom Post leg through Everlook. Pick up the Everlook quests once through the tunnel.
04-45到60級.md:1376｜練怪說明｜永夜港交完可由木喉要塞回費伍德側入口補。普通死木熊怪密集，還能補木喉聲望；避開木喉守衛與帳篷內的連拉。｜After Nighthaven turn-ins, go through Timbermaw Hold to the Felwood entrance. Grind dense normal Deadwood furbolgs for rep. Avoid Timbermaw guards and pulls inside tents.
04-45到60級.md:1377｜練怪說明｜若已穿過要塞，冬泉谷一側先打沿路普通熊怪。可在多諾瓦附近補少量，主要怪群仍在永望鎮以東。｜If you're through the hold, kill normal furbolgs along the Winterspring road. Grind a little near Donova or find the main packs east of Everlook.
04-45到60級.md:1382｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1384｜危險說明｜若從月光林地走木喉要塞轉冬泉谷，先確認木喉聲望。敵對時先繞或回費伍德補聲望。｜Check your Timbermaw reputation before taking the tunnel from Moonglade to Winterspring. If Hostile, go around or return to Felwood to raise it.
04-45到60級.md:1392｜交通步驟｜出木喉要塞沿路往東，先到溫泉找多諾瓦，再進永望鎮。｜Head east from Timbermaw Hold. Visit Donova at Frostfire Hot Springs before entering Everlook.
04-45到60級.md:1399｜步驟說明｜只有洞內成年的女族長、雪人王掉落，低階雪人留給前段任務。｜Only the cave's adult matriarchs and patriarchs drop it. Skip the lower-level yetis.
04-45到60級.md:1399｜標籤｜掉率 10%｜Drop rate: 10%
04-45到60級.md:1401｜步驟說明｜接完先在永望鎮對萊加奇（61.54, 38.61）使用機械雪人，另外兩人安戈洛環形山 馬紹爾營地順路。｜Use the Mechanical Yeti on Legacki in Everlook (61.54, 38.61), then on two in Un'Goro.
04-45到60級.md:1402｜交通步驟｜選做取蛋或已組好厄運之槌隊伍時才飛菲拉斯莫沙徹營地；兩項都跳過就從永望鎮直飛加基森。｜Fly to Camp Mojache only for the optional egg or a ready Dire Maul group. Otherwise fly straight from Everlook to Gadgetzan.
04-45到60級.md:1404｜站內交通｜第 1 步從木喉要塞出來先停溫泉，末步依是否要繞菲拉斯 亂羽高地選航線。｜At step 1, stop at Frostfire Hot Springs after leaving Timbermaw Hold. At the last step, pick a flight route based on whether you're detouring to Frayfeather Highlands.
04-45到60級.md:1405｜站內取捨｜先別交｜3912 在塔納利斯 加基森解。5086 到費伍德森林 鐵木森林刷物品，回冬泉谷 冰火溫泉交。｜Do 3912 in Gadgetzan. Farm the item for 5086 in Irontree Woods, then turn it in at Frostfire Hot Springs.
04-45到60級.md:1406｜站內取捨｜值得做｜5163 會沿同一路線跑三張圖，接了就先在永望鎮用一次。｜Quest 5163 takes you through three zones along this route. Use the Mechanical Yeti in Everlook first.
04-45到60級.md:1407｜站內提醒｜還差 57 級就先在冰薊嶺（約 66, 43）打普通雪人，或在菲拉斯 亂羽高地打角鷹獸。｜Below level 57? Grind normal yetis on Ice Thistle Hills (around 66, 43) or hippogryphs in Frayfeather Highlands.
04-45到60級.md:1410｜練怪說明｜冰薊嶺洞口的普通雪人，任務需要的角也會掉。人多可打外坡，洞內留意連拉。｜Normal yetis outside the Ice Thistle Hills cave drop the quest horns. Use the outer slope if it's busy. Watch for extra pulls inside.
04-45到60級.md:1411｜練怪說明｜同一帶的高等普通雪人，補到 57 的經驗較合適。隊友先清窄道，避免兩隻同時進戰。｜Higher-level normal yetis in the same area are good through 57. Let a teammate clear narrow passages to avoid double pulls.
04-45到60級.md:1417｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1419｜危險說明｜冰薊丘的洞道窄，57–58 級雪人會在轉角連拉。缺經驗先打洞口外側。｜The Ice Thistle Hills cave is narrow. Level 57–58 yetis can pull together around the bends. Grind outside the entrance if you just need XP.
04-45到60級.md:1427｜交通步驟｜從莫沙徹營地沿南路到亂羽高地；點角鷹獸蛋（55.91, 76.03 或 58.62, 75.53），拿 1 顆就回飛點。｜Take the south road from Camp Mojache to the Frayfeather Highlands. Loot one Hippogryph Egg (55.91, 76.03 or 58.62, 75.53), then return to the flight master.
04-45到60級.md:1427｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:1428｜交通步驟｜取蛋者回莫沙徹營地飛加基森。跳過菲拉斯的角色到加基森直接開始安戈洛環形山 馬紹爾營地。｜If you collected an egg, return to Camp Mojache and fly to Gadgetzan. If you skipped Feralas, start the Marshal's Refuge leg from Gadgetzan.
04-45到60級.md:1430｜站內交通｜第 1 步為南下取蛋的停靠點，第 2 步飛加基森。｜Step 1 is a stop for the egg on the way south. Fly to Gadgetzan at step 2.
04-45到60級.md:1431｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜超級測蛋器（The Super Egg-O-Matic）的一次性交件，已做過或已達 57 級且想省跑圖時，可以直接飛加基森。｜Skip the one-time The Super Egg-O-Matic turn-in if you've already done it, or if you're level 57 and want to save travel time. Fly straight to Gadgetzan.
04-45到60級.md:1432｜站內提醒｜未到 57 級可在亂羽高地（約 57, 76）打普通角鷹獸，或者冬泉谷 永望鎮打冰薊雪人後直接搭機。｜Below level 57? Grind normal hippogryphs in Frayfeather Highlands (around 57, 76), or kill Ice Thistle yetis by Everlook before flying.
04-45到60級.md:1435｜練怪說明｜菲拉斯短訪只有角鷹獸蛋支線。缺 57 級可在上一站離開永望鎮前補，冰薊嶺雪人等級較高；洞口可能有人搶。｜The Feralas stop is just for the hippogryph egg. If below 57, grind the higher-level Ice Thistle yetis before leaving Everlook. The cave mouth may be busy.
04-45到60級.md:1441｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1442｜標籤｜僅法師,薩滿,牧師,聖騎士,術士,德魯伊｜Mage/Shaman/Priest/Paladin/Warlock/Druid only
04-45到60級.md:1450｜交通步驟｜先在加基森完成墓園交接。做機械雪人任務的角色也留在鎮內，等使用過雪人再走南路。｜Finish the graveyard turn-ins in Gadgetzan first. If you're on the Mechanical Yeti quest, use it in town before taking the south road.
04-45到60級.md:1451｜步驟說明｜用菲拉斯 亂羽高地撿的 1 顆蛋；已做過就直接跳過。｜Use an egg from the Frayfeather Highlands in Feralas. Skip if already done.
04-45到60級.md:1451｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:1452｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:1453｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:1454｜步驟說明｜喝下會死亡；先用靈魂完成交談，再回墓園復活。｜Drinking it kills you. Talk while dead, then resurrect at the graveyard.
04-45到60級.md:1460｜交通步驟｜先對加基森的斯普琳科（1446 51.06, 26.87）使用機械雪人，再沿南路入環形山。｜Use the Mechanical Yeti on Sprinkle in Gadgetzan (1446 51.06, 26.87), then take the south road into Un'Goro.
04-45到60級.md:1463｜步驟說明｜打開托爾瓦的麻袋，先放肉塊，再用費洛蒙引出拉克維。｜Open Torwa's pouch. Set down the meat, then use the pheromones to lure Lar'korwi.
04-45到60級.md:1463｜標籤｜掉率 100%｜Drop rate: 100%
04-45到60級.md:1464｜步驟目標｜安戈洛猩猩／安戈洛猩猩／安戈洛巨猩猩／安戈洛大猩猩｜Un'Goro Gorilla / Un'Goro Gorilla / Un'Goro Stomper / Un'Goro Thunderer
04-45到60級.md:1464｜標籤｜掉率 19%｜Drop rate: 19%
04-45到60級.md:1473｜步驟說明｜前兩人沿冬泉谷 永望鎮及本段轉場完成；在這裡對奎克希爾使用後留冬泉谷 霜語峽谷交。｜Use the yeti on Quixxil here after the first two targets. Turn in at Frostwhisper Gorge.
04-45到60級.md:1476｜步驟說明｜有反應才算完成，不用跳進熔岩。｜Wait for the reaction to count. Stay out of the lava.
04-45到60級.md:1479｜步驟說明｜護送前先清洞口；林格倒下時用斯普拉格的水壺叫醒他。｜Clear the cave entrance before escorting. Wake Ringo with Spraggle's Canteen.
04-45到60級.md:1493｜步驟說明｜進洞時先清外層猩猩，尤爾查本身為普通怪。｜Clear the gorillas at the cave entrance. U'cha is a normal mob.
04-45到60級.md:1493｜標籤｜掉率 100%｜Drop rate: 100%
04-45到60級.md:1495｜交通步驟｜由安戈洛西北坡進希利蘇斯，沿路直上塞納里奧要塞。｜Use Un'Goro's northwest ramp into Silithus. Follow the road to Cenarion Hold.
04-45到60級.md:1497｜站內交通｜第 1、11 步經加基森，沿途用機械雪人，末步走西北坡去希利蘇斯。｜Pass through Gadgetzan at steps 1 and 11, and use the Mechanical Yeti along the way. At the last step, take the northwest slope into Silithus.
04-45到60級.md:1498｜站內取捨｜先別交｜980 到冬泉谷 冰火溫泉交，5163 到永望鎮交；3942 留費伍德森林 鐵木森林。｜Turn in 980 at Frostfire Hot Springs and 5163 at Everlook. Save 3942 for Irontree Woods.
04-45到60級.md:1499｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜2741 只在撿到蛋且還能交時出發；沒撿的不用折返。｜Go for 2741 only if you picked up an egg and can still turn it in. Otherwise, don't backtrack.
04-45到60級.md:1500｜站內提醒｜同為 57–59 級帶。要補進度可打火羽山普通元素或北側猩猩，留意平原巡邏的魔暴龍。｜This leg is still for levels 57–59. If behind on XP, grind normal elementals on Fire Plume Ridge or gorillas to the north. Watch for devilsaurs on the flats.
04-45到60級.md:1503｜練怪說明｜火羽山的普通元素，等級較高且可順做火山任務。沿山腰拉，別進入魔暴龍巡邏的平原。｜Higher-level normal elementals at Fire Plume Ridge. Pair with the volcano quest. Pull along the slope and avoid devilsaur patrols on the plain.
04-45到60級.md:1504｜練怪說明｜馬紹爾營地附近的普通焦油怪，差一點就升級時可從營地出發打幾輪。沿池邊單拉。｜Normal tar mobs near Marshal's Refuge. Do a few laps for the last bit of XP. Pull singles from the pool edge.
04-45到60級.md:1509｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1512｜危險說明｜火羽山南側平原有 54–56 級精英魔暴龍。護送林格前先觀察路線，走山腰避開平原。｜Level 54–56 elite devilsaurs patrol the flats south of Fire Plume Ridge. Scout the route before escorting Ringo and stick to the slope.
04-45到60級.md:1520｜交通步驟｜塞納里奧城堡｜Cenarion Hold
04-45到60級.md:1520｜步驟說明｜抵達塞納里奧要塞後，向魯克·馴風者開部落飛行點。｜Unlock the Horde flight path with Runk Windtamer at Cenarion Hold.
04-45到60級.md:1521｜交通步驟｜可在旅店（1451 51.89, 39.16）綁爐石，跑完勇士之墓後用。｜Set your hearth at the inn (1451 51.89, 39.16) if you want to use it after Valor's Rest.
04-45到60級.md:1528｜標籤｜掉率 18%｜Drop rate: 18%
04-45到60級.md:1534｜標籤｜掉率 34%｜Drop rate: 34%
04-45到60級.md:1547｜步驟說明｜亡靈死後可能生出異種蠍，先處理再拉下一隻。｜Undead can spawn a silithid when killed. Kill it before the next pull.
04-45到60級.md:1550｜步驟說明｜清塔梯的怪再開物件，塔裡視線窄。｜Clear the tower stairs before opening the object. Watch your line of sight.
04-45到60級.md:1550｜標籤｜掉率 100%｜Drop rate: 100%
04-45到60級.md:1553｜交通步驟｜回塞納里奧要塞；若這站已綁爐石，這時可用。｜Return to Cenarion Hold. Hearth if bound here.
04-45到60級.md:1556｜交通步驟｜從要塞飛回奧格瑪，在杜洛塔轉提里斯法飛艇。｜Fly from Cenarion Hold to Orgrimmar, then take the Tirisfal zeppelin from Durotar.
04-45到60級.md:1558｜站內交通｜第 1 步開塞納里奧要塞飛行點，最後一步轉飛艇回東部王國。｜Unlock the Cenarion Hold flight path at step 1. At the final step, take the zeppelin back to the Eastern Kingdoms.
04-45到60級.md:1559｜站內取捨｜先別交｜5527、6844 留到月光林地交。｜Save 5527 and 6844 for the Moonglade turn-in.
04-45到60級.md:1560｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜8282 要從要塞再跑一次地圖最南端；8283 要殺精英，練等路線可略過。｜Skip 8282 and 8283 if you're leveling. Quest 8282 sends you back to the far south, and 8283 requires an elite kill.
04-45到60級.md:1561｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜影片提及的暗翼蝠 6135 在東瘟疫；希利蘇斯這站也略過組隊精英。｜The video's Duskwing quest (6135) is in Eastern Plaguelands. Skip the elite group quests in Silithus as well.
04-45到60級.md:1562｜站內提醒｜未滿 59 級仍可先到西瘟疫之地 亡靈壁壘；要補則留在要塞東北（約 55, 29）打普通蠍、蜘蛛或西南暮光教徒（約 38, 44）。｜Head to the Bulwark even if below level 59. To grind first, kill normal scorpids and spiders northeast of Cenarion Hold (around 55, 29) or Twilight cultists to the southwest (around 38, 44).
04-45到60級.md:1565｜練怪說明｜暮光營地外側普通教徒，等級正合適、掉暮光裝，可順做教徒任務。會遇到收裝玩家，從營邊清。｜Normal Twilight cultists outside the camp are good XP and drop Twilight gear. Pair with the cultist quests. Clear from the edge if others are farming gear.
04-45到60級.md:1566｜練怪說明｜要塞東北空地的普通怪，等級稍低但密度好，與採任務材料同路。若暮光營地人多可替換。｜Normal mobs in the clearing northeast of Cenarion Hold are slightly lower-level but dense. Farm on the material-gathering route if the Twilight camp is busy.
04-45到60級.md:1572｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1573｜標籤｜僅法師,薩滿,牧師,聖騎士,術士,德魯伊,盜賊｜Mage/Shaman/Priest/Paladin/Warlock/Druid/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1575｜危險說明｜南風村塔頂會觸發異種蠍群。先清塔內和樓梯，把退路留到觸發後。｜Reaching the top of the Southwind Village tower triggers a silithid swarm. Clear the tower and stairs first so you have a way out.
04-45到60級.md:1583｜交通步驟｜由提里斯法飛艇塔往亡靈壁壘，再走費爾斯通農場、安多哈爾與北山伐木場。｜Go from the Tirisfal zeppelin tower to the Bulwark, then through Felstone Field, Andorhal and Northridge Lumber Camp.
04-45到60級.md:1587｜★獎勵物品名｜英勇短劍｜Valiant Shortsword
04-45到60級.md:1587｜★獎勵職業｜聖騎士／法師／術士｜Paladin/Mage/Warlock
04-45到60級.md:1589｜★獎勵物品名｜英勇短劍｜Valiant Shortsword
04-45到60級.md:1589｜★獎勵職業｜聖騎士／法師／術士｜Paladin/Mage/Warlock
04-45到60級.md:1594｜步驟說明｜食屍鬼在農場移動，先找農場南側。｜The ghoul patrols the farm. Check the south side first.
04-45到60級.md:1599｜步驟說明｜安多哈爾市中心有精英巫妖，走外側到旅店。｜An elite lich is in central Andorhal. Stay on the outskirts on your way to the inn.
04-45到60級.md:1603｜步驟說明｜假書可能引出敵人；看封面並避開市中心精英。｜Check the cover. Fake books can spawn enemies. Avoid the elites in the center.
04-45到60級.md:1613｜步驟說明｜桶會引來敵人，開完就撤離。｜Opening the barrel draws enemies. Leave right after opening it.
04-45到60級.md:1615｜交通步驟｜回幽暗城飛艇塔，搭飛艇回奧格瑪，再往費伍德。｜Return to the Undercity zeppelin tower. Take the Orgrimmar zeppelin and continue to Felwood.
04-45到60級.md:1617｜站內交通｜第 1 步進亡靈壁壘，最後一步從幽暗城外搭飛艇。｜Enter the Bulwark at step 1. At the last step, take the zeppelin outside Undercity.
04-45到60級.md:1618｜站內取捨｜值得做｜費爾斯通和安多哈爾連著做，末段白蟻回程剛好一起交。｜Do Felstone Field and Andorhal on the same loop. Turn in the termite quest on your way back.
04-45到60級.md:1619｜站內取捨｜之後順路｜克羅米其餘鏈要再跑東瘟疫；有專程回去再接。｜Chromie's remaining quests send you back to Eastern Plaguelands. Save them for a return trip.
04-45到60級.md:1620｜站內提醒｜未到 59 級可在安多哈爾東側外圍（約 46, 64）或瘟疫農場打普通亡靈，再轉費伍德。｜Below level 59? Grind normal undead outside eastern Andorhal (around 46, 64) or at the plagued farms before heading to Felwood.
04-45到60級.md:1623｜練怪說明｜安多哈爾東緣的普通亡靈，回農場前能連打，請避開城內精英和多怪屋群。｜Normal undead on Andorhal's east edge. Grind here before returning to the farm. Avoid elites and packs in the buildings.
04-45到60級.md:1624｜練怪說明｜蓋羅恩農場的普通怨靈，若仍在東邊可就近補，等級較高。從農場外圍繞，避免房屋內連拉。｜Higher-level normal wraiths at Gahrron's Withering. Use this spot if you're still east. Loop the edge to avoid linking mobs indoors.
04-45到60級.md:1630｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1631｜標籤｜僅法師,薩滿,牧師,聖騎士,術士,德魯伊｜Mage/Shaman/Priest/Paladin/Warlock/Druid only
04-45到60級.md:1632｜標籤｜僅盜賊｜Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1634｜危險說明｜安多哈爾市政廳靠近 61 級精英『召喚者』阿拉基。找達隆郡的歷史時從外牆繞進出。｜Andorhal Town Hall is near Araj the Summoner, a level 61 elite. Follow the outside walls when looking for the Annals of Darrowshire.
04-45到60級.md:1642｜交通步驟｜由奧格瑪飛梣谷碎木崗哨，沿大路向北進費伍德，先到翡翠聖地與附近路邊。｜Fly from Orgrimmar to Splintertree Post. Follow the main road north into Felwood and stop at Emerald Sanctuary and along the nearby road.
04-45到60級.md:1650｜步驟說明｜先清通道再深入；洞內座標可能重疊。｜Clear the passage first. Map pins may overlap inside the cave.
04-45到60級.md:1651｜步驟說明｜銀爪由狼、熊掉落；鐵樹之心找鐵木樹人。｜Loot Silver Claws from wolves and bears. Kill Irontree treants for the heart.
04-45到60級.md:1651｜標籤｜掉率 45%｜Drop rate: 45%
04-45到60級.md:1654｜步驟說明｜若有人同行或能穩定單拉，再回暗影堡深處做。｜Return deep into Shadow Hold with a partner or if you can pull mobs one at a time.
04-45到60級.md:1654｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:1655｜步驟說明｜兩名守衛與領主位置近，先清附近巡邏。｜The guards are close to the lord. Clear the nearby patrol first.
04-45到60級.md:1655｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:1655｜標籤｜掉率 100%｜Drop rate: 100%
04-45到60級.md:1656｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:1658｜標籤｜掉率 80%｜Drop rate: 80%
04-45到60級.md:1659｜交通步驟｜沿路北上進木喉要塞，走月光林地方向。｜Go north into Timbermaw Hold and take the Moonglade exit.
04-45到60級.md:1661｜站內交通｜第 1 步由梣谷北上，末步走木喉要塞去月光林地。｜At step 1, head north from Ashenvale. At the last step, go through Timbermaw Hold to Moonglade.
04-45到60級.md:1662｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜5242 要為深處三個目標再走一次暗影堡，單人不順就略過。｜Quest 5242 requires another trip deep into Shadow Hold for three targets. Skip it if the solo run isn't worth the time.
04-45到60級.md:1663｜站內取捨｜先別交｜5086 帶到冬泉谷 冰火溫泉交。｜Bring 5086 to Frostfire Hot Springs in Winterspring to turn in.
04-45到60級.md:1664｜站內提醒｜未滿 60 級可在鐵木森林（約 49, 25）打劇毒元素和鐵木樹人，也可把差額留給冬泉谷。｜Below level 60? Grind Toxic Horrors and Irontree treants in Irontree Woods (around 49, 25), or catch up in Winterspring.
04-45到60級.md:1667｜練怪說明｜鐵木森林水池邊普通元素，能同步收劇毒水滴。等級偏低只補小差額，池邊任務玩家多時前往冬泉谷。｜Normal elementals by the Irontree Woods pool. Collect Toxic Horror Droplets as you go. They're good for a small XP gap. Move on to Winterspring if the pool is busy.
04-45到60級.md:1668｜練怪說明｜北路旁普通樹人，若水池被佔可接著打，靠道路方便繼續往木喉要塞。留意營地內施法怪。｜Normal treants by the northern road. Switch here if the pool is busy and continue along the road to Timbermaw Hold. Watch for casters inside camp.
04-45到60級.md:1675｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1677｜危險說明｜暗影堡的火盆分散在狹窄洞道。先清一段再滅火，撤退時沿原路走。｜The braziers in Shadow Hold are scattered through narrow tunnels. Clear each section before dousing its brazier. Retrace your steps to get out.
04-45到60級.md:1685｜交通步驟｜出木喉要塞走大路往永夜港，把希利蘇斯帶來的兩件物品交掉。｜Leave Timbermaw Hold and follow the main road to Nighthaven. Turn in both items from Silithus.
04-45到60級.md:1695｜交通步驟｜帶著 980 或 5086 時，由月光林地原路穿木喉要塞往冬泉谷，先到溫泉。兩件都沒有且跳過多諾瓦的支線時，才從法斯托恩（1450 32.09, 66.61）飛永望鎮。｜With 980 or 5086, go back through Timbermaw Hold to the Winterspring hot springs. If you have neither and are skipping Donova, fly to Everlook from Faustron (1450 32.09, 66.61).
04-45到60級.md:1697｜站內交通｜第 1 步步行到永夜港，末步先按手上任務選溫泉或永望鎮。｜Walk to Nighthaven at step 1. At the last step, head to Frostfire Hot Springs or Everlook, depending on your quests.
04-45到60級.md:1698｜站內取捨｜值得做｜永夜港兩位 NPC 的交接在同一座村。｜Do both Nighthaven NPC handoffs on one village visit.
04-45到60級.md:1699｜站內取捨｜之後順路｜5526 要進厄運之槌東區，留副本行程。｜Save 5526 for a Dire Maul East run.
04-45到60級.md:1700｜站內提醒｜仍在 59–60 級帶，做完直接進冬泉谷 霜語峽谷。｜This leg is still for levels 59–60. Go straight to Frostwhisper Gorge when you're done.
04-45到60級.md:1703｜練怪說明｜月光林地交件後沿要塞轉冬泉谷，到霜語峽谷北口打普通熊。怪等貼近 60，避開谷底精英。｜After Moonglade turn-ins, cross through the hold and grind normal bears near the north mouth of Frostwhisper Gorge. They're close to 60. Avoid the elites below.
04-45到60級.md:1707｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1710｜危險說明｜從月光林地轉冬泉谷時，木喉聲望仍敵對的角色不要直接穿洞，先從費伍德側處理聲望。｜Check Timbermaw reputation before crossing from Moonglade into Winterspring. If still Hostile, raise your reputation on the Felwood side before entering the tunnel.
04-45到60級.md:1718｜交通步驟｜由木喉要塞出來先到溫泉找多諾瓦，交安戈洛環形山 馬紹爾營地、費伍德森林 鐵木森林帶來的任務，再去永望鎮和南部山谷。直飛永望鎮且跳過溫泉任務者從烏米開始。｜From Timbermaw Hold, see Donova at the hot springs. Turn in the Marshal's Refuge and Irontree Woods quests, then head to Everlook and the southern valley. If you flew straight to Everlook and are skipping the hot springs quests, start with Umi.
04-45到60級.md:1724｜步驟說明｜主路信使會成隊，單人可找木喉入口或死木蒸鍋附近的落單信使。｜Find a lone courier near Timbermaw's entrance or the Deadwood cauldron.
04-45到60級.md:1724｜標籤｜掉率 100%｜Drop rate: 100%
04-45到60級.md:1726｜步驟說明｜59 級精英，旁邊有其他熊怪，有隊友再做。｜Group up for the level-59 elite and nearby furbolgs.
04-45到60級.md:1726｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:1727｜步驟說明｜先清外圈，戰後若拾到信可依需求解後續。｜Clear the outer mobs first. Follow up if the letter drops and you need the chain.
04-45到60級.md:1727｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:1728｜步驟說明｜打冬泉酋長拾到日誌才右鍵接。｜Right-click the journal if High Chief Winterfall drops it.
04-45到60級.md:1728｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:1729｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional

04-45到60級.md:1733｜步驟說明｜到峽谷入口即可，避開深處的精英。｜Stop at the gorge entrance. Avoid the elites deeper inside.
04-45到60級.md:1735｜交通步驟｜還沒到 60 級時留在峽谷北口外，刷普通瘋狂的裂齒熊。｜Below level 60? Grind normal Crazed Shardtooth bears outside the gorge's north entrance.
04-45到60級.md:1737｜站內交通｜第 1 步先到溫泉，交完永望鎮的雪人後往南，末步在峽谷北口外補怪。｜Stop at Frostfire Hot Springs first. After turning in the Everlook yeti quests, head south and grind outside the gorge's north entrance.
04-45到60級.md:1738｜站內取捨｜值得做｜5087 優先找落單的信使；4842 是探索，和影片的補怪點同路。｜Look for lone couriers for 5087. Exploration quest 4842 is on the way to the video's grind spot.
04-45到60級.md:1739｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜5121 是精英；單人直接以普通熊怪補等。｜Quest 5121 has an elite target. Grind normal bears instead if solo.
04-45到60級.md:1740｜站內提醒｜未滿 60 級就照影片在霜語峽谷北側打熊。QuestieDB 的普通瘋狂的裂齒熊點（約 57.63, 70.83／66.68, 70.57），避開谷底精英。｜Below level 60? Follow the video and grind bears north of Frostwhisper Gorge. QuestieDB lists normal Crazed Shardtooth spawns around 57.63, 70.83 and 66.68, 70.57. Avoid elites at the bottom.
04-45到60級.md:1743｜練怪說明｜霜語峽谷北口西側的普通熊，近戰、能單拉和剝皮。清完往東線輪替，別進谷底精英區。｜Normal melee bears west of the north mouth of Frostwhisper Gorge. Pull singles and skin them. Rotate east after clearing. Avoid the elites below.
04-45到60級.md:1744｜練怪說明｜峽谷北口東側的普通熊，西側有人或尚未刷新就沿坡轉來。沿坡拉回道路，避開谷底精英。｜Normal bears east of the gorge's north mouth. Switch here if the west side is busy or hasn't respawned. Pull uphill to the road away from the elites.
04-45到60級.md:1750｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1752｜危險說明｜霜語峽谷內有 59–60 級精英霜槌巨人，北口補熊時沿坡單拉，別把怪帶進谷底。｜Level 59–60 elite Frostmaul giants roam Frostwhisper Gorge. Pull bears one at a time along the slope at the north entrance and don't drag them into the gorge.
04-45到60級.md:1753｜危險說明｜暗語峽谷有 57–60 級精英赫達琳殺戮者。奇怪的源頭在北口觸發，完成就回道路。｜Level 57–60 elite Hederine Slayers roam Darkwhisper Gorge. Trigger Strange Sources at the north entrance, then return to the road.
04-45到60級.md:1762｜步驟說明｜幽暗城交完城內任務後、上飛艇前往西南找他。騎士有多個刷新點。｜After Undercity turn-ins, look southwest before boarding. The knight has several spawns.

04-45到60級.md:2046｜站內永恆交通複查｜核對火線港與熱砂港的雙向船線，補上塔納利斯端碼頭及加基森首訪地面路線。加基森、莫沙徹、瑟銀哨塔、永望鎮、月光林地與希利蘇斯飛行管理員或旅店依 QuestieDB 的 NPC 名稱、座標更新。[永恆版大河林地航線](https://www.wowhead.com/forever/guide/riverglades-zone-overview)｜The boat runs both ways between Powderfuse Port and Steamwheedle Port. Use the Tanaris dock and first-visit ground route to Gadgetzan. QuestieDB supplies the updated flight master and innkeeper names and coordinates for Gadgetzan, Camp Mojache, Thorium Point, Everlook, Moonglade, and Silithus. [Forever Riverglades travel](https://www.wowhead.com/forever/guide/riverglades-zone-overview)
04-45到60級.md:2047｜站內永恆交通複查｜斯通納德、莫沙徹和聖光之願的回訪先確認飛行點，補首訪地面替代路線。從莫沙徹飛棘齒城後再決定是否搭船交護送，預設少一次跨洲來回。｜Check your flight paths before returning to Stonard, Camp Mojache, or Light's Hope Chapel. Take the ground route on your first visit. Fly from Camp Mojache to Ratchet before deciding whether to take the boat for the escort turn-in. This normally saves a round trip across the sea.
04-45到60級.md:2048｜站內永恆交通複查｜莫沙徹爐石冷卻時走大路回營地。暴掠龍爪留奧格瑪順路交，加基森先完成墓園和機械雪人再南下，省各一趟同城折返。｜If your Hearthstone is on cooldown, take the main road back to Camp Mojache. Save the ravasaur claws for Orgrimmar. In Gadgetzan, finish the graveyard and Mechanical Yeti before heading south to save a return trip.
05-副本.md:8｜副本動線｜入口清穴居人→首廳岔路右上坡，打奧格弗林特並找瑪爾→回主路過十字熔岩橋打塔拉加曼→沿路清火刃教徒→右坡打巴札蘭，盡頭打耶戈什。｜Clear troggs at the entrance → take the first hall's right ramp to Oggleflint and Maur → cross the lava bridge for Taragaman → clear Burning Blade cultists → Bazzalan up the right ramp, then Jergosh at the end.
05-副本.md:11｜副本入口｜奧格瑪 1454 52.60, 49.00｜Orgrimmar 1454 52.60, 49.00
05-副本.md:18｜站內前置接取路線｜在貧瘠之地 十字路口開飛行點後，飛雷霆崖找拉哈羅接 5722／5723，飛奧格瑪找索爾先做 5726／5727，再去暗巷區接 5761；若此輪已開幽暗城飛點，可在飛艇跨海時先向瓦里瑪薩斯領 5725。｜Unlock the Crossroads flight path, fly to Thunder Bluff for 5722 and 5723 from Rahauro, then do 5726 and 5727 with Thrall in Orgrimmar. Pick up 5761 in the Cleft of Shadow. If you've unlocked Undercity, get 5725 from Varimathras during the crossing.

05-副本.md:66｜副本動線｜入口→安威瑪休憩地打法德林→黑鐵召喚師旁打瑪格瑪圖斯→走廊清巡邏的掠奪者→諸王聖物庫打杜爾根。｜Entrance → Fadlin at Anvilmar's Rest → Magmatus by the Dark Iron summoner → the patrolling Reaver → Durgan in the royal vault.

05-副本.md:78｜站內前置接取路線｜從貧瘠之地轉往東部王國後，只有專程成就隊才從幽暗城經銀松、希爾斯布萊德、阿拉希南下濕地，經丹奧加茲到丹莫羅再進鐵爐堡。部落前置接取點未查到。｜Only make the Ironforge trip for an organized achievement run. From Undercity, travel through Silverpine, Hillsbrad, and Arathi, then south through the Wetlands and Dun Algaz into Dun Morogh. Horde prerequisite pickups are unverified.
05-副本.md:78｜標籤｜接取錨點 02-第8站｜Pick up anchor point 02-Stop 8
05-副本.md:83｜站內說明｜本機永恆版的 96391、96393、96394、96395、96403、98423 都標聯盟；部落沒有可核實的接取路線。｜QuestieDB Forever lists 96391, 96393, 96394, 96395, 96403, and 98423 as Alliance. No Horde pickup route is verified.
05-副本.md:87｜站內說明｜可進本打法德林·安威瑪、瑪格瑪圖斯、掠奪者、杜爾根·喪鐘錘等首領。這趟以掉落或成就為主。｜Run for loot or achievements. Bosses include Faldrim Anvilmar, Magmatus, Plunder, and Durgen Dirgehammer.
05-副本.md:91｜站內說明｜部落交件未查到。｜Horde turn-in location unverified.
05-副本.md:93｜站內取捨｜練級可略過。若要做傳承成就，先約隊再去，聯盟首都守衛與 PvP 規則會增加進門難度。｜Skip while leveling. For the Legacy achievement, form your group before heading in. Alliance capital guards and PvP rules make entry harder.
05-副本.md:94｜站內說明｜城內由王座廳側門進舊鐵爐堡通道；穿到底才到副本門。暴雪確認部落可進，但需進聯盟領地。｜Take the side door in Ironforge's throne room to Old Ironforge, then follow the passage to the dungeon portal. Blizzard confirms Horde can enter through Alliance territory.
05-副本.md:99｜副本動線｜入口→國王巷打枯牙→沿路清亡靈→擊敗男爵並取紋章→墓園打拉斯梅爾，順路找西側的愛德華。市集的被遺棄者與墓園西南煙囪的維克托可選。｜Entrance → Witherfang in King's Alley → clear undead → kill the Baron and loot the crest → Rath'mael in the cemetery and Edward to the west. The Forsaken in the market and Victor by the southwest chimney are optional.
05-副本.md:102｜副本入口｜幽暗城 1458 72.41, 11.37｜Undercity 1458 72.41, 11.37
05-副本.md:110｜站內前置接取路線｜先在提里斯法林地 布瑞爾向林奈確認 356 的進度。林奈另有 99156 版本【僅獸人,不死族】。前往銀松森林前，從布瑞爾下飛艇可順路拜訪林奈與克里斯多夫；瑟伯切爾先向塔比薩領 92401，並完成 447→450→451；幽暗城鍊金房找格雷夫與莫賓。這六類任務等副本階段再交。｜Check 356 with Linnea in Brill. Linnea also offers 99156 to Orcs and Undead. Visit Linnea and Kristof after getting off the zeppelin. In the Sepulcher, take 92401 from Tabitha and finish 447 → 450 → 451. See the Apothecarium for Grave and Morbin. Save all six sets of turn-ins for the dungeon leg.

05-副本.md:167｜站內取捨｜部落在 16–20 級可優先排一場。沒有清過銀松配方線的角色，可先做銀松森林 瑟伯切爾再組本，讓枯牙一起計入。｜Horde can prioritize a run at levels 16–20. If you haven't done the Silverpine recipe chain, do the Sepulcher quests first so Witherfang counts toward the chain.
05-副本.md:168｜站內說明｜入口在幽暗城上方、提里斯法地表的王城廢墟。用幽暗城地圖座標，在進王城後上左側石階；不要走到地下電梯。｜The portal is in the Ruins of Lordaeron above Undercity. Use the Undercity map coordinates. Enter the ruins and climb the stone stairs on the left instead of taking the elevator down.
05-副本.md:173｜副本動線｜入口淺水找安娜科德拉→河西打考布萊恩→回水道往東打皮薩斯、斯卡姆、瑟芬迪斯、永生的沃爾丹→四牙王都倒後回入口護送信徒，打穆坦努斯。兩翼沿路採毒蛇花、收變異皮革和哀嚎香精，並清變異怪。｜Anacondra in the entrance shallows → Cobrahn west of the river → Pythas, Skum, Serpentis and Verdan to the east → return to the entrance after all four Fanglords, escort the Disciple and kill Mutanus. Gather Serpentbloom, Deviate Hides and Wailing Essence while clearing deviates in both wings.
05-副本.md:176｜副本入口｜貧瘠之地 1413 46.00, 36.30｜The Barrens 1413 46.00, 36.30
05-副本.md:184｜站內前置接取路線｜在貧瘠之地 十字路口找圖加完成 870→877→880，然後去雷霆崖找哈繆爾、納拉與札瑪；棘齒城先交 865 再接 1491 和 959。最後去洞口上方石台找納爾派克與厄布魯。｜Finish 870 → 877 → 880 with Tonga at the Crossroads, then visit Hamuul, Nara, and Zama in Thunder Bluff. Turn in 865 before taking 1491 and 959 in Ratchet. Find Nalpak and Ebru on the ledge above the cave entrance.

05-副本.md:217｜步驟位置｜進門沿淺水河道找毒蛇花，掃兩岸可採植株｜Follow the shallow stream and gather Serpentbloom along both banks.
05-副本.md:218｜步驟說明｜座標是副本門前外洞的變異殺戮者刷新點。｜Pins mark Deviate Slayers in the cave outside the portal.
05-副本.md:218｜標籤｜掉率 23%｜Drop rate: 23%
05-副本.md:218｜步驟位置｜淺水岔路與兩翼清變異獸，邊推首領邊拾皮｜Kill deviates at the shallow fork and in both wings. Loot hides as you go.
05-副本.md:219｜步驟位置｜淺水岔路先清，河道西、東兩翼補齊四種怪｜Clear the shallow fork, then finish all four mobs in the west and east wings.
05-副本.md:220｜步驟說明｜坐標指向門外的吞噬軟漿怪，進本後仍可繼續收集。｜Pins mark Devouring Ectoplasms outside. Oozes inside count too.
05-副本.md:220｜步驟說明｜掉率採副本門外吞噬軟漿怪。｜Drop rate: Devouring Ectoplasms outside the dungeon portal.
05-副本.md:220｜標籤｜掉率 100%｜Drop rate: 100%
05-副本.md:220｜步驟位置｜在副本內沿水道找軟泥怪，缺精華再補｜Find oozes along the stream if you're short on Wailing Essence.
05-副本.md:221｜步驟說明｜DungeonsForever 地城圖可查 Lady Anacondra；另一點 28.1,31.8（第 1 圖 30.50, 43.20）、Lord Cobrahn（第 1 圖 15.60, 58.50）、Lord Pythas（第 1 圖 85.60, 28.40）、Lord Serpentis（第 1 圖 61.60, 53.80）。｜Map 1: Anacondra 30.5,43.2; Cobrahn 15.6,58.5; Pythas 85.6,28.4; Serpentis 61.6,53.8.
05-副本.md:221｜步驟位置｜淺水找安娜科德拉，河西考布萊恩，河東另兩王｜Find Anacondra in the shallows, Cobrahn west and the other two bosses east.
05-副本.md:222｜步驟說明｜四位德魯伊清完後回入口找納拉雷克斯的信徒，完成護送和儀式，再擊殺吞噬者穆坦努斯拾碎片。｜Return to the Disciple after the four Druids. Escort him and kill Mutanus for the shard.

05-副本.md:238｜站內取捨｜沒交 865 就看不到 1491；少一條不必讓全隊在門口等。已先完成貧瘠之地 十字路口綠洲鏈，照既有進度從 1489 接續。｜Turn in 865 to unlock 1491. If you miss one quest, don't keep the group waiting at the door. If the Crossroads oasis chain is done, continue from 1489.
05-副本.md:239｜站內說明｜外洞洞口約 1413 47.70, 35.00；由繁茂綠洲進石洞穿過通道，門在更深處。納爾派克、厄布魯在外洞上方的小洞，接完再下去。｜Enter the outer cave at the Lushwater Oasis (1413 47.70, 35.00) and follow the tunnel to the portal. Pick up quests from Nalpak and Ebru in the alcove above the outer entrance first.
05-副本.md:244｜副本動線｜入口礦道→拉克佐→斯尼德伐木場順撿木材→基爾尼格熔爐→炸門進船塢→重拳先生→綠皮隊長→艾德溫·范克里夫。廚師在船下層。只需木材可在斯尼德房取完後退出。｜Mine tunnel → Rhahk'Zor → Sneed and the lumber → Gilnid's forge → blast the door to the docks → Mr. Smite → Captain Greenskin → Edwin VanCleef. Cookie is on the lower deck. Leave after Sneed if you only need the lumber.
05-副本.md:247｜副本入口｜西部荒野 1436 38.20, 77.50｜Westfall 1436 38.20, 77.50
05-副本.md:255｜站內前置接取路線｜前往銀松森林時，先在提里斯法林地 班達利昂要塞找丹妮莎接 91858，順路做完銀松、芬里斯島前置【僅不死族】【僅聖騎士】。滿 20 級在瑟伯切爾向露蜜娜接 95036 並找崔凡拿筆記【僅不死族】【僅聖騎士】。從貧瘠之地 棘齒城搭船去藏寶海灣，沿荊棘谷北上暮色森林，再向西到月溪鎮。｜On the way to Silverpine, take 91858 from Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal and finish the Silverpine and Fenris Isle prerequisites. At level 20, take 95036 from Lumina in the Sepulcher and get the notes from Trevan. These quests are for Undead Paladins. Take the Ratchet boat to Booty Bay, then ride north through Stranglethorn into Duskwood and west to Moonbrook.

05-副本.md:289｜步驟說明｜必須備妥武器筆記、白石橡木、影牙城堡的附魔銀錠、95042 的淨化過的科爾寶石才交。｜Bring the notes, Whitestone Oak, Enchanted Silver Bar and Purified Kor Gem.
05-副本.md:291｜站內取捨｜純練級可略過這趟。做 95036 打到斯尼德房間收齊木料即可【僅不死族】【僅聖騎士】。隊伍想拿尾王裝備可繼續打完。｜Skip this trip if you're just leveling. For 95036, reach Sneed's room and collect the lumber (Undead Paladins only). Keep going if the group wants loot from the final boss.
05-副本.md:291｜標籤｜僅不死族｜Undead only
05-副本.md:291｜標籤｜僅聖騎士｜Paladin only
05-副本.md:292｜站內說明｜月溪鎮的礦井入口約 1436 42.40, 70.40，先進建築下樓，再循坑道到 38.20, 77.50 的正式門。聯盟接的迪菲亞任務不列入部落。｜Enter the mine building at Moonbrook (1436 42.40, 70.40), go downstairs, and follow the tunnel to the portal at 38.20, 77.50. The Alliance Defias quests are unavailable to Horde.
05-副本.md:297｜副本動線｜入口打雷希戈爾並放出阿達曼特→庭院右側找文森特→穿過宴會廳與城牆→芬魯斯房取書→沿塔路清怪，打狼王南杜斯→上樓打阿魯高並查桌面。｜Kill Rethilgore and free Adamant → find Vincent on the right side of the courtyard → banquet hall and ramparts → Fenrus's room for the book → clear the tower to Wolf Master Nandos → kill Arugal upstairs and check his table.
05-副本.md:300｜副本入口｜銀松森林 1421 44.70, 67.80｜Silverpine Forest 1421 44.70, 67.80
05-副本.md:308｜站內前置接取路線｜前往銀松森林前，路過幽暗城時在鍊金區先接 1013，到瑟伯切爾找哈德瑞克和達拉爾接 1098、1014。可在貧瘠之地 陶拉祖營地東側接 1740【僅術士】。先做死亡礦坑章節的 91858 至 95036，保留 95036【僅不死族】【僅聖騎士】。往希爾斯布萊德途中，回東部王國後可先飛銀松森林 瑟伯切爾，再向南走。｜Before Silverpine, pick up 1013 in the Apothecarium, then take 1098 and 1014 from Hadrec and Dalar at the Sepulcher. Warlocks can pick up 1740 east of Camp Taurajo. Undead Paladins should follow the Deadmines chain from 91858 to 95036 and keep 95036 active. On the way to Hillsbrad, fly to the Sepulcher after returning to the Eastern Kingdoms, then go south.

05-副本.md:331｜步驟說明｜梣谷 碎木崗哨黑暗深淵的三枚小碎片齊了，再回貧瘠之地交。｜Loot all 3 small fragments in Blackfathom Deeps, then turn in in the Barrens.
05-副本.md:333｜站內取捨｜1013 與 1014 都要回外面交；1098 在本內交給文森特。22 級前隊伍若不穩，可先做羅德隆廢墟或哀嚎洞穴。｜Turn in 1013 and 1014 outside the dungeon. Turn in 1098 to Vincent inside. If your group is struggling before level 22, try the Ruins of Lordaeron or Wailing Caverns first.
05-副本.md:334｜站內說明｜瑟伯切爾南下，沿焚木村北側坡道進堡，過外門走到庭院旁真正的副本門。想打達拉然城隱藏首領，另從阿魯高桌上取 Black Tome，再去安伯米爾大廳的地脈裝置製成 Tome of Dalaran。｜Head south from the Sepulcher. Take the ramp north of Pyrewood Village into the keep, then go through the outer gate to the dungeon portal by the courtyard. For the City of Dalaran's hidden boss, take the Black Tome from Arugal's table. Use Ambermill's Leyline Device to make the Tome of Dalaran.
05-副本.md:339｜副本動線｜從東側入口往西穿沼澤打鹽脊→沿草叢小徑打灌木迅猛龍與暗齒→走西南側營區清龍喉→南行至挖掘場啟動守護者旁面板，打倒守護者後拾聖物。｜From the east entrance, head west through the marsh to Saltspine → take the brushy trail for Thicket Raptors and Shadetooth → clear Dragonmaw in the southwest camp → activate the panel at the dig site and loot the relic from the Relic Guardian.
05-副本.md:342｜副本入口｜溼地 1437 47.79, 56.16｜Wetlands (1437), 47.79, 56.16.
05-副本.md:350｜站內前置接取路線｜石爪山脈 烈日石居已滿24可從石爪山飛奧格瑪，暗巷區找博斯坦接 95697。塔倫米爾離站後，先往阿拉希落錘鎮找薩魯克接 95663，再過薩多爾大橋與丹莫德，走瑟根石一帶山路找亡靈衛兵密探；接 95682 後才進本。｜At level 24, fly from Stonetalon to Orgrimmar and take 95697 from Borstan in the Cleft of Shadow. After Tarren Mill, pick up 95663 from Zaruk at Hammerfall. Cross the Thandol Span and pass Dun Modr, then follow the mountain road near Thelgen Rock to the Deathstalker Agent. Accept 95682 before entering.

05-副本.md:377｜站內取捨｜打滿一次可同時收肉、龍喉急件和尾王聖物。最後一段要回卡林多，跟下一趟奧格瑪／雷霆崖行程一起交。｜A full run covers the meat, the Dragonmaw dispatch, and the relic from the final boss. Save the last Kalimdor turn-in for the next Orgrimmar or Thunder Bluff visit.
05-副本.md:378｜站內說明｜正式藍色門在維爾加挖掘場東南方的高坡。集合石、亡靈衛兵密探與副本門是不同點。｜The blue portal is up the slope southeast of Whelgar's Excavation Site. The Meeting Stone, Deathstalker Agent, and portal are at separate locations.
05-副本.md:383｜副本動線｜沿水洞到加摩拉的海龜池，從水下側洞找塞爾瑞德→經薩利維絲女士和格里哈斯特的岔洞到暮光營區找洛古斯。暮光營區順路收碎片。【僅術士】從月神祭壇廢墟橋下點石、打阿奎尼斯並取水球→回聖所打克爾里斯→全隊準備好再逐一點火，進阿庫麥爾巢穴。｜Follow the flooded cave to Ghamoo-ra's pool and find Thaelrid in the underwater side cave → past Lady Sarevess and Gelihast to Lorgus Jett in the Twilight camp. Warlocks loot shards there. Use the stone under the bridge for Aquanis and his globe → Kelris → get the group ready before lighting all four braziers for Aku'mai.
05-副本.md:383｜標籤｜僅術士｜Warlock only

05-副本.md:393｜站內前置接取路線｜在石爪山脈 烈日石居找蘇納曼接 6562，留到梣谷 佐拉姆加前哨站找耶努薩克雷。貧瘠之地 棘齒城與陶拉祖營地可先接 1740【僅術士】。在銀松森林 瑟伯切爾接好 95036 並留在日誌【僅不死族】【僅聖騎士】。到梣谷 佐拉姆海岸先接 6563／6921，外洞取得便箋時先回前哨交再進本。再接 95042【僅不死族】【僅聖騎士】。｜Accept 6562 from Tsunaman at Sun Rock Retreat and save it for Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar. Warlocks can take 1740 on the Barrens leg. Undead Paladins should keep 95036 from the Sepulcher in their log. Pick up 6563 and 6921 on the Zoram Strand. If you loot the note in the outer cave, turn it in at the outpost before entering. Undead Paladins can then take 95042.

05-副本.md:431｜站內說明｜由佐拉姆海岸西北的廢墟外洞進水，沿水道穿進洞窟，走到深處才是副本門。克爾里斯周圍的火盆會各自觸發一波怪，分次點。｜Swim in from the ruins at the northwest end of the Zoram Strand. Follow the submerged passage through the cave to the dungeon portal. The braziers around Kelris each trigger a wave. Light them one at a time.
05-副本.md:436｜副本動線｜入口走廊清十字軍並收心臟→審訊室打韋沙斯，找拷問架上的沃瑞爾→穿過露天墓園，下墓穴階梯打血法師薩爾諾斯。｜Clear Crusaders and loot hearts in the entry hall → kill Vishas and find Vorrel on the rack → cross the open cemetery and descend to Bloodmage Thalnos.
05-副本.md:439｜副本入口｜提里斯法林地 1420 85.20, 32.10｜Tirisfal Glades 1420 85.20, 32.10
05-副本.md:447｜站內前置接取路線｜經希爾斯布萊德丘陵 塔倫米爾時可先開飛行點；從幽暗城沿提里斯法林地北路到修道院。先完成剃刀沼澤 1109（若先跑千針石林才去剃刀沼澤，把 1113 留到轉往奧特蘭克山脈途中接；墓地可先打沃瑞爾），在幽暗城煉金區找法拉尼爾；離開墓地之後要到奧特蘭克湖岸與塔倫米爾。｜Unlock Tarren Mill on the way, then follow the north road through Tirisfal from Undercity to the monastery. Finish Razorfen Kraul quest 1109 first. If you run RFK after Thousand Needles, save 1113 for the Alterac Mountains leg and do Vorrel in the Graveyard now. See Faranell in the Apothecarium. After the Graveyard, head to the Alterac lakeshore and Tarren Mill.
05-副本.md:447｜標籤｜接取錨點 03-第15站｜Pick up anchor point 03-Stop 15

05-副本.md:473｜副本動線｜進本在下水道入口接哥布林任務→打阿崔希斯，想打林恩再進符文密室→從右路上街，沿途收構裝體核心並到城堡左側樓上書架找書→紫羅蘭城堡會客室開傳送門，擊敗大法師之影。離本前回下水道入口找瑞克希交書。｜Pick up the goblin quests at the sewer entrance → kill Atrexis, then optionally enter the rune chamber for Lynn → take the right path to the street and loot construct cores → get the book upstairs left of the Citadel → portal to the Violet Parlor for the Archmage's Shade. Turn the book in to Rexxie by the entrance.
05-副本.md:476｜副本入口｜奧特蘭克山脈 1416 8.46, 59.21｜Alterac Mountains 1416 8.46, 59.21
05-副本.md:484｜站內前置接取路線｜塔倫米爾可先接梅里薩拉的 96986，經幽暗城時向馬丁醫生接 96988。希爾斯布萊德丘陵 塔倫米爾到30級向沃迪恩接 544／93680，沿洛丹米爾湖東南到收容所，同一趟取血石和污穢鑰匙；回塔倫米爾交後接 545，完成再接 92434。繞湖岸向莫德菈的影像報到，接 96984 後把下水道鑰匙留在身上。｜Take 96986 from Melisara in Tarren Mill and 96988 from Doctor Martin Felben in Undercity. At level 30, take 544 and 93680 from Wordeen. Go southeast along Lordamere Lake to the internment camp for both the bloodstone and the key. Turn in at Tarren Mill, then do 545 and take 92434. Follow the lakeshore to Modera's image, take 96984, and keep the sewer key.

05-副本.md:523｜站內取捨｜部落前置從30級起，建議先做好開門任務再招募。隊伍有鑰匙可先確認誰能開門；有自己的鑰匙便於再訪。隊伍想打隱藏首領 Lyn the Ignored，再帶從影牙城堡起手製成的 Tome of Dalaran。｜Horde prerequisites start at level 30. Finish the access quest before forming a group. Check who has the key, and get your own for later runs. Bring the Tome of Dalaran from Shadowfang Keep if your group wants Lyn the Ignored.
05-副本.md:524｜站內說明｜莫德菈影像與正式門在不同點；走洛丹米爾湖的下水道側。戶外達拉然城門與城內 NPC 通行受陣營規則限制。｜Modera's image and the dungeon portal are at separate spots. Approach from the Lordamere Lake sewer side. Faction restrictions apply to the outdoor city gates and NPC access.
05-副本.md:529｜副本動線｜過入口畫廊到左手小室取書→經前庭打馴犬者洛克希→在長廊末段與杜安前的書架分別取書→擊敗奧法師杜安，開身後箱取血色十字軍鑰匙。｜Take the book from the small left room past the gallery → kill Houndmaster Loksey → collect the books from the last corridor and the shelf before Doan → kill Arcanist Doan and loot the Scarlet Key from the strongbox behind him.
05-副本.md:532｜副本入口｜提里斯法林地 1420 85.20, 32.10｜Tirisfal Glades 1420 85.20, 32.10
05-副本.md:540｜站內前置接取路線｜阿拉希高地 落錘鎮回幽暗城再去圖書館；千針石林 亂風崗先做多恩 1149→1150→1151。已走過石爪山脈 烈日石居時，可在梣谷南線由隧道去布勞格，再到幽暗城找帕科瓦。路過雷霆崖時可順接 1049【僅獸人,牛頭人,食人妖】。可在 千針石林 閃光平原、塵泥沼澤 蕨牆村跑塔貝薩和提爾斯的前置，書可之後回東部王國時補拿【僅法師】。｜Fly from Hammerfall to Undercity for the Library. Do Dorn's 1149 → 1150 → 1151 chain at Freewind Post first. If you've done Sun Rock Retreat, use the south Ashenvale tunnel to Braug, then see Parqual in Undercity. Orcs, Tauren, and Trolls can take 1049 in Thunder Bluff. Mages can do Tabetha's and Tirth's prerequisites at Shimmering Flats and Brackenwall Village, then get the book on the next Eastern Kingdoms visit.

05-副本.md:586｜交通步驟｜擊殺馴犬者洛克希，記入深入血色修道院 1048。｜Kill Houndmaster Loksey for Into The Scarlet Monastery (1048).
05-副本.md:587｜交通步驟｜擊殺奧法師杜安後，開他身後的保險箱，拾血色十字軍鑰匙。｜Kill Arcanist Doan and loot the Scarlet Key from the strongbox behind him.

05-副本.md:595｜站內取捨｜先取血色十字軍鑰匙，可接著開軍械庫與大教堂；書類任務可一起拾。｜Get the Scarlet Key to open the Armory and Cathedral. Pick up the quest books on the same run.
05-副本.md:596｜站內說明｜1048 橫跨三翼，完整做／交列在大教堂。｜Quest 1048 spans three wings. See the Cathedral section for the full clear and turn-in.
05-副本.md:599｜副本動線｜開門進軍械庫→沿營房和長廊到底→在大廳打赫洛德→清後續進場的血色學員。｜Open the Armory door → follow the barracks and hall to Herod → clear the Scarlet Trainees after he dies.
05-副本.md:602｜副本入口｜提里斯法林地 1420 85.20, 32.10｜Tirisfal Glades 1420 85.20, 32.10
05-副本.md:609｜站內前置接取路線｜由阿拉希高地 落錘鎮飛幽暗城，可與圖書館同趟；在幽暗城皇家區瓦里瑪薩斯處接 1048，需 33 級；若在圖書館已接，保留任務並帶上血色十字軍鑰匙。從幽暗城走提里斯法林地北路到修道院。｜Fly from Hammerfall to Undercity and pair the Armory with the Library. At level 33, pick up 1048 from Varimathras in the Royal Quarter. If you already have it, keep it active and bring the Scarlet Key. Follow the north road through Tirisfal to the monastery.
05-副本.md:609｜標籤｜接取錨點 03-第16站｜Pick up anchor point 03-Stop 16
05-副本.md:611｜副本入口｜由大堂朝四門看，右數第二道鎖門；座標是室外修道院入口，進大堂後依門序找實際傳送門。｜Take the second door from the right. It is locked. The coordinates mark the outdoor entrance.
05-副本.md:615｜交通步驟｜在幽暗城確認 1048 已接，若未接依圖書館段補接。｜Check for 1048 in Undercity. If missing, see the Library section for the pickup.
05-副本.md:619｜交通步驟｜擊殺勇士赫洛德，記入深入血色修道院 1048；旋風時近戰拉開。｜Kill Herod for Into The Scarlet Monastery (1048). Melee should back out during Whirlwind.
05-副本.md:623｜交通步驟｜深入血色修道院先留著，接著打大教堂；四名首領都完成才回幽暗城交。｜Keep Into The Scarlet Monastery for Cathedral. Turn it in at Undercity after all four bosses.
05-副本.md:623｜步驟說明｜軍械庫後保留，繼續大教堂。｜Keep the quest after Armory and continue to Cathedral.
05-副本.md:625｜站內取捨｜已有鑰匙的隊伍可直接清軍械庫。｜If someone has the Scarlet Key, head straight to the Armory.
05-副本.md:626｜站內說明｜帶血色十字軍鑰匙，或請隊友中開鎖技能達 １７５ 點的盜賊開門。｜Bring the Scarlet Key, or have a Rogue with 175 Lockpicking open the door.
05-副本.md:629｜副本動線｜穿過噴泉庭院上階梯→正殿打莫格萊尼→懷特邁恩復活莫格萊尼→擊敗兩人。｜Cross the fountain courtyard and go up the steps → kill Mograine in the Cathedral → wait for Whitemane to resurrect him → kill both.
05-副本.md:632｜副本入口｜提里斯法林地 1420 85.20, 32.10｜Tirisfal Glades 1420 85.20, 32.10
05-副本.md:640｜站內前置接取路線｜由阿拉希高地 落錘鎮飛幽暗城，滿 35 可和圖書館、軍械庫一起打。前往希爾斯布萊德丘陵途中，經過幽暗城時可先看皇家區瓦里瑪薩斯，33 級才接 1048；若尚未滿 35 級，可在回東部王國去奧特蘭克山脈時一起打。帶血色十字軍鑰匙與圖書館、軍械庫的擊殺進度。｜Fly from Hammerfall to Undercity. At level 35, run the Cathedral with the Library and Armory. On the Hillsbrad leg, check Varimathras in the Royal Quarter for 1048 at level 33. Below 35? Save the run for the Alterac Mountains return. Bring the Scarlet Key and finish the Library and Armory kills.
05-副本.md:640｜標籤｜接取錨點 03-第16站｜Pick up anchor point 03-Stop 16
05-副本.md:642｜副本入口｜由大堂朝四門看，左數第二道鎖門；座標是室外修道院入口，進大堂後依門序找實際傳送門。｜Take the second door from the left. It is locked. The coordinates mark the outdoor entrance.
05-副本.md:646｜交通步驟｜確認任務日誌有深入血色修道院 1048；接取詳見圖書館。｜Check that Into The Scarlet Monastery (1048) is in your log. See the Library section for the pickup.
05-副本.md:650｜步驟說明｜大教堂先清房間周圍；懷特邁恩會復活莫格萊尼。｜Clear around the room first. Whitemane resurrects Mograine.
05-副本.md:650｜步驟說明｜DungeonsForever 地城圖可查大檢察官懷特邁恩；莫格萊尼 49.0,27.5（第 1 圖 49.10, 16.00）。｜Map 1: Whitemane (49.10, 16.00). Mograine: 49.0, 27.5.
05-副本.md:650｜步驟位置｜穿過噴泉庭院上階梯，進正殿打雙王。｜Cross the fountain courtyard and go up the steps. Kill both Cathedral bosses.
05-副本.md:650｜步驟順序｜莫格萊尼→懷特邁恩復活→雙王｜Kill Mograine → Whitemane resurrects him → fight both.
05-副本.md:654｜步驟說明｜四個首領都計入後回幽暗城皇家區。｜Turn in at Undercity's Royal Quarter after all four bosses count.
05-副本.md:656｜站內取捨｜若尚缺洛克希或赫洛德，先回相應分區，再一起回城。｜Still need Loksey or Herod? Return to the corresponding wing before heading back to town.
05-副本.md:657｜站內說明｜帶血色十字軍鑰匙，或請隊友中開鎖技能達 １７５ 點的盜賊開門。｜Bring the Scarlet Key, or have a Rogue with 175 Lockpicking open the door.
05-副本.md:660｜副本動線｜入口荊棘道沿路用地鼠找藍葉薯→走支路打魯古格→賈格巴→拉姆塔斯→蝙蝠洞收糞便→卡爾加小屋打王、拾心臟與任務物品→路清完再回尾王旁營帳，護送威利克斯到入口。｜Use the gopher for Blueleaf Tubers along the bramble path → Roogug on the side path → Jargba → Ramtusk → bat guano in the cave → Charlga's hut for her heart and quest loot → return to Willix's tent and escort him to the entrance.
05-副本.md:663｜副本入口｜貧瘠之地 1413 約 42.30, 89.90（荊棘通道的副本門附近）｜The Barrens (1413), near the portal in the thorn tunnel, about 42.30, 89.90.
05-副本.md:671｜站內前置接取路線｜前往千針石林時可順路進本。在貧瘠之地 棘齒城可先接 1221 並拿地鼠工具；前往希爾斯布萊德丘陵途中，經過幽暗城時找法拉尼爾接 1109；進本前若經雷霆崖找奧爾德接 1102。可從千針石林 亂風崗出發，經大升降梯回貧瘠之地，走西側荊棘路進本。｜Run Razorfen Kraul on the way to Thousand Needles. In Ratchet, pick up 1221 and the gopher tools. Pick up 1109 from Faranell in Undercity on the way to Hillsbrad. If passing through Thunder Bluff before the run, get 1102 from Auld. From Freewind Post, take the Great Lift back into the Barrens, then follow the west thorn path to the portal.

05-副本.md:708｜步驟說明｜奧特蘭克山脈到奧特蘭克時交件。若日誌顯示亂風崗，按提示交勞恩·峭壁行者（1441 46.14, 51.71）。｜Turn in in Alterac. If your log says Freewind Post, see Rau (1441 46.14, 51.71).
05-副本.md:710｜站內取捨｜想接狂熱之心與剃刀高地後續，尾王及前廳蝙蝠都要打；只有短時間可先做沿路地鼠或護送。｜Kill the final boss and the bats in the front hall to unlock Hearts of Zeal and the Razorfen Downs follow-up. If short on time, do the gophers or escort along the route first.
05-副本.md:711｜站內說明｜大升降梯西側是剃刀沼澤；東側是剃刀高地。42.30, 89.90 為永恆版客戶端的門口標記。從大路沿西側荊棘隧道找傳送門。｜Razorfen Kraul is west of the Great Lift. Razorfen Downs is east. The Forever client marks the entrance at 42.30, 89.90. Follow the west thorn tunnel from the main road to the dungeon portal.
05-副本.md:714｜副本動線｜入本左轉下坡到清潔區→右側宿舍護送克努比→電刑器→群體打擊者→瑟瑪普拉格，拾密碼開保險箱。打到髒戒指後回清潔區用超級清潔器。｜Go left and downhill to the Clean Zone → escort Kernobee from the quarters on the right → Electrocutioner 6000 → Crowd Pummeler 9-60 → Thermaplugg, then use his code on the safe. Use the Sparklematic in the Clean Zone if you loot a Grime-Encrusted Ring.
05-副本.md:717｜副本入口｜荊棘谷 1434 27.60, 77.48｜Stranglethorn Vale 1434 27.60, 77.48
05-副本.md:717｜步驟說明｜部落入場用藏寶海灣傳送器，座標為斯庫提工作區。｜Horde enter via the Booty Bay teleporter. The pin marks Scooty's workshop.
05-副本.md:725｜站內前置接取路線｜前往荊棘谷 藏寶海灣前，在奧格瑪 榮譽谷先找索維克和諾格。從棘齒城坐船到藏寶海灣，或格羅姆高飛藏寶海灣；斯庫提完成 2842→2843 後，保留哥布林轉發器進入。｜Before Booty Bay, visit Sovik and Nogg in the Valley of Honor. Take the boat from Ratchet or fly from Grom'gol to Booty Bay. Finish 2842 → 2843 with Scooty and keep the Goblin Transponder to enter.

05-副本.md:755｜站內取捨｜裝備或任務經驗值得時再打；和藏寶海灣任務一起交最省路。｜Run if the gear or quest XP is worth it. Pair the turn-ins with your Booty Bay quests to save travel.
05-副本.md:756｜站內說明｜傳送到丹莫洛的設施後，循地下走道到實例門；不走鐵爐堡。若未解斯庫提，先完成傳送鏈。｜Use the teleporter to the facility in Dun Morogh and follow the underground corridor to the dungeon portal. Skip Ironforge. Finish Scooty's chain first if the teleporter is locked.
05-副本.md:759｜副本動線｜祖爾阿萊→伐塔卡→懼湧船長→不滅之髓→聖蛇米洛斯。沿途在入口水池左側、伐塔卡左側、船區頭骨嘴裡和米洛斯身後拓印石板；船區同時清海盜並收神器。原初元素與基爾可選。｜Zul'Alai → Var'Taka → Captain Dreadrise → Deathless Marrow → Min'loth the Serpent. Make rubbings left of the entrance pool, left of Var'Taka, in the skull by the ships and behind Min'loth. Loot artifacts from the pirates. Primeval Elemental and Gill are optional.
05-副本.md:762｜副本入口｜荊棘谷 1434 21.50, 27.70｜Stranglethorn Vale 1434 21.50, 27.70
05-副本.md:769｜站內前置接取路線｜荊棘谷第一次已排進主線：格羅姆高接 629 先做暗礁海、交後接 95748；藏寶海灣找克拉茲克接 95789、95791；祖昆達拓印 95748；回格羅姆高接 95770、95773 在西岸一起做完，交後接 95775、95776。若已開雷霆崖飛行點，進本前可飛雷霆崖，沿莫高雷道路去天空觀測高臺找瑪庫可。接齊後回格羅姆高，自西岸下水游到水下傳送門。｜Follow the first Stranglethorn visit: take 629 at Grom'gol and do the reef objectives, then turn it in for 95748. Take 95789 and 95791 from Krazek at Booty Bay. Take the rubbings for 95748 at Zul'Kunda. Back at Grom'gol, pick up 95770 and 95773, do both on the west coast, then take 95775 and 95776. If you've unlocked Thunder Bluff, fly there before the run and follow the Mulgore road to Mazu'kon at Skywatcher Plateau. Return to Grom'gol and swim to the underwater portal from the west coast.

05-副本.md:814｜站內說明｜實例門在格羅姆高以西的水下洞窟。DungeonsForever 點 21.50, 27.70 與實地攻略的約 21.4, 27.9 相符；22.40, 27.18 是 95770 探查點。帶水下呼吸藥劑，或請有技能的隊友施放。｜The portal is in an underwater cave west of Grom'gol. The DungeonsForever pin (21.50, 27.70) matches the field guide (around 21.4, 27.9). Quest 95770 uses a separate exploration point (22.40, 27.18). Bring an underwater breathing potion or ask a party member for the spell.
05-副本.md:817｜副本動線｜入口清到火眼莫德雷斯附近牢房→和貝尼斯特拉茲交換誓言石，再護送他封印神像，途中可能遇見腐爛的普雷莫→沿螺旋坡打亞門納爾，同區找寒冰使者之眼。｜Clear to Belnistrasz's cell near Mordresh Fire Eye → turn in the oathstone and escort him to the idol, with Plaguemaw the Rotting if encountered → take the spiral ramp to Amnennar and look for the Coldbringer's Eye nearby.
05-副本.md:820｜副本入口｜貧瘠之地 1413 約 49.10, 93.40（荊棘通道深處的副本門）｜The Barrens (1413), portal deep in the thorn tunnel, about 49.10, 93.40.
05-副本.md:828｜站內前置接取路線｜離開阿拉希高地 落錘鎮時先飛幽暗城。千針石林 閃光平原可先打剃刀沼澤並拾 6522。奧特蘭克山脈至阿拉希高地 落錘鎮經幽暗城時先交瓦里瑪薩斯，再同城找安德魯接 3341。由提里斯法坐飛艇回奧格瑪、飛雷霆崖，往莫高雷西北找蘇塔菈接 97196；飛陶拉祖往南，門外找麥雷姆。若從東部王國的火線港轉場，可搭船到熱砂港後北上千針石林。｜Fly from Hammerfall to Undercity. On the Shimmering Flats leg, run Razorfen Kraul and loot 6522. On the Alterac–Hammerfall leg, turn in to Varimathras in Undercity, then take 3341 from Andrew. Take the zeppelin from Tirisfal to Orgrimmar, then fly to Thunder Bluff and see Sutara Plainstalker in northwest Mulgore for 97196. Fly to Camp Taurajo and head south to Myriam Moonsinger outside the entrance. From Powderfuse Port, you can also boat to Steamwheedle Port and head north to Thousand Needles.

05-副本.md:859｜站內說明｜五人隊，無鑰匙。門口在大升降梯北側的東路，與西側剃刀沼澤不同。若已轉入大河林地，可在火線港搭船到熱砂港後再北上。｜Five-player dungeon. No key needed. Take the eastern road north of the Great Lift. Razorfen Kraul is to the west. From Riverglades, boat from Powderfuse Port to Steamwheedle Port, then head north.
05-副本.md:860｜站內提醒｜五人隊，無鑰匙。門口在大升降梯北側的東路，與西側剃刀沼澤不同。若已轉入大河林地，可在火線港搭船到熱砂港後再北上。｜Five-player dungeon. No key needed. Take the eastern road north of the Great Lift. Razorfen Kraul is to the west. From Riverglades, boat from Powderfuse Port to Steamwheedle Port, then head north.
05-副本.md:864｜副本動線｜正門→雷夫洛什→找遺體取日記，先回卡加斯翻譯再回本。可從後門直接去黑曜石哨兵。【僅法師】第二挖掘場→加加恩→格瑞姆洛克→阿札達斯→查諾甘農圓盤。｜Main entrance → Revelosh → loot the journal from the remains. Return to Kargath for the translation before the next run. Mages can reach the Obsidian Sentinel from the back door. Second dig site → Galgann → Grimlok → Archaedas → Discs of Norgannon.

05-副本.md:867｜副本入口｜荒蕪之地 1418 約 42.60, 10.80（正門定位，沿挖掘場入地下）；後門實際門點 ?｜Badlands (1418), about 42.60, 10.80. Follow the dig site underground. Back portal coords unknown.
05-副本.md:875｜站內前置接取路線｜荒蕪之地 卡加斯走奧達曼；奧特蘭克山脈、阿拉希高地 落錘鎮到幽暗城先接派翠克的 2342。由落錘鎮或格羅姆高飛荒蕪之地 卡加斯，接加卡爾 2258→2202，再找里格弗茲與塞爾杜林。滿 35 級可在塵泥沼澤先做塔貝薩的前置【僅法師】。想做項鏈時，第一趟先打到破碎項鏈，可趁往返奧格瑪時交德蘭，第二趟再從卡加斯進副本。｜Approach Uldaman from Kargath. On the Alterac and Hammerfall legs, take 2342 from Patrick in Undercity. Fly from Hammerfall or Grom'gol to Kargath, do Jarkal's 2258 → 2202, then visit Rigglefuzz and Theldurin. Mages can do Tabetha's Dustwallow prerequisite from level 35. For the necklace chain, loot the Shattered Necklace on the first run, turn it in to Dran on an Orgrimmar visit, then return through Kargath.

05-副本.md:938｜站內取捨｜優先順手接 2202、2342、2418，達 40 可取圓盤並拿背包。項鏈要來回兩趟以上，想快速練級時可略。｜Prioritize 2202, 2342, and 2418. At level 40, get the discs and the bag. The necklace takes at least two trips, so skip it if leveling quickly.
05-副本.md:939｜站內說明｜五人隊。34 級先接幽暗城 2342，荒蕪之地順路再做外洞；清尾王建議 42 級。正門適合全清與項鏈，後門適合只打後半。要做法師任務可從後門走【僅法師】。部分資料只標地面洞口，找門時沿洞內主道。｜Five-player dungeon. At level 34, take 2342 in Undercity and do the outer cave when passing through Badlands. Aim for level 42 for the final boss. Use the front door for a full clear or the necklace, or the back door for the latter half or the Mage quest. If your map only marks the surface cave, follow the main tunnel to the portal.
05-副本.md:939｜標籤｜僅法師｜Mage only

At level 34, take 2342 in Undercity and do the outer cave when passing through Badlands. Aim for level 42 for the final boss. Use the front door for a full clear or the necklace, or the back door for the latter half or the Mage quest. If your map only marks the surface cave, follow the main tunnel to the portal.
05-副本.md:940｜標籤｜僅法師｜Mage only
05-副本.md:944｜副本動線｜礦道打葛羅克斯→暮光指揮官扎爾莫克→阿什卡旁鐵匠鋪找鑄模→納古克取暮光寶典→橋頭圖夫→霸主馬戈取馬戈之眼。全程沿途收暮光教徒耳朵。｜Mine: Slavecrusher Grox → Twilight Commander Zarmok → mold in Ashka's smithy → Nar'gurk for Tome of Twilight → Bossman Toof at the bridge → Overlord Mugg for Eye of Mugg. Loot cultist ears along the way.
05-副本.md:947｜副本入口｜大河林地 2548 48.60, 26.30｜Riverglades 2548 48.60, 26.30
05-副本.md:953｜站內前置接取路線｜到大河林地羅格瑪先做特朗古爾的 Sunnyglade 與棒趾鏈，跑博德羅克的鈍拳前置；之後從羅格瑪往西進暮光營地找達羅許和 Crag’rog，回羅格瑪交書信再接眼與寶典。飛羅格瑪或從卡加斯步行進河林，往 Sunnyglade 正北的高地找門。厚皮 ×4、鐵錠 ×12 可先備給模具後續。｜At Rog'mar, do Tran'gul's Sunnyglade and Clubtoe quests, then the Bolder'ok prerequisites. Go west from Rog'mar to the Twilight camp and find Da'grosh and Crag'rog. Turn in the letter at Rog'mar to unlock the eye and tome quests. Fly to Rog'mar or walk from Kargath, then find the portal on the heights north of Sunnyglade. Bring 4 Thick Leather and 12 Iron Bars for the mold follow-up.

05-副本.md:1039｜站內取捨｜先完成 大河林地羅格瑪、大河林地博德羅克與火線港前置再組隊，可同趟完成三項。鑄模材料可預備，有打到再交。｜Finish the Rog'mar, Bolder'ok, and Powderfuse Port prerequisites before grouping so you can do all three on one run. Bring the mold materials and turn them in if the mold drops.
05-副本.md:1040｜站內說明｜入口在 Sunnyglade 正北，城門旁另有要塞傳送門。採用本機 DungeonsForever 入口點；Wowhead 河林概覽的早期標記與此不同。94800 系列等聯盟任務不列入部落路線。｜The entrance is north of Sunnyglade, with another portal by the stronghold gate. Use the DungeonsForever entrance pin. The early Wowhead Riverglades overview marks a different spot. Alliance quests such as the 94800 chain are outside this route.
05-副本.md:1043｜副本動線｜橙線打諾克賽恩、銳刺鞭笞者，紫線打維利塔恩；沿路收塑像、可汗寶石和任務材料→兩線掉落齊了到匯合點找塞雷布拉斯，跟完節杖儀式→地歌瀑布→公主→洛特格里普水池（選做）。｜Orange: Noxxion and Razorlash. Purple: Lord Vyletongue. Collect statues, khan gems and other quest loot → Celebras at the junction, then follow his scepter ritual → Earth Song Falls → the Princess → Rotgrip's pool if needed.
05-副本.md:1046｜副本入口｜淒涼之地 1443 29.10, 62.50｜Desolace 1443 29.10, 62.50
05-副本.md:1054｜站內前置接取路線｜前往淒涼之地 葬影村前，可從奧格瑪尤塞爾奈接暗影殘片，但最低 39 級。離開菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地後往淒涼之地 葬影村，先找瓦克與瑟琳德拉，再繞維洛、半人馬賤民。想做永恆版水瓶支線先到東南辛德拉，完成水晶塔與魔導師引導後到遺忘花園接 93594→93404。辛德拉任務的最低 35 級由 Wowhead 永恆版補足。進瑪拉頓橙門之前接凱雯德拉。｜At level 39, take Shadowshard Fragments from Uthel'nay in Orgrimmar before Shadowprey Village. From Camp Mojache, head to Shadowprey Village and see Warug and Selendra, then visit Willow and the Centaur Pariah. For the Forever water-vial chain, do the crystal-tower and Magister lead-ins in southeast Shen'dralas, then take 93594 → 93404 at the Forgotten Gardens. Wowhead lists level 35 for the Shen'dralas quests. Pick up from Cavindra before the orange portal.

05-副本.md:1088｜交通步驟｜橙線（Foulspore Cavern，45–53）。進洞深處看橙色水晶和池塘，先裝水再穿橙色傳送門。｜Orange side: Foulspore Cavern (45–53). Look for orange crystals and the pool deep in the cave. Fill the vial before entering the portal.
05-副本.md:1089｜步驟位置｜橙門外水池裝水，進門後沿路找藤蔓。｜Fill the vial at the pool outside the orange portal. Find vines inside.
05-副本.md:1090｜交通步驟｜紫線（Wicked Grotto，45–53）。由三岔處走紫色水晶通道；取得維利塔恩掉落的鑽石。｜Purple side: Wicked Grotto (45–53). Take the purple crystal passage at the three-way fork. Loot the diamond from Lord Vyletongue.
05-副本.md:1091｜步驟說明｜本機 QuestieDB 任務文字為 15；舊攻略可能列 25，以日誌為準。｜QuestieDB says 15; older guides may list 25. Follow your quest log.

05-副本.md:1092｜步驟說明｜第一位在橙紫兩線之間；第二與第三位分別在門外通道；第四、第五位在橙、紫門內，各巡邏。｜Three khans patrol by the fork and outer tunnels. One is inside each portal.
05-副本.md:1092｜步驟位置｜橙紫分岔與兩外洞找前三人，兩門內各一人。｜Find three khans at the fork and outer caves, then one inside each portal.

05-副本.md:1115｜站內取捨｜首次想拿節杖就走橙、紫兩線，若只打公主與鱷魚，隊友有節杖可直接進內區。任務若需門外暗影怪或不同分支，不要從捷徑跳過。｜Do both orange and purple wings to get the scepter on your first run. If you only want the princess and crocodile, use a party member's scepter to enter the inner wing. Skip the shortcut if you need the shadow mobs outside or objectives in another wing.
05-副本.md:1116｜站內說明｜29.10, 62.50 是荒野洞口，橙與紫兩道實例門要沿對應顏色洞道尋找；實例門單獨的世界座標 ?。紫線與橙線在毒水瀑布附近會合。｜The outer cave is at 29.10, 62.50. Follow the orange or purple tunnel to its portal. Exact world coordinates for the separate portals are unverified. Both routes meet by the poison waterfall.
05-副本.md:1119｜副本動線｜安圖蘇爾支路→塞卡甲蟲房順取第一塊摩沙魯石板→祖穆拉恩墓地→金字塔階梯事件→水占師維蕾薩取第二塊摩沙魯石板和探水棒（水池可選召加茲瑞拉）→烏克茲。沿路收聖甲蟲殼和食人妖調和劑。｜Antu'sul's side path → Theka for the first Mosh'aru Tablet → Zum'rah's graveyard → pyramid stairs event for the Divino-matic Rod → Velratha for the second tablet → optional Gahz'rilla at the pool → Chief Ukorz. Loot scarab shells and Troll Temper throughout.
05-副本.md:1122｜副本入口｜塔納利斯 1446 38.70, 20.00｜Tanaris 1446 38.70, 20.00

Collect the spirits in Feralas. Return to Steamwheedle Port to turn in 3520 and pick up 3527 before meeting your group at Gadgetzan. Pick up 2770 when passing the Shimmering Flats. Mages can do Tabetha's Dustwallow quest before Swamp of Sorrows.

05-副本.md:1164｜站內說明｜可在塔納利斯 熱砂港與加基森先刷一次；走完整葉基亞前置才建議塔納利斯 加基森與砂槌營地刷。摩沙魯石板亦為哈卡鏈前置。｜Run once on the Steamwheedle Port and Gadgetzan leg. If doing Yeh'kinya's full chain, wait until the Gadgetzan and Dunemaul visit. The Tablets of Mosh'aru are also a prerequisite for the Hakkar chain.
05-副本.md:1168｜副本動線｜入口上層牢房找弗卡爾→打典獄長監督者瑞克斯取鑰匙→清審問者和海潮主母並收頭巾→開下層牢門打『清潔者』卡特莉娜與燃吼→在尾王身後密室查看紙條，再回上層牢房找弗卡爾。｜Find Commander Folkar in the upper cells → kill Overseer Wrex for the key → clear The Questioner and Tidemistress Ca'zass, looting bandanas → open the lower cells for Katerina the Cleaner and Blazeroar → read the note in the hidden room and return to Folkar upstairs.

05-副本.md:1180｜站內前置接取路線｜前往悲傷沼澤時，未到 48 級可先開塵泥沼澤 蕨牆村飛行點。前往灼熱峽谷前，在奧格瑞瑪智慧谷索爾的大廳向伊崔格接 95283（1454 34.28, 39.35），再飛蕨牆村找納澤爾·血矛。沿東北海岸游往奧卡茲島，在島側軍士處依序交 95284、95285，拿 95309 再進島塔地下。留下 95483 至下次奧格瑞瑪。｜Below level 48? Unlock Brackenwall Village on the way to Swamp of Sorrows. Before Searing Gorge, take 95283 from Eitrigg in Thrall's chamber in the Valley of Wisdom (1454 34.28, 39.35). Fly to Brackenwall Village and see Nazeer Bloodpike. Swim from the northeast coast to Alcaz Island. Turn in 95284 and 95285 to the sergeant by the island, then take 95309 before going under the tower. Save 95483 for Orgrimmar.

05-副本.md:1219｜站內說明｜部落可避開塞拉摩；由蕨牆村到東北海岸後游泳。軍士在島側，副本門位於島塔地下走廊。｜Avoid Theramore. Go from Brackenwall Village to the northeast coast and swim across. The sergeant is by the island, and the dungeon portal is in the corridor under the tower.
05-副本.md:1223｜副本動線｜入口右側平路→下層環廊查祭壇並點雕像→阿塔拉利恩→上層六座陽台清守衛→獻祭之穴東廊打迦瑪蘭→西廊可選召哈卡→四龍獸→伊蘭尼庫斯與精華之泉。沿途打阿塔萊食人妖收神像。｜Take the right entrance path to the lower ring → check the altar, activate the statues and kill Atal'alarion → clear the six upper balconies → east from the Pit of Sacrifice for Jammal'an → optional Hakkar event west → four dragonkin → Eranikus and the Essence Font. Loot idols from Atal'ai trolls throughout.
05-副本.md:1226｜副本入口｜悲傷沼澤 1435 69.50, 52.50（神廟建築外部路標）｜Swamp of Sorrows (1435), 69.50, 52.50. Marks the outside of the temple.
05-副本.md:1234｜站內前置接取路線｜到悲傷沼澤 斯通納德完成 1424 並保留 1429；從辛特蘭 惡齒村飛行點走到辛特蘭南側流放者交 1429、接 1444 與 1446，若完成祖爾法拉克石板鏈再去辛薩羅拿卵。菲拉斯先接 3380；塔納利斯 加基森與砂槌營地先到瑪爾馮開石環任務，飛棘齒城取物，再回瑪爾馮接兩個神廟任務。在塔納利斯 熱砂港交卵後，可從加基森飛棘齒城，再搭船到藏寶海灣，飛斯通納德交 1444、接 1445 並赴神廟。｜Finish 1424 in Stonard and keep 1429. From Revantusk Village, walk to the exile in the southern Hinterlands. Turn in 1429 and take 1444 and 1446. Get the egg at Jintha'Alor if you've finished the Zul'Farrak tablet chain. Take 3380 in Feralas. On the Gadgetzan and Dunemaul leg, start the Stone Circle quest with Marvon, get the item in Ratchet, then return to Marvon for both temple quests. Turn in the egg at Steamwheedle Port. Fly Gadgetzan → Ratchet, boat to Booty Bay, then fly to Stonard to turn in 1444 and take 1445 before entering.

05-副本.md:1287｜站內取捨｜斯通納德與辛特蘭本地鏈優先；摩沙魯鏈適合已刷祖爾法拉克並到辛薩羅的人；石環在塔納利斯 加基森與砂槌營地安排棘齒城一趟。｜Prioritize the Stonard and Hinterlands chains. Do the Mosh'aru chain if you've already run Zul'Farrak and visited Jintha'Alor. Plan one Ratchet trip for the Stone Circle during the Gadgetzan and Dunemaul leg.
05-副本.md:1288｜站內說明｜座標指向淚水之池建築外。沿南側階梯進神廟，經面具之廳及儀式之廳到骸骨之廳中層的副本門。｜The pin marks the building outside the Pool of Tears. Go down the south stairs into the temple, past the Hall of Masks and the Hall of Ritual, to the portal on the middle level of the Hall of Bones.
05-副本.md:1292｜副本動線｜入口外可先打征服者派隆→監獄與競技場外廊清鐵怒矮人→黑鐵砧打伊森迪奧斯→工藝大廳打弗諾斯、到紀念碑換影爐鑰匙→寶庫取山脈之心、黑鐵酒吧打雷布裏和取秘方，順路可互換→過七賢與熔岩橋，到熔火之心門旁拾核心碎片。沿途打元素怪與魔像。｜Optional Pyron outside → Ironfury dwarves in the Detention Block and Ring of Law → Incendius at the Black Anvil → Fineous in the Hall of Crafting and the monument for the Shadowforge Key → Heart in the vault and Ribbly and the recipe in the Grim Guzzler, in either order → pass the Seven and the lava bridge for the Core Fragment. Loot elementals and golems throughout.
05-副本.md:1295｜副本入口｜灼熱峽谷 1427 34.80, 85.30（黑石山外部路標）｜Searing Gorge (1427), 34.80, 85.30. Marks the approach to Blackrock Mountain.
05-副本.md:1303｜站內前置接取路線｜在灼熱峽谷 瑟銀哨塔開點，去燃燒平原 烈焰峰時先找尤卡與麥克斯沃特。飛卡加斯接桑德哈特、通緝板與薇薇安，進黑石山殺門外派隆後回卡加斯交 3906，接 3907、7201；再由瑟銀哨塔或烈焰峰進山。｜Unlock Thorium Point. Visit Yuka and Maxwort at Flame Crest, then fly to Kargath for Thunderheart, the wanted poster, and Vivian. Kill Pyron outside Blackrock Depths and return to Kargath to turn in 3906 and take 3907 and 7201. Reenter Blackrock Mountain from Thorium Point or Flame Crest.

05-副本.md:1330｜步驟說明｜DungeonsForever 地城圖參考點 47.60, 57.50。同一事件的聯盟任務 4126 標記是觸發三個酒桶的實際位置，兩陣營由同一敵人掉落秘方。｜Break the kegs at 47.60, 57.50. Both factions loot the recipe from the same mob.

05-副本.md:1331｜步驟位置｜進黑鐵寶庫開十二遺物箱，進暗室取山脈之心｜Open 12 relic coffers in the Black Vault, then loot the Heart in the hidden room.

05-副本.md:1332｜步驟位置｜過七賢及熔岩橋，碎片在熔火之心門旁｜Pass the Seven and cross the lava bridge. The fragment is by the Core portal.

05-副本.md:1344｜站內取捨｜首趟優先卡加斯與烈焰峰任務；時間足夠再做寶庫或熔火之心門。｜Prioritize the Kargath and Flame Crest quests on the first run. Do the vault or the Molten Core entrance if you have time.
05-副本.md:1345｜站內說明｜北側入口通往黑石山，內部沿中央鎖鏈下行，穿過磨石場及派隆後找到實際副本門。也可由燃燒平原 1428 29.40, 38.30 進山。｜Enter Blackrock Mountain from the north. Descend the central chain and pass through the Grinding Quarry, past Overmaster Pyron, to the dungeon portal. You can also enter the mountain from Burning Steppes (1428 29.40, 38.30).
05-副本.md:1349｜副本動線｜下層入口→歐莫克→沃什加斯→斜坡下找比修和裝置→沃恩→蛛網區清卵與煙網蛛后→哈雷肯與基茲魯爾→維姆薩拉克。歐莫克、沃恩與維姆薩拉克的寶鑽一路收齊。｜Lower entrance → Omokk → Vosh'gajin → Bijou and her belongings down the ramp → Voone → eggs and Mother Smolderweb → Halycon and Gizrul → Wyrmthalak. Loot the gems from Omokk, Voone and Wyrmthalak.
05-副本.md:1352｜副本入口｜灼熱峽谷 1427 34.80, 85.30（黑石山外部路標）｜Searing Gorge (1427), 34.80, 85.30. Marks the approach to Blackrock Mountain.
05-副本.md:1360｜站內前置接取路線｜在燃燒平原 烈焰峰先開飛行點，55 級後回烈焰峰找基布雷爾接兩件。到冬泉谷 永望鎮找基爾拉姆，跨海回東部王國後飛卡加斯向高圖斯、賈拉瑪弗、雷克斯洛特接任。走灼熱峽谷或烈焰峰到黑石山東側上層陽台入共同傳送門；回卡加斯交 4903，接 4941 並保留。｜Unlock Flame Crest and return at level 55 for both quests from Kibler. See Kilram in Everlook. After crossing to the Eastern Kingdoms, fly to Kargath for quests from Warlord Goretooth, Galamav the Marksman, and Lexlort. Approach Blackrock Mountain from Searing Gorge or Flame Crest and take the shared portal on the upper east balcony. Turn in 4903 in Kargath, then take and keep 4941.

05-副本.md:1381｜步驟順序｜先打沃什加斯，再沿其房間斜坡找比修｜Kill War Master Voone, then take the ramp in his room to Bijou.
05-副本.md:1382｜步驟說明｜先告訴隊伍留一隻幼狼，避免被範圍攻擊擊殺。｜Tell the group to leave a worg pup alive. Keep it out of AoE.
05-副本.md:1382｜步驟位置｜過蜘蛛區與食人妖岔道，進狼房抓幼狼｜Past the spiders and troll fork, enter the wolf room and cage a pup.
05-副本.md:1383｜步驟位置｜蜘蛛區後岔路往右，沿路進左側狼巢｜Go right at the fork after the spiders. Take the left side into the wolf den.
05-副本.md:1384｜步驟說明｜文件位置會變，遇到前三房先找。｜The document can move. Check each of the first three rooms as you reach it.
05-副本.md:1384｜步驟說明｜DungeonsForever 地城圖參考點 35.10, 55.30、52.50, 54.90、57.80, 60.50。依序為歐莫克、沃恩、維姆薩拉克。文件若出現在不同首領房間，逐間查看。｜Map: Omokk 35.10,55.30; Voone 52.50,54.90; Wyrmthalak 57.80,60.50. Check each room.
05-副本.md:1384｜步驟位置｜沿三王線逐房找文件，也查看烏洛克貢品堆｜Check each of the three bosses' rooms and Urok's tribute pile for the documents.
05-副本.md:1384｜步驟順序｜歐莫克→沃恩→維姆薩拉克｜Omokk → Voone → Wyrmthalak.
05-副本.md:1385｜步驟說明｜寶石與印章掉落機率有限，先和隊友約定分配；若只打上層，隊伍一人持完成品即可。｜Agree on gem and seal loot first. For UBRS, only one player needs a finished seal.

05-副本.md:1403｜站內說明｜開服後下層可進。黑石山外部路標另可用燃燒平原 1428 29.40, 38.30；進山後沿上行路到東側高台，進門後往右下走。｜Lower Blackrock Spire is available at launch. For the surface entrance, use Burning Steppes (1428 29.40, 38.30). Follow the uphill route inside to the east ledge. After entering, go down to the right.
05-副本.md:1407｜副本動線｜正門→市場菸草店→進血色堡壘，威利支線可略→檔案管理員加爾福特的房間同時取資料與燒檔案→需要全清再打巴納札爾。｜Main gate → tobacco shop in Market Row → Scarlet Bastion. Skip Cannon Master Willey if desired. In Archivist Galford's room, retrieve the painting and burn the records. Kill Balnazzar for a full clear.
05-副本.md:1410｜副本入口｜東瘟疫之地 1423 約 27.10, 10.70（正門傳送門）｜Eastern Plaguelands (1423), main portal, about 27.10, 10.70.
05-副本.md:1418｜站內前置接取路線｜先在東瘟疫之地 聖光之願禮拜堂找公爵和煙鬼。沿瘟疫之地大道往西北，走正門；要做提里恩的畫，先在東瘟疫之地 聖光之願禮拜堂完成狩獵，接續跑南部墓穴、北谷，轉去西瘟疫凱爾達隆找畫家，再回東瘟疫。｜Visit the Duke and Smokey at Light's Hope Chapel, then follow the main road northwest to the front gate. For Tirion's painting, finish the hunting quests first. Continue through the southern crypt and northern valley, see the painter on Caer Darrow, then return to Eastern Plaguelands.

05-副本.md:1449｜步驟說明｜DungeonsForever 地城圖參考點 27.10, 75.10。檔案管理員座標，血色檔案位於同一間檔案室。｜DungeonsForever map: Archivist (27.10, 75.10). The records are in his room.

05-副本.md:1450｜步驟說明｜DungeonsForever 地城圖參考點 27.10, 75.10。這是檔案室首領的位置，雙月畫在同一間，沒有獨立座標。｜Map: Archivist (27.10, 75.10). The painting is in the same room.
05-副本.md:1450｜步驟位置｜同一間血色檔案室，查牆上的雙月畫｜Check the painting of two moons on the wall of the Scarlet archives.
05-副本.md:1457｜站內取捨｜煙草和檔案任務兩件好接；已完成提里恩前半再加愛與家庭。想只跑一趟時先把前置接齊。｜Pick up the tobacco and archive quests. Add Of Love and Family if you've finished Tirion's earlier chain. Get the prerequisites before heading in if you only want one run.
05-副本.md:1458｜站內說明｜五人隊。血色要塞門請帶血色十字軍鑰匙。未滿 58 級時先接、到等級再組；可從地下側門進亡靈區。｜Five-player dungeon. Bring the Scarlet Key for the Bastion gate. Below level 58, pick up the quests and group later. Use the Service Entrance for the undead wing.
05-副本.md:1459｜站內提醒｜五人隊。血色要塞門請帶血色十字軍鑰匙。未滿 58 級時先接、到等級再組；可從地下側門進亡靈區。｜Five-player dungeon. Bring the Scarlet Key for the Bastion gate. Below level 58, pick up the quests and group later. Use the Service Entrance for the undead wing.
05-副本.md:1463｜副本動線｜側門先找小教堂的奧里克斯→打三座通靈塔的安娜絲塔麗、奈魯布恩坎和蒼白的瑪勒基，順查通靈塔資料→屠宰場拉姆斯登→打瑞文戴爾後與奧里克斯交談。沿路收肉塊、開木箱取聖水、解放幽靈居民。｜Service gate → Aurius in the chapel → Baroness Anastari, Nerub'enkan and Maleki in the three ziggurats. Check for the data → Ramstein in the Slaughterhouse → Baron Rivendare, then speak to Aurius. Loot flesh and Holy Water and free Spectral Citizens on the way.
05-副本.md:1466｜副本入口｜東瘟疫之地 1423 約 43.50, 19.40（亡靈區側門）｜Eastern Plaguelands (1423), Undead side entrance, about 43.50, 19.40.
05-副本.md:1474｜站內前置接取路線｜先在東瘟疫之地 聖光之願禮拜堂找貝蒂娜、萊尼德與護理者奧林，西去恐懼谷找伊根後再進側門。從正門跑過的隊伍可把後續 5213 留這一趟。｜Visit Betina, Leonid, and Caretaker Alen at Light's Hope Chapel. Head west to see Egan in Terrordale before entering through the side gate. If your group has cleared from the front gate, save follow-up 5213 for this run.

05-副本.md:1495｜步驟位置｜清通靈塔後過屠宰場，到瑞文戴爾房找奧里克斯｜Clear the ziggurats and Slaughterhouse. Find Aurius in Rivendare's room.

05-副本.md:1504｜站內取捨｜肉塊、聖水、伊根的靈魂可同趟。只刷一翼可略過需要先拿信仰獎章的奧里克斯線。｜Collect the flesh, Holy Water, and Egan's souls on one run. If doing only one wing, skip the Aurius chain that requires the Medallion of Faith first.
05-副本.md:1505｜站內說明｜五人隊。側門用城市大門鑰匙；第一次可從正門通過城內路線，從巴瑟拉斯取得側門鑰匙。｜Five-player dungeon. Bring the Key to the City for the Service Entrance. On your first run, go through from the front gate and get the key from Barthilas.
05-副本.md:1506｜站內提醒｜五人隊。側門用城市大門鑰匙；第一次可從正門通過城內路線，從巴瑟拉斯取得側門鑰匙。｜Five-player dungeon. Bring the Key to the City for the Service Entrance. On your first run, go through from the front gate and get the key from Barthilas.
05-副本.md:1510｜副本動線｜主入口先追普希林，到終點再開打→蕾瑟塔蒂絲與海多斯博恩依分支順路打→薩特祭壇打瑟雷姆·刺蹄→尾王奧茲恩。圖書館另從西區或北區進。｜Chase Pusillin from the entrance and fight him at the end → Lethtendris and Hydrospawn on the side paths → Zevrim Thornhoof at the satyr altar → Alzzin the Wildshaper. Enter the Library from West or North.
05-副本.md:1513｜副本入口｜菲拉斯 1444 64.80, 30.20（競技場東牆凹處傳送門）｜Feralas (1444), 64.80, 30.20. Portal in the recess along the arena's east wall.
05-副本.md:1521｜站內前置接取路線｜艾薩拉 瓦羅莫克經奧格瑪且滿 54 級時可向公告員高拉克接 7492；在菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地交塔羅並先接 7489，飛菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地後找拉瑞斯小亭的埃斯托爾迪。5527 可從月光林地接，希利蘇斯 塞納里奧要塞南風村取匣、月光林地 永夜港交後才有 5526，可留到晚一趟。｜At level 54, take 7492 from Warcaller Gorlach when passing through Orgrimmar on the Valormok leg. Turn in to Talo and take 7489 at Camp Mojache. Fly to Camp Mojache and visit Azj'Tordin at Lariss Pavilion. For 5527, pick it up in Moonglade, collect the reliquary at Southwind Village, and turn it in at Nighthaven to unlock 5526. Save that chain for a later run if needed.

05-副本.md:1549｜站內說明｜五人隊，東門可直接進。別只跳王漏掉普希林。鑰匙留著開西、北區。｜Five-player dungeon. Use the east entrance. Don't skip Pusillin on a boss run. Keep the key for the west and north wings.

05-副本.md:1554｜副本動線｜西門→花園清水晶塔→特迪斯·扭木→上層找古靈接任務並清塔（卡雷迪斯、伊琳娜可選）→牢籠打伊莫塔爾→圖書館打托塞德林→回古靈交接，再返圖書館找寶藏與遺骸。｜West gate → clear the garden pylons → Tendris Warpwood → see the Ancient upstairs and clear the remaining pylons, with Kalendris and Illyanna optional → Immol'thar in the prison → Prince Tortheldrin in the Library. Turn in to the Ancient, then return to the Library for the chest and remains.

05-副本.md:1565｜站內前置接取路線｜在菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地找先知科魯拉克；滿 54 級可在菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地先接 7481。飛莫沙徹後沿大道向西，隊內先確認月牙鑰匙；沒人有就先排東區。｜Visit Sage Korolusk at Camp Mojache and pick up 7481 at level 54. Fly to camp and follow the main road west. Check that someone has the Crescent Key, or run the east wing first.

05-副本.md:1583｜站內取捨｜同一趟完成 7481、7461 及 7877；材料換附魔與多本長鏈留裝備行程。｜Do 7481, 7461, and 7877 on one run. Save the enchantment materials and longer multi-dungeon chains for a gear run.
05-副本.md:1584｜站內說明｜五人隊。月牙鑰匙可由東區普希林取得。需清五塔才能打伊莫塔爾；圖書館的職業書見北區說明。｜Five-player dungeon. Get the Crescent Key from Pusillin in the east wing. Clear all five pylons before Immol'thar. See the north wing notes for the library class books.
05-副本.md:1585｜站內提醒｜五人隊。月牙鑰匙可由東區普希林取得。需清五塔才能打伊莫塔爾；圖書館的職業書見北區說明。｜Five-player dungeon. Get the Crescent Key from Pusillin in the east wing. Clear all five pylons before Immol'thar. See the north wing notes for the library class books.
05-副本.md:1589｜副本動線｜一般全清依序走莫爾達、克雷格、芬古斯、諾特旁的陷阱、克羅卡斯和戈多克大王。打貢品則保留沿途守衛，找諾特並處理陷阱，打完大王再回克雷格。職業書可另由入口庭院側門通圖書館。｜Full clear: Guard Mol'dar → Stomper Kreeg → Guard Fengus → trap by Knot → Captain Kromcrush → King Gordok. Tribute: leave guards alive, find Knot and fix the trap, then see Kreeg after killing the king. The courtyard side door leads to the Library for class books.
05-副本.md:1592｜副本入口｜菲拉斯 1444 62.50, 24.90（北區傳送門）｜Feralas (1444), 62.50, 24.90. North wing portal.
05-副本.md:1600｜站內前置接取路線｜在菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地整隊再往西；菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地可先準備材料。北區常用任務多在本內，先在東區取得月牙鑰匙，或者與有鑰匙的隊友同行。要交職業書可先從拍賣場備妥對應書。｜Group up and gather materials at Camp Mojache, then head west. Most north wing quests are inside. Get the Crescent Key in the east wing or bring someone who has it. Buy your class book at the Auction House if needed.

05-副本.md:1648｜站內說明｜貢品打法盡量保留守衛和克雷格，打倒戈多克大王後再對話。只想打普通全清，先和隊伍講清楚。｜For a Tribute run, leave the guards and Kreeg alive. Talk to them after killing King Gordok. Tell the group first if you want a standard full clear.
05-副本.md:1649｜站內提醒｜貢品打法盡量保留守衛和克雷格，打倒戈多克大王後再對話。只想打普通全清，先和隊伍講清楚。｜For a Tribute run, leave the guards and Kreeg alive. Talk to them after killing King Gordok. Tell the group first if you want a standard full clear.
05-副本.md:1654｜副本動線｜入口→泰坦遺跡沿途收四色水晶→在無色水晶旁一起處理水池目標。泰坦龍、Bolt、Vitrix、納納雅的完整擊殺順序待核。｜Entrance → collect four crystal colors through the titan ruins → handle the pool objectives by the Colorless Crystal. The full order for the titan dragon, Bolt, Vitrix and Nanaya remains unconfirmed.
05-副本.md:1654｜標籤｜需遊戲實測｜Needs in-game check
05-副本.md:1657｜副本入口｜安戈洛環形山 1449 48.10, 6.10（泰坦建築室外路標；副本傳送門精確點 ?）｜Un'Goro Crater (1449), 48.10, 6.10. Marks the Titan structure. Exact portal coords unknown.
05-副本.md:1666｜站內前置接取路線｜前往月光林地途中，經雷霆崖時可先到莫高雷西北找 Mayena Earthseeker。回安戈洛環形山 馬紹爾營地後，沿北邊石階往上找泰坦建築；95928 以外兩件的接取者仍待確認。｜On the way to Moonglade, stop by Mayena Earthseeker in northwest Mulgore while passing through Thunder Bluff. Back at Marshal's Refuge, take the stone stairs north to the titan structure. Pickup NPCs for the other two quests are unverified.

05-副本.md:1690｜副本動線｜入口橋→第一大廳取地契→召喚廳後取另一份→骨庫打血骨傀儡與瘟疫幼龍→萊斯·霜語房取地契→下層六室拿末份並清卡斯迪諾夫房→黑暗院長加丁。｜Entrance bridge → deed in the first hall → another past the summoning chamber → ossuary for Rattlegore and hatchlings → deed in Ras Frostwhisper's room → final deed and Krastinov downstairs → Darkmaster Gandling.
